words.definition: the state of being able to do something; capacity, competence, talent, quality, power
words.translation: 能力；能耐，本领；能力，能耐；才能

examples.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
examples.zh: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

words.definition: clever or good at doing something; capable, efficient, competent
words.translation: 有能力的；出色的；能；[经管]有能力的；能干的

examples.en: one of my more able students
examples.zh: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

words.definition: concerning or relating to a particular subject; concerning, as for, with reference to, round, in relation to; close-at-hand; around, approximately, everywhere, throughout, something
words.translation: 关于；在…周围；大约；在附近的；四处走动的；在起作用的；周围；到处

examples.en: a book about politics
examples.zh: 一本有关政治的书

examples.en: She said something about leaving town.
examples.zh: 她说了些要离开镇子的话。

examples.en: He lied about his age.
examples.zh: 他谎报年龄。

words.definition: beyond, without, than; hereinabove, thereinbefore
words.translation: 在…上面；高于；超过；在……上面；在……之上；在上面；在上文

examples.en: He lived in a flat above the shop.
examples.zh: 他住在那商店上面的一套房间里。

examples.en: The airliner flew above the clouds.
examples.zh: 大型客机在云层上面飞行。

words.definition: in or to a foreign country; foreign country
words.translation: (在)国外；到处；海外；异国

examples.en: I’ve never lived abroad before.
examples.zh: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

examples.en: She often goes abroad on business.
examples.zh: 她经常出国公干。

examples.en: We never travelled abroad when we were kids.
examples.zh: 我们小时候从来没有去国外旅行过。

words.definition: not at work, school, a meeting etc, because you are sick or decide not to go; missing, vacant
words.translation: 缺席的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的

examples.en: He has been absent from his desk for two weeks.
examples.zh: 他已经两个星期没来了。

words.definition: the way someone pronounces the words of a language, showing which country or which part of a country they come from; stress, trait; emphasize, stress, highlight
words.translation: 口音，腔调；重音；口音；[语]重音；强调；特点；重音符号；重读；带…口音讲话

examples.en: He had a strong Irish accent
examples.zh: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

words.definition: to take something that someone offers you, or to agree to do something that someone asks you to do; undertake, adopt, recognize, contain, shoulder; recognize, grant
words.translation: 接受；同意；承认；承担；承兑；容纳

examples.en: Rick accepted her offer of coffee.
examples.zh: 她请里克喝咖啡，他接受了。

examples.en: He accepted the invitation to stay with us.
examples.zh: 他接受了邀请来我们家住。

examples.en: His school reports said that he is always ready to accept a challenge (=  agree to do something difficult  ) .
examples.zh: 他的学业报告上说他乐于接受挑战。

words.definition: an event in which a car, train, plane etc is damaged and often someone is hurt; occurring, slip
words.translation: 意外的；事故；[安全]事故；意外；[法]意外事件；机遇

examples.en: Over 70,000 people are seriously injured every year in road accidents.
examples.zh: 每年在道路事故中受重伤的有七万多人。

examples.en: The accident happened at the junction of Forest Road and Pine Walk.
examples.zh: 事故发生在森林路与松树路的交叉口。

examples.en: a train accident
examples.zh: 火车事故

words.definition: if part of your body aches, you feel a continuous, but not very sharp pain there; a continuous pain that is not sharp or very strong; rare, aspire; pain, achiness
words.translation: 痛；想念；疼痛；[临床]疼痛；渴望

examples.en: His feet were aching from standing so long.
examples.zh: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

words.definition: to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard; accomplish, carry out, perform, complete, fulfil; gain one's ends, Make it.
words.translation: 完成，实现；达到；完成；达到目的；如愿以偿

examples.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
examples.zh: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

examples.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
examples.zh: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

examples.en: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
examples.zh: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

words.definition: through; opposite
words.translation: 横过；在…对面；穿过；横穿；在对面

words.definition: to do something in a particular way or for a particular reason; one thing that you do; play, take a part of; operate, bear oneself, conduct oneself; behavior, dealing, action, going, bill
words.translation: 行动；见效；行为；扮演；装作，举动像；扮演，充当；表现，举止；假装，演戏；起作用，见效；行为，行动；[法]法令，法案；（戏剧，歌剧的）一幕，段；装腔作势

examples.en: The company acted correctly in sacking him.
examples.zh: 公司解雇他做得对。

examples.en: The jury decided that Walker had acted in self-defence.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁定沃克的行为属于自卫。

examples.en: Politicians will only act when enough people demand that they do something.
examples.zh: 只有足够多的民众起来要求，政客们才会采取行动。

words.definition: the process of doing something, especially in order to achieve a particular thing; movement, function, doing, campaign, working
words.translation: 行动；作用；功能；活动；战斗；情节

examples.en: The government must take action (=  do something  ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
examples.zh: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

examples.en: She was looking forward to putting her ideas into action (=  doing the things she had planned  ) .
examples.zh: 她盼望着将自己的想法付诸实施。

examples.en: Ambulance crews are ready to spring into action (=  suddenly start doing something  ) if anything goes wrong during the race.
examples.zh: 救护车急救人员随时准备出动，以应对比赛期间发生的意外。

words.definition: always busy doing things, especially physical or mental activities; positive, valid, available, effective, virtual; rustler
words.translation: 活跃的；积极的；[物化]活跃的；主动的；[电子]有效的；现役的；主动语态；积极分子

examples.en: games for active youngsters
examples.zh: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

examples.en: She’s over 80, but is still very active.
examples.zh: 她80多岁了，但仍旧很活跃。

words.definition: things that people do, especially in order to achieve a particular aim; movement, doing, campaign, working, act
words.translation: 活动；活力；行动；活跃

examples.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
examples.zh: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

examples.en: fund-raising activities
examples.zh: 筹款活动

examples.en: Regular physical activity helps to control your weight.
examples.zh: 定期参加体育活动有助于控制体重。

words.definition: to put something with something else or with a group of other things; improve, gain, accelerate; enhance, boost, jack, mount, hot; addition
words.translation: 添加，附加，掺加；[数]加；增加；加起来；做加法；增加，添加；补充说；计算…总和；加法，加法运算

examples.en: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
examples.zh: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

words.definition: if you address a problem, you start trying to solve it; undertake, pursue, have; speech, lecture, talk
words.translation: 解决；演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；[计]地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧

words.definition: a picture, set of words, or a short film, which is intended to persuade people to buy a product or use a service, or that gives information about a job that is available, an event that is going to happen etc; publicity, bill, propaganda, dissemination, drumbeating
words.translation: 广告；公告；登广告；[经]广告，宣传

examples.en: They put an advertisement in ‘The Morning News’, offering a high salary for the right person.
examples.zh: 他们在《晨报》上刊登了一则启事，出高薪寻找合适的人选。

examples.en: The organizers of the concert had taken out a full page advertisement in ‘The New York Times’.
examples.zh: 音乐会筹办者在《纽约时报》上刊登了整版广告。

examples.en: Only a handful of people answered the advertisement .
examples.zh: 只有寥寥数人对该广告作出了回应。

words.definition: an opinion you give someone about what they should do; suggestion, proposal, information, instance, notice
words.translation: 建议；忠告；劝告；通知

examples.en: You should have followed my advice.
examples.zh: 你真该听我的建议。

words.definition: to tell someone what you think they should do, especially when you know more than they do about something; alarm, message; agree to sb, make suggestions
words.translation: 劝告；建议；通知；劝告，忠告；警告；与…商量

examples.en: She needed someone to advise her.
examples.zh: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

examples.en: ‘Make sure that you keep the documents in a safe place,’ Otley advised him.
examples.zh: “一定要把文件放在安全的地方。”奥特利向他建议道。

words.definition: to have enough money to buy or pay for something; allow, deal, extend, deliver, tender
words.translation: 负担得起；给予，提供；买得起

examples.en: I couldn’t afford the rent on my own.
examples.zh: 我单靠自己付不起房租。

examples.en: How can she afford to eat out every night?
examples.zh: 每天晚上下馆子她怎么能负担得起？

words.definition: frightened because you think that you may get hurt or that something bad may happen; worried, scared
words.translation: 害怕的；担心的；恐怕

examples.en: There’s no need to be afraid.
examples.zh: 没有必要害怕。

words.definition: when a particular event or time has happened, or when someone has done something; since, subsequently; in the back of; succeeding
words.translation: 在…以后；次于；后来，以后；在……之后；以后的

examples.en: After the war many soldiers stayed in France.
examples.zh: 战后，许多士兵留在法国。

examples.en: I go swimming every day after work.
examples.zh: 我每天下班后都去游泳。

examples.en: Do you believe in life after death?
examples.zh: 你相信人死后还有来生吗？

words.definition: the part of the day after the morning and before the evening; post meridian, arvo
words.translation: 下午，午后；午后，下午

examples.en: There’s a meeting on Thursday afternoon .
examples.zh: 星期四下午有个会议。

examples.en: It was very hot in the afternoon .
examples.zh: 下午很热。

examples.en: See you tomorrow afternoon .
examples.zh: 明天下午见。

words.definition: one more time – used when something has happened or been done before; moreover, besides, additionally, then, both
words.translation: 又一次；而且；又，此外；再一次

examples.en: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.
examples.zh: 你能再说一遍吗？ 我没听见。

examples.en: I’ll never go there again.
examples.zh: 我再也不会去那儿了。

examples.en: Mr Khan’s busy. Can you try again later?
examples.zh: 卡恩先生正忙着。 你能不能过一会儿再打来？

words.definition: next to and touching an upright surface, especially for support; in opposition to, in contravention of; adverse, contrary, opposite, disadvantageous
words.translation: 倚在；逆，对着；反对，违反；靠；倚；防备；不利的；对立的

examples.en: There was a ladder propped up against the wall.
examples.zh: 有一把梯子靠在墙边。

examples.en: The younger policeman was leaning against the bureau with his arms folded.
examples.zh: 那位较年轻的警官两臂交叉，倚靠在办公桌旁。

words.definition: the number of years someone has lived or something has existed; to start looking older or to make someone or something look older; era, time, stage, phase, grade; mature, flower; grey, ripen
words.translation: 年龄；时代；变老；寿命，使用年限；阶段；成熟；使成熟；使变老，使上年纪

examples.en: Francis is the same age as me.
examples.zh: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

examples.en: Experts disagree over the age of the drawings.
examples.zh: 专家对这些画作的年代意见不统一。

examples.en: Dad retired at the age of 56.
examples.zh: 爸爸是在56岁时退休的。

words.definition: used to show how far back in the past something happened; previously, formerly, back; previous, past, back
words.translation: 以前；以前，以往；以前的；过去的

examples.en: They moved to a new house some time ago (=  a fairly long time ago  ) .
examples.zh: 他们搬进新居已有些日子了。

examples.en: We had our bicentenary celebrations not that long ago.
examples.zh: 不久前，我们举行了200周年庆典活动。

words.definition: to have or express the same opinion about something as someone else; undertake, accept, recognize, side, grant; accept, grant
words.translation: 同意；持相同意见；赞成；承认；意见一致

examples.en: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
examples.zh: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

words.definition: an arrangement or promise to do something, made by two or more people, companies, organizations etc; accordance, protocol, unity, identity, keeping
words.translation: 协定，协议；同意；[法]协议；同意，一致

examples.en: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
examples.zh: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

words.definition: the mixture of gases around the Earth, that we breathe; atmosphere, heaven, sky, high, look; sport, ventilate
words.translation: 空气；空中；外观；[气象]空气，[地物]大气；天空；样子；曲调；使通风，晾干；夸耀

examples.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
examples.zh: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

examples.en: You need to put some air in the tyres.
examples.zh: 你得给轮胎充气了。

words.definition: a company that takes passengers and goods to different places by plane; vector, lane, airways
words.translation: 航空公司；航线；[航]航线

examples.en: an airline pilot
examples.zh: 航空公司飞行员

words.definition: a vehicle that flies through the air and has one or more engines; plane, aeroplane
words.translation: 飞机；[航]飞机

examples.en: The airplane cracked up in landing.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在着陆时坠毁。

examples.en: The new airplane flies at twice the speed of sound.
examples.zh: 这架新式飞机以两倍于音速的速度飞行。

examples.en: We beamed the airplane down safely.
examples.zh: 我们给飞机导航使它安全降落。

words.definition: a place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in; landing field, aeroport
words.translation: 机场，航空站；[航]机场；航空站

examples.en: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
examples.zh: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

examples.en: Her family went to see her off at the airport.
examples.zh: 她的家人去机场送她。

words.definition: still living and not dead; lively, activated
words.translation: 活着的；活跃的；活泼的；有生气的

examples.en: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.
examples.zh: 这是一宗严重事故——他们能活着实属幸运。

examples.en: My grandparents are still alive .
examples.zh: 我的祖父母和外祖父母都还健在。

examples.en: We stayed alive by eating berries.
examples.zh: 我们靠吃浆果活命。

words.definition: entire, overall, total; utterly, sheerly; full, entirety, allness
words.translation: 全部的；全部；全然地；越发

words.definition: to let someone do or have something, or let something happen; afford, let, have, deal, extend; think of, think about
words.translation: 允许，准许；任；允许；给予；认可；容许；考虑

examples.en: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
examples.zh: 泳池内禁止跳水。

words.definition: nearly, but not completely or not quite; nearly, most, virtually, practically, feckly
words.translation: 几乎，差不多；差不多，几乎

examples.en: Have you almost finished?
examples.zh: 你差不多完成了吗？

examples.en: Supper’s almost ready.
examples.zh: 晚饭就要做好了。

examples.en: It was almost midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜将至。

words.definition: if you are alone in a place, there is no one with you; Alone is also an adverb; independent, isolated, separate, sole; respectively, solely
words.translation: 单独的；单独地；独自的；孤独的；独自地

examples.en: She lives alone .
examples.zh: 她一个人生活。

examples.en: You shouldn’t leave a child alone in the house.
examples.zh: 你不应该把小孩独自留在家里。

examples.en: My wife and I like to spend time alone together away from the kids.
examples.zh: 我和妻子喜欢没有孩子打扰，过二人世界。

words.definition: from one place on something such as a line, road, or edge towards the other end of it; going forward; forth, together, to, ahead, front; down
words.translation: 沿着；向前；一起；来到；顺着

examples.en: We were driving along Follyfoot Road.
examples.zh: 我们沿着福莱福特路行驶。

examples.en: She glanced anxiously along the line of faces.
examples.zh: 她焦急地扫视着这一排面孔。

examples.en: He slid his hand along her arm.
examples.zh: 他的手顺着她的臂膀滑下。

words.definition: if you read, laugh, say something etc aloud, you read etc so that people can hear you; out, loudly
words.translation: 出声地，大声地；大声地；出声地

examples.en: When we were children, our father read aloud to us.
examples.zh: 当我们是孩子时，我们的父亲大声地朗读给我们听。

words.definition: before now, or before a particular time; yet
words.translation: 早已，已经；已经，早已；先前

examples.en: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
examples.zh: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

examples.en: The performance had already started when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到达时表演已经开始了。

words.definition: in addition to something else that you have mentioned; moreover, too, besides, either, likewise
words.translation: 亦，也；而且，还；也；而且；同样

examples.en: Information is also available on women’s health care.
examples.zh: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

examples.en: She sings beautifully and also plays the flute and piano.
examples.zh: 她歌唱得好，而且还会吹长笛和弹钢琴。

examples.en: The system was not only complicated but also ineffective.
examples.zh: 这套系统不仅复杂而且效率低。

words.definition: used to introduce a statement that makes your main statement seem surprising or unlikely; while, though, as, albeit
words.translation: 尽管，虽然；虽然，尽管

examples.en: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
examples.zh: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

examples.en: We decided to take rooms in Longwood House, although we knew we could not really afford the rent.
examples.zh: 虽然我们知道自己其实付不起租金，但还是决定住朗伍德庄园的房间。

examples.en: Although I can’t help admiring the man’s courage, I do not approve of his methods.
examples.zh: 尽管我不得不佩服那个男子的勇气，却并不赞成他的方法。

words.definition: all the time, at all times, or every time; forever and ever, immer
words.translation: 总是，一直；永远；永远，一直；总是；常常

examples.en: Always lock your bicycle to something secure.
examples.zh: 每次都要把自行车锁在牢固的物体上。

examples.en: She’d always assumed that Gabriel was a girl’s name.
examples.zh: 她一直认为加布里埃尔是个女孩名字。

examples.en: He hadn’t always been a butler.
examples.zh: 他并不是一直当管家。

words.definition: United States, U.S.A
words.translation: 美洲；美国；美洲（包括北美和南美洲）

examples.en: I may go to America or I may not,it all depends.
examples.zh: 我也许去美国，也许不去，要视情况而定。

examples.en: She scampered in London then went back to America.
examples.zh: 她在伦敦匆忙地游览了一番，然后回到了美国。

examples.en: Some of the mountains in America have not yet been mapped out.
examples.zh: 美洲有些山脉还没有在地图上标出来。

words.definition: relating to the US or its people; someone from the US
words.translation: 美洲的；美国人

examples.en: Her mother is American.
examples.zh: 她妈妈是美国人。

examples.en: a famous American writer
examples.zh: 一位著名的美国作家

words.definition: in or through the middle of a group of people or things; in the middle of, in the midst of
words.translation: 在…之中；在…中间

examples.en: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
examples.zh: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

examples.en: I could hear voices coming from somewhere among the bushes.
examples.zh: 我能听到灌木丛中某个地方传来说话的声音。

examples.en: We walked among the chestnut woods on the mountain slopes.
examples.zh: 我们走在山坡上的栗树林中。

words.definition: belonging to a time long ago in history, especially thousands of years ago; old, aged, advanced; elder, old folk
words.translation: 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的；古代人；老人

examples.en: the ancient civilizations of Asia
examples.zh: 亚洲的古代文明

words.definition: used to join two words, phrases etc referring to things that are related in some way; granted, et, but, yet, only
words.translation: 和，又，并，则；和，与；就；而且；但是；然后

examples.en: He’s gone to get some fish and chips.
examples.zh: 他去买炸鱼薯条了。

examples.en: The film starred Jack Lemmon and Shirley Maclaine.
examples.zh: 这部电影由杰克·莱蒙和雪莉·麦克莱恩主演。

examples.en: We’ve dealt with items one, two, and eleven.
examples.zh: 我们已经处理了第一项、第二项和第十一项。

words.definition: feeling strong emotions which make you want to shout at someone or hurt them because they have behaved in an unfair, cruel, offensive etc way, or because you think that a situation is unfair, unacceptable etc; riley, vexed
words.translation: 愤怒的，生气的；生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的

examples.en: I was angry because he hadn’t told me his plans.
examples.zh: 我很生气，因为他没有告诉我他的计划。

examples.en: He was beginning to get angry .
examples.zh: 他开始发脾气了。

examples.en: His comments brought an angry response from opposition politicians.
examples.zh: 他的话激起反对派政客愤怒的回应。

words.definition: a living creature such as a dog or cat, that is not an insect, plant, bird, fish, or person; human feelings, desires etc that are connected with sex, food, and other basic needs; creature, zoon
words.translation: 动物，兽；动物的；[动]动物

examples.en: furry little animals
examples.zh: 毛茸茸的小动物

examples.en: The cosmetics have not been tested on animals.
examples.zh: 这些化妆品没有进行过动物试验。

examples.en: Beth is an animal lover (=  someone who likes animals  ) .
examples.zh: 贝丝是个喜欢动物的人。

words.definition: different, diverse, other, unlike, varying
words.translation: 再一个的；别的；又一，另一；另外的；不同的

examples.en: Can you cite another case like this one?
examples.zh: 你能举出另一个像这样的例子吗?

words.definition: to say something to someone as a reply when they have asked you a question, made a suggestion etc; reply, meet with; reply, accord; response, defence, reply, result
words.translation: 回答；响应；适应；符合；答案；[法]答辩

examples.en: She thought for a moment before answering.
examples.zh: 她想了一会儿才回答。

examples.en: He still hadn’t answered my question .
examples.zh: 他仍然没有回答我的问题。

examples.en: ‘Why don’t you just leave?’ ‘I’d like to,’ she answered, ‘but I have nowhere else to go.’
examples.zh: “你为什么不一走了之？”“我倒是想走，”她回答说，“但是我没有其他地方可去。”

words.definition: a small insect that lives in large groups; emmet, pismire
words.translation: 蚂蚁

examples.en: Ants swarmed up out of the ground and covered her shoes and legs.
examples.zh: 蚂蚁从地里成群地爬出来，爬满了她的鞋和腿。

words.definition: having, possessory; somewhat, in some sort
words.translation: 什么，一些；任何的；所有的；丝毫；稍微；少许

examples.en: We could not reason out which way the robbers escaped, because we were unable to find any trace of them.
examples.zh: 我们推断不出这些强盗是从哪个方向逃走的，因为我们找不到他们的任何踪迹。

words.definition: used to refer to any person, when it is not important to say exactly who
words.translation: 任何人

examples.en: Anyone could win tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚任何人都可能赢。

examples.en: They offer help and advice to anyone interested in becoming a teacher.
examples.zh: 他们为任何有兴趣当老师的人提供帮助和咨询。

examples.en: If anyone sees Lisa, ask her to call me.
examples.zh: 如果有谁看见莉萨，叫她打电话给我。

words.definition: any thing, event, situation etc, when it is not important to say exactly which
words.translation: 任何事物；一切

examples.en: You can buy anything you want.
examples.zh: 你想要什么都可以买。

examples.en: He was prepared to do anything to make a bit of money.
examples.zh: 只要能赚一点钱，他什么都愿意做。

examples.en: Anything would be better than staying at home!
examples.zh: 做什么都比待在家里好！

words.definition: however, anyhow
words.translation: 无论如何；无论如何，不管怎样；总之

words.definition: You use anywhere in statements with negative meaning to indicate that a place does not exist; whithersoever; nowhere
words.translation: 在什么地方；在任何地方；无论何处；任何地方

examples.en: I haven't got anywhere to live.
examples.zh: 我没有任何地方住。

words.definition: used to say how something seems, especially from what you know about it or from what you can see; occur, figure, offer, come out
words.translation: 出现；来到；似乎；显得；出庭

examples.en: Police have found what appear to be human remains.
examples.zh: 警方发现了疑似人体遗骸的东西。

examples.en: He tried to make it appear that she had committed suicide.
examples.zh: 他试图制造她自杀的假象。

examples.en: It may be less useful than it appears at first.
examples.zh: 这可能没有一开始显得那么有用。

words.definition: a hard round fruit that has red, light green, or yellow skin and is white inside; customer, fellow, egg, guy, bird
words.translation: 苹果，苹果树；[园艺]苹果；家伙

examples.en: apple pie
examples.zh: 苹果馅饼

examples.en: an apple tree
examples.zh: 苹果树

examples.en: roast pork and apple sauce (=  a thick sauce made from cooked apples  )
examples.zh: 烤猪肉配苹果酱汁

words.definition: the fourth month of the year, between March and May
words.translation: 四月

examples.en: The changes will be introduced in April.
examples.zh: 这些变更将于4月实施。

words.definition: a particular part of a country, town etc; district, region, extent, boundary, spectrum, territory
words.translation: 面积；地区；领域；区域，[地理]地区；范围

examples.en: Only cheeses made in this area may be labelled ‘Roquefort.’
examples.zh: 只有这个地区出产的干酪才能被称作“罗克福尔干酪”。

examples.en: Crime rates are much higher in urban areas.
examples.zh: 城镇地区的犯罪率要高很多。

words.definition: one of the two long parts of your body between your shoulders and your hands; weapon, equipment, setup; war preparation
words.translation: 臂；臂状物；武器；手臂；袖子；[军]装备；武装；备战

examples.en: Dave has a broken arm .
examples.zh: 戴夫手臂断了。

examples.en: Tim’s mother put her arms around him.
examples.zh: 蒂姆的母亲伸出双臂搂着他。

examples.en: Pat was carrying a box under his arm .
examples.zh: 帕特腋下挟着一个盒子。

words.definition: the part of a country’s military force that is trained to fight on land in a war; battalion, heer
words.translation: 军队；陆军；陆军，[军]军队

examples.en: The army are helping to clear up after the floods.
examples.zh: 陆军部队正协助洪灾后的清理工作。

examples.en: an army officer
examples.zh: 陆军军官

examples.en: Army units launched attacks on bases near Jounieh port.
examples.zh: 陆军部队对朱尼耶港附近的基地发动了进攻。

words.definition: approximately, everywhere, throughout, something; round
words.translation: 在…周围；大约；到处；在附近；四处

examples.en: What an inspiration she was to all around her!
examples.zh: 她对于她周围所有的人是一种多么大的鼓舞!

examples.en: All those around him looked at him with amazement.
examples.zh: 周围的人都对他投射出惊异的眼光。

words.definition: to get to the place you are going to; land, win, make good
words.translation: 到达；来临；达到；成功；达成；出生

examples.en: Give me a call to let me know you’ve arrived safely.
examples.zh: 打个电话给我，告诉我你已平安到达。

examples.en: By the time the police arrived on the scene, the burglars had fled.
examples.zh: 警方赶到现场时，窃贼已经逃跑了。

words.definition: the use of painting, drawing,  sculpture  etc to represent things or express ideas; beaux-arts, artwork; artistic; are, am
words.translation: 艺术，美术；技术；艺术；美术；艺术品；艺术的；艺术品的；是（be的变体）

examples.en: the Museum of Modern Art in New York
examples.zh: 纽约现代艺术博物馆

examples.en: an example of early Indian art
examples.zh: 印度早期艺术的范例

words.definition: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine; item, provision, clause
words.translation: 文章；条款；物品；[法]条款；[语]冠词

examples.en: The paper’s leading article (=  the main article  ) described the government as weak.
examples.zh: 该报社论称政府软弱。

examples.en: newspaper articles
examples.zh: 报纸上的文章

words.definition: while or when; because, although, since, for, seeing; in the light of, like; equally, similarly, same, likewise
words.translation: 当…的时候；因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时；如同；当作；以…的身份；同样地；和…一样的

examples.en: I saw Peter as I was getting off the bus.
examples.zh: 我下公共汽车的时候看见了彼得。

examples.en: As time passed, things seemed to get worse.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，情况似乎变得更加糟糕了。

examples.en: Just as the two men were leaving, a message arrived.
examples.zh: 那两个男子刚要离开，消息就传来了。

words.translation: 亚洲

examples.en: The European powers extended their authority in Asia.
examples.zh: 欧洲列强在亚洲扩大他们的管辖权。

examples.en: The teacher chalked out a map of Asia on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老师用粉笔在黑板上画了一张亚洲地图。

examples.en: His extensive experience in other parts of Asia helped him to overcome cultural barriers.
examples.zh: 在亚洲其他地区的广泛经历帮助他克服了文化障碍。

words.definition: from or relating to Asia, especially India or Pakistan; someone from Asia, or whose family originally came from Asia, especially India or Pakistan
words.translation: 亚洲的；亚洲人

examples.en: The financial crisis devitalized the economy of the Asian countries.
examples.zh: 这次金融危机使亚洲国家的经济大伤元气。

examples.en: The government predicates that the market collapse was caused by Asian financial crisis.
examples.zh: 政府宣布市场不景气是由于亚洲金融危机而引起的。

words.definition: to speak or write to someone in order to get an answer, information, or a solution; invite, lack, question, desire, exact; question, query
words.translation: 问；要求；邀请；问，询问；需要；讨价

examples.en: ‘What’s your name?’ she asked.
examples.zh: “你叫什么名字？”她问道 。

examples.en: Don’t ask him – he won’t know.
examples.zh: 别问他，他不知道。

examples.en: That kid’s always asking awkward questions .
examples.zh: 那孩子总是问一些尴尬的问题。

words.definition: sleeping; sleeping, stupid
words.translation: 睡着的，睡熟的；睡着的；麻木的；长眠的

examples.en: Quiet! The baby’s asleep.
examples.zh: 安静！ 宝宝在睡觉。

words.definition: used to say exactly where something or someone is, or where something happens; be, towards, unto, out
words.translation: 在…里；在…时；在（表示存在或出现的地点、场所、位置、空间）；以（某种价格、速度等）；向；因为；朝；忙于

examples.en: They live at 18 Victoria Street.
examples.zh: 他们住在维多利亚街18 号。

examples.en: Does this train stop at Preston?
examples.zh: 这列火车在普雷斯顿停吗？

examples.en: I was waiting at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 我在公共汽车站等着。

words.translation: 大西洋的；大西洋

examples.en: They underlaid the Atlantic with a cable.
examples.zh: 他们在大西洋海底铺设了一条电缆。

examples.en: The Straits of Gibraltar are the strategic passage between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
examples.zh: 直布罗陀海峡是地中海通向大西洋的咽喉。

words.definition: when you carefully listen to, look at, or think about someone or something; consideration, thought
words.translation: 注意，留心；注意力；关心；立正！（口令）

examples.en: My attention wasn’t really on the game.
examples.zh: 我的注意力其实不在比赛上。

examples.en: She tried to pay attention to what he was saying.
examples.zh: 她尽量注意听他说话。

examples.en: If you paid more attention in class, you might actually learn something!
examples.zh: 要是你上课更认真些，也许能实实在在地学到些东西！

words.definition: the eighth month of the year, between July and September; imperial, formidable
words.translation: 八月；威严的；令人敬畏的

examples.en: The world premiere took place in August 1956.
examples.zh: 全球首映是在1956年8月。

words.definition: the sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your father’s or mother’s brother
words.translation: 伯母，婶母，姑母

examples.en: Aunt Mary
examples.zh: 玛丽姑妈

words.translation: 澳大利亚

examples.en: He transplanted his family to Australia.
examples.zh: 他把家迁到澳大利亚。

examples.en: He went out to Australia about five years ago.
examples.zh: 他大约在五年前移居澳大利亚。

examples.en: Australia won the toss and put England in to bat.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚队掷币获胜，要求英格兰队首先击球。

words.definition: relating to Australia or its people
words.translation: 澳大利亚的

examples.en: She went solo backpacking for eight months in the Australian outback.
examples.zh: 她在澳大利亚内陆独自背包旅行了八个月。

words.definition: the season between summer and winter, when leaves change colour and the weather becomes cooler; fall, maturation phase; fall
words.translation: 秋，秋季；秋天；成熟期；渐衰期，凋落期；秋天的，[天]秋季的

examples.en: autumn mists
examples.zh: 秋天的雾霭

words.definition: something that is available is able to be used or can easily be bought or found; valid, effective, virtual, telling, significant
words.translation: 可利用的，现有的；可获得的；[交]有效的，可得的；可利用的；空闲的

examples.en: Tickets are available from the box office.
examples.zh: 售票处有票出售。

examples.en: Meetings were held to update employees as soon as new information became available .
examples.zh: 一有新的信息就开会告诉员工。

examples.en: Further building can continue when money is made available .
examples.zh: 有了资金就可以继续进一步的施工。

words.definition: to prevent something bad from happening; eliminate, escape, shun
words.translation: 避免；避开，躲避；消除

examples.en: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
examples.zh: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

examples.en: It is important to take measures to avoid the risk of fire.
examples.zh: 采取措施避免火灾风险很重要。

examples.en: Alan narrowly avoided an accident.
examples.zh: 艾伦险出事故。

words.definition: used to say that someone leaves a place or person, or stays some distance from a place or person; aside, beyond
words.translation: 离开，远离；…去；离去，离开；在远处

examples.en: Go away!
examples.zh: 走开！

examples.en: Dinah was crying as she drove slowly away.
examples.zh: 黛娜一边哭一边慢慢地开车走了。

words.definition: a very young child who has not yet learned to speak or walk; infant, babe; pamper, indulge; small, chicken, infant
words.translation: 婴儿；孩子气的人；婴儿，婴孩；纵容，娇纵；把……当婴儿般对待；婴儿的；幼小的

examples.en: The baby is crying.
examples.zh: 宝宝在哭。

examples.en: She gave birth to a baby on Thursday.
examples.zh: 她于星期四产下一名婴儿。

examples.en: What do you think of your new baby sister?
examples.zh: 你觉得你刚出生的妹妹怎么样？

words.definition: in, into, or to the place or position where someone or something was before; rear, dorsum; encourage, second, carry, hand, champion; reverse, recede; previously, ago, formerly; latter, past, ago, rear
words.translation: 在后；回原处；回；[机]后面；背部；[家具]靠背；足球等的后卫；书报等的末尾；支持；后退；背书；下赌注；背靠；倒退；以前；向后地；来回地；上溯；[机]后面的；过去的；拖欠的

examples.en: I’ll be back in a minute.
examples.zh: 我马上回来。

examples.en: Put that book back where you found it!
examples.zh: 把那本书放回原处！

examples.en: He was back home by half past eleven.
examples.zh: 他是11点半之前回家的。

words.definition: someone’s family, education, previous work etc; prehistory
words.translation: 背景；[物]背景；隐蔽的位置

examples.en: Students with a background in chemistry will probably find the course easier.
examples.zh: 学过化学的学生可能会觉得这门课程容易些。

examples.en: It’s important to understand other people, people from different backgrounds .
examples.zh: 要理解别人，理解那些来自不同背景的人，这是很重要的。

examples.en: Do you know anything about his background?
examples.zh: 关于他的背景，你知道什么吗？

words.definition: the amount that a bag will hold; killing, wallet; occupy
words.translation: 袋，包，钱包，背包；袋；钱包，旅行袋；袋状物；猎获物；占据，私吞；猎获；把…装入袋中；使膨大

examples.en: She left the hotel carrying a shopping bag.
examples.zh: 她拎着一个购物袋离开了宾馆。

words.definition: a round object that is thrown, kicked, or hit in a game or sport; dance, globus
words.translation: 球，球状物；舞会；球

examples.en: a ball of string
examples.zh: 线团

words.definition: an object made of brightly coloured thin rubber, that is filled with air and used as a toy or decoration for parties; surge, sharp rise; proliferate
words.translation: 气球，玩具气球；激增；膨胀如气球；使像气球般鼓起；使激增

examples.en: Can you help me blow up these balloons?
examples.zh: 你帮我把这些气球吹起来好吗？

examples.en: He burst the balloon in my face.
examples.zh: 他对着我的脸弄爆了气球。

words.definition: a tall tropical plant with hollow stems that is used for making furniture; Abo
words.translation: 竹；竹杆，竹棍；竹制的；土著居民的

examples.en: ...huts with walls of bamboo.
examples.zh: …竹墙小屋。

words.definition: a long curved tropical fruit with a yellow skin; pisang, comedian
words.translation: 香蕉；芭蕉属植物；[园艺]香蕉；喜剧演员；大鹰钩鼻

examples.en: ...a bunch of bananas.
examples.zh: …一串香蕉。

words.definition: land along the side of a river or lake; shallow, ford; pile, heap up
words.translation: 银行；库；岩，堤；[金融]银行；岸；[地理]浅滩；储库；堆积；倾斜转弯

examples.en: the river bank
examples.zh: 河岸

words.definition: forming the most important or most necessary part of something; elementary, fundamental, essential, primary, first; foundation, element, base, bed, factor
words.translation: 基本的，基础的；[岩]基本的；基础的；基础；要素

examples.en: the basic principles of chemistry
examples.zh: 化学的基本原理

examples.en: The basic idea is simple.
examples.zh: 基本思想很简单。

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["basic research"]}
examples.zh: 基础研究

words.definition: a container made of thin pieces of plastic, wire, or wood woven together, used to carry things or put things in
words.translation: 篮，篓，筐

examples.en: a shopping basket
examples.zh: 购物篮

examples.en: a basket full of vegetables
examples.zh: 装满蔬菜的篮子

words.definition: a game played indoors between two teams of five players, in which each team tries to win points by throwing a ball through a net
words.translation: 篮球；篮球运动

words.definition: a room where there is a bath or  shower  , a  basin  , and sometimes a toilet; john, convenience, toilet
words.translation: 浴室；盥洗室；厕所

words.definition: used with a present participle to form the  continuous 4  tenses of verbs; at
words.translation: v&vi是，在，做；在，存在；是

examples.en: Don’t disturb me while I’m working.
examples.zh: 我工作的时候不要打扰我。

examples.en: Gemma was reading.
examples.zh: 吉玛正在看书。

examples.en: They’ve been asking a lot of questions.
examples.zh: 他们已经问了许多问题。

words.definition: an area of sand or small stones at the edge of the sea or a lake; seabeach, foreshore; take the ground, make one's pitch
words.translation: 海滩，湖滩，河滩；[海洋]海滩；湖滨；搁浅；定居

examples.en: a sandy beach
examples.zh: 沙滩

examples.en: surfers on the beach
examples.zh: 沙滩上的冲浪者

words.definition: a large strong animal with thick fur, that eats flesh, fruit, and insects; fruit; support, stomach, go, stand, abide; Bruin
words.translation: 熊；粗鲁的人；承受；结果实；忍受；具有；支撑；[脊椎]熊

examples.en: a mother bear and her cubs
examples.zh: 母熊和它的熊崽们

words.definition: someone or something that is beautiful is extremely attractive to look at; fair, seraphic
words.translation: 美的，美丽的；美丽的

examples.en: She was even more beautiful than I had remembered.
examples.zh: 她比我记忆中更美。

examples.en: a beautiful bunch of flowers
examples.zh: 一束美丽的花

words.definition: used when you are giving the reason for something; since, for, seeing, that
words.translation: 由于，因为；因为

examples.en: We didn’t enjoy the day because the weather was so awful.
examples.zh: 那天我们很不尽兴，因为天气实在太糟。

examples.en: ‘Why can’t I go?’ ‘Because you’re not old enough.’
examples.zh: “我为什么不能去？”“因为你年纪太小。”

examples.en: Hubert never experienced any fear, and this was partly because he was not particularly intelligent.
examples.zh: 休伯特从来都没有害怕的感觉，部分原因是他这人不大聪明。

words.definition: a piece of furniture that you sleep on; elements, basis, foundation, base, sole; establish, put, station, plant, rear; spin in
words.translation: 床，床位；圃；河床；[家具]床；基础；河底， 海底；使睡觉；安置，嵌入；栽种；上床；分层

examples.en: You should go to bed early.
examples.zh: 你应该早点上床。

examples.en: She got into bed and turned out the light.
examples.zh: 她上了床，关掉灯。

words.definition: a room for sleeping in; sleeping room, bedchamber
words.translation: 卧室；[建]卧室

examples.en: a hotel with 50 bedrooms
examples.zh: 有50间客房的旅馆

words.definition: a black and yellow flying insect that makes  honey  and can sting you; honeybee
words.translation: 蜂，密蜂；忙碌的人；[蜂]蜜蜂，蜂；勤劳的人

examples.en: a swarm of bees

examples.zh: 他用蜡笔给画上色。

examples.zh: 他们寄信，有一次甚至是蜡笔写的，详细的描述了他们的权利和我如何违反了某些1700年代的海上条约。

examples.zh: 警察叫她描述一下那名男子。

examples.zh: 这个问题的另一种解决方法在第三章有所阐述。

examples.en: Inge kept a diary (= wrote in a diary ) during the war years.
examples.zh: 英奇在战争年代里一直写日记。

words.definition: a book that gives a list of words in alphabetical order and explains their meanings in the same language, or another language; lexicon, wordbook
words.translation: 词典，字典；字典；[语][计]词典

examples.en: a German-English dictionary
examples.zh: 一本德英词典

words.definition: to stop living and become dead; go out, angel of death; join the majority, end one's days; former block, cutting block
words.translation: 死，死亡；灭亡；死亡；凋零；熄灭；死，死于…；[机]冲模，钢模；骰子

examples.en: He died in 1985 at the age of 76.
examples.zh: 他1985年去世，终年76岁。

examples.en: Her father died suddenly in an accident when she was only ten.
examples.zh: 她年仅10岁时父亲突然死于一场意外事故。

examples.en: She died peacefully in her sleep at the age of 98.
examples.zh: 她在睡眠中安然辞世，享年98岁。

words.definition: a way in which two or more people or things are not like each other; diversity, conflict, disparity, deviations
words.translation: 差别；差；分歧；差异；不同；争执

examples.en: (= there’s a very big difference ) between us.
examples.zh: 我们之间有着天壤之别。

words.definition: not like something or someone else, or not like before; diverse, unlike, unusual, individual, varying
words.translation: 差异的；各种的；不同的；个别的，与众不同的

examples.en: The place looks completely different now.
examples.zh: 这地方现在完全变了。

examples.en: They decided to try a radically different approach.
examples.zh: 他们决定尝试一种全然不同的办法。

examples.en: We found women had significantly different political views from men.
examples.zh: 我们发现女性的政治观点与男性大不相同。

words.definition: hard to do, understand, or deal with; hard, tough
words.translation: 困难的；难对付的；不随和的；执拗的

examples.en: a difficult question
examples.zh: 难解的问题

examples.en: an immensely difficult task
examples.zh: 极为艰巨的任务

examples.en: Was the exam very difficult?
examples.zh: 这次考试很难吗？

words.definition: poverty, corner, hardness, dilemma, fix
words.translation: 困难；难事；困境；困难，困境

words.definition: the main meal of the day, eaten in the middle of the day or the evening; supper, evening meal
words.translation: 正餐，主餐；宴会；晚餐，晚宴；正餐

examples.en: What time do you usually have dinner?
examples.zh: 你通常什么时候吃饭？

examples.en: We’re having fish for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我们今天晚饭吃鱼。

examples.en: What’s for dinner?
examples.zh: 晚饭吃什么？

words.definition: done without any other people, actions, processes etc coming between; immediate, right; manage, conduct, run, officer, control; supervise, to command; immediately, straight, just, fair
words.translation: 直接的；直率的；直系的；亲身的；恰好的；管理；指挥；导演；指向；指导；直接地；正好；按直系关系

examples.en: Experienced users have direct access to the main data files.
examples.zh: 高级用户可直接浏览主数据文档。

examples.en: I’m not in direct contact with them.
examples.zh: 我和他们没有直接的联系。

examples.en: Few policy-makers have had direct experience of business.
examples.zh: 决策者几乎都没有直接的从商经历。

words.definition: covered in or marked by an unwanted substance; poor, mean, blue, base, gross; soil; soil, mud, spot
words.translation: 脏的；下流的；下流的，卑鄙的；污秽的；恶劣的；暗淡的；变脏；弄脏

examples.en: a stack of dirty dishes in the sink
examples.zh: 洗涤槽里的一堆脏碟子

examples.en: How did you get so dirty?
examples.zh: 你怎么会弄得这么脏？

words.definition: to find someone or something, either by accident or because you were looking for them; detect, sniff out; sniff out, to find
words.translation: 发现；发觉

examples.en: The body was discovered in a field.
examples.zh: 尸体是在一块田地里找到的。

examples.en: Forest Service crews often discover campfires that have not been put out completely.
examples.zh: 林务局工作人员常常发现未完全熄灭的营火。

words.definition: a fact or thing that someone finds out about, when it was not known about before; detection, occurrence, find
words.translation: 发现；被发现的事物；发现，发觉

examples.en: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.
examples.zh: 我感到自己有了一个惊人的发现。

words.definition: to talk about something with another person or a group in order to exchange ideas or decide something; debate, reason, argue
words.translation: 讨论，谈论；论述；讨论；论述，辩论

examples.en: Littman refused to discuss the case publicly.
examples.zh: 利特曼拒绝公开讨论此案。

examples.en: If you would like to discuss the matter further, please call me.
examples.zh: 如果你想进一步讨论此事，请打电话给我。

words.definition: when you discuss something; argumentum, counsel
words.translation: 讨论，谈论；论述；讨论，议论

examples.en: class discussions
examples.zh: 课堂讨论

examples.en: the topics suggested for discussion
examples.zh: 建议讨论的话题

examples.en: We have had discussions about her legal situation.
examples.zh: 我们就她的法律状况已进行了讨论。

words.definition: an illness which affects a person, animal, or plant; illness, ill, sickness, complaint; to infect
words.translation: 病，疾病；病害；[医]病，疾病；弊病；传染；使…有病

examples.en: His father died of heart disease.
examples.zh: 他父亲死于心脏病。

examples.en: She contracted the disease while she was abroad on holiday.
examples.zh: 她在国外度假时染上了这种疾病。

words.definition: a flat container with low sides, for serving food from or cooking food in; plate, course; visit, chin music
words.translation: 碟，盘子；菜肴；[轻]碟，盘；一道菜；成碟状；闲谈

examples.en: a serving dish
examples.zh: 上菜用的盘子

examples.en: an ovenproof dish
examples.zh: 耐热盘

words.definition: to remove someone from their job; remove, fire out; disband, break up
words.translation: 不再考虑；解雇；解散；开除；让...离开

examples.en: The government has dismissed criticisms that the country’s health policy is a mess.
examples.zh: 有人认为国家医疗政策一塌糊涂，政府对这种批评持否认态度。

words.definition: to interrupt someone so that they cannot continue what they are doing; let, violate; intrude upon, hinder from
words.translation: 打扰，扰乱；弄乱；打扰；妨碍；使不安；使恼怒

examples.en: Sorry to disturb you, but I have an urgent message.
examples.zh: 对不起打扰一下，我有个紧急消息。

examples.en: The thieves fled when they were disturbed by a neighbour.
examples.zh: 窃贼们被一名邻居惊动后逃跑了。

examples.en: (= a sign you put on a door so that people will not interrupt you ) .
examples.zh: 请勿打扰。

words.definition: if something divides, or if you divide it, it separates into two or more parts; distribute, part; differ, come between; shed, watershed
words.translation: 分开；划分；除；使产生分歧；意见分歧；[地理]分水岭，分水线

examples.en: The Wall used to divide East and West Berlin.
examples.zh: 过去这堵墙把东、西柏林隔开。

words.definition: someone who is trained to treat people who are ill; medical, hakeem; repair, perform maintenance; practice medicine
words.translation: 医生，医师；博士；[医]医生；修理；窜改，伪造；为…治病；授以博士学位；就医；行医

examples.en: She was treated by her local doctor.
examples.zh: 她由她的本区医生治疗。

examples.en: I’d like to make an appointment to see Dr Pugh.
examples.zh: 我想预约看皮尤医生。

words.definition: a common animal with four legs, fur, and a tail. Dogs are kept as pets or trained to guard places, find drugs etc.; insect, chien; shadow, tail after; jack, dogly; extremely, badly, thoroughly, highly, entirely, greatly, completely
words.translation: 狗，犬，犬科动物；狗；丑女人；卑鄙的人；雄兽；坏蛋；跟踪；尾随；狗的；雄的；劣等的；非常；彻底地

examples.en: I could hear a dog barking .
examples.zh: 我听到了狗吠声。

examples.en: He’s taken the dog for a walk .
examples.zh: 他去遛狗了。

examples.en: We used to have a dog when I was young.
examples.zh: 我小时候我们养过狗。

words.definition: a child’s toy that looks like a small person or baby; babydoll, Living Doll
words.translation: 洋娃娃, 玩偶；洋娃娃；玩偶；无头脑的美丽女人

examples.en: a small wooden doll
examples.zh: 一个小木玩偶

words.definition: the standard unit of money in the US, Canada, Australia, and some other countries, divided into 100  cent s  : symbol $; peso
words.translation: 元(货币单位)；美元

examples.en: It cost three dollars.
examples.zh: 它要三美元。

examples.en: a ten-dollar bill
examples.zh: 一张十元钞票

examples.en: You can pay in dollars or euros at the airport.
examples.zh: 在机场你可以使用美元或欧元。

words.definition: the large flat piece of wood, glass etc that you move when you go into or out of a building, room, vehicle etc, or when you open a cupboard; home, exit, gateway, channel, route
words.translation: 门，通道；一家；[建]门；家，户；门口；通道

examples.en: Could you open the door for me?
examples.zh: 请你帮我开门好吗？

examples.en: The door flew open and Ruth stormed in.
examples.zh: 门一下子打开了，露丝气冲冲地跑了进来。

examples.en: Don’t forget to lock the garage door.
examples.zh: 别忘了把车库的门锁上。

words.definition: consisting of two parts that are similar or exactly the same; dual, two-fold; redouble; duplicate; twifold, twofold
words.translation: 两倍的；双的；双重的；加倍，加倍努力；快步走；使加倍；双重地；两倍地；弓身地

examples.en: a double sink
examples.zh: 双水槽

examples.en: a double wardrobe
examples.zh: 双门衣柜

examples.en: the great double doors of the cathedral
examples.zh: 大教堂宏伟的双开大门

words.definition: a feeling of being not sure whether something is true or right; to think that something may not be true or that it is unlikely; challenge, question, query, suspicion; suspect of, be suspicious of
words.translation: 怀疑；疑虑；[法]怀疑；疑问；疑惑；不信；恐怕；拿不准

examples.en: There was still one little nagging doubt at the back of his mind.
examples.zh: 他的心头仍有一丝挥之不去的疑虑。

words.definition: to or towards a lower place or position; below, under; descensive; pubescence, fur; along with; defeat, floor, fell; decline, descend
words.translation: 向下，在下面；向下，下去；在下面；向下的；软毛，[植]绒毛；[地质]开阔的高地；沿着，往下；打倒，击败；下降；下去

examples.en: David bent down to tie his shoelace.
examples.zh: 戴维弯腰系鞋带。

examples.en: Get down off the table.
examples.zh: 从桌子上下来。

examples.en: Tears were streaming down my face.
examples.zh: 我泪流满面。

words.definition: towards or on a lower floor of a building, especially a house; Downstairs means situated on the ground floor of a building or on a lower floor than you are; belowstairs
words.translation: 在楼下；楼下的

examples.en: Rosie ran downstairs to answer the door.
examples.zh: 罗茜跑下楼去开门。

examples.en: Charles was downstairs in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 查尔斯在楼下厨房里。

examples.en: She repainted the downstairs rooms and closed off the second floor.
examples.zh: 她重新粉刷了楼下的房间，并把二楼封上了。

words.definition: twelve
words.translation: 一打，十二个；[计量]十二个，一打

examples.en: a dozen eggs
examples.zh: 一打鸡蛋

examples.en: Chris, Helen, and half a dozen others went on holiday together.
examples.zh: 克里斯、海伦和其他六个人一起去度假了。

examples.en: (= about 12 ) cars were parked near the entrance.
examples.zh: 入口附近停了大约十二辆汽车。

words.definition: part of a piece of furniture, such as a desk, that you pull out and push in and use to keep things in
words.translation: 抽屉

examples.en: She took a file from her desk drawer .
examples.zh: 她从书桌的抽屉里拿出了一个文件夹。

examples.en: The scissors are in the kitchen drawer (= drawer in a piece of kitchen furniture ) .
examples.zh: 剪刀在厨房的抽屉里。

words.definition: clothes for men or women of a particular type or for a particular occasion; apparel, clothe; frock, suit-dress
words.translation: 女服，童装；服装；给…穿衣；[服装]连衣裙；女装

examples.en: a gentleman in evening dress
examples.zh: 穿晚礼服的绅士

examples.en: The play was performed in modern dress (= clothes from the present time ) .
examples.zh: 这出戏里演员是现代装束。

words.definition: someone who drives a car, bus etc; navigator
words.translation: 驾驶员，司机；[车辆]驾驶员；驱动程序；起子；[机]传动器

examples.en: a taxi driver
examples.zh: 出租车司机

examples.en: Do you think you’re a good driver?
examples.zh: 你认为自己是个好司机吗？

words.definition: to fall suddenly onto the ground or into something; kill, closure; decline, determine, finish, pass, go down; suggestion, falling, trace
words.translation: 使落下；降低；滴；使降低；使终止；随口漏出；下降；终止；落下；空投；微量；滴剂

examples.en: Your button has dropped off.
examples.zh: 你的纽扣掉了。

words.definition: a medicine, or a substance for making medicines; medicine, pharmacon; hit the pipe, hop up
words.translation: 药，药物，药材；[药]药；毒品；麻醉药；滞销货；吸毒

examples.en: a drug used in the treatment of cancer
examples.zh: 用于治疗癌症的一种药物

examples.en: (= ordered for people ) by doctors can be extremely hazardous if used in the wrong way.
examples.zh: 医生开的处方药如果使用不当是非常危险的。

examples.en: The big drug companies make huge profits.
examples.zh: 大型制药公司利润丰厚。

words.definition: a musical instrument made of skin stretched over a circular frame, played by hitting it with your hand or a stick; kettle
words.translation: 鼓；鼓状物，圆桶；鼓声

examples.en: a big bass drum
examples.zh: 一面低音大鼓

examples.en: 1,000 people marched, beating drums and carrying flags.
examples.zh: 1,000人打着鼓扛着旗游行。

examples.en: Jones played the drums in an all-girl band.
examples.zh: 琼斯在一个女子乐队里打鼓。

words.definition: without water or liquid inside or on the surface; exsuccous, thirsty; desiccate, exsiccate; dryout
words.translation: 干的，干燥的；[木]干的；口渴的；枯燥无味的；禁酒的；变干；干涸

examples.en: I need to change into some dry clothes .
examples.zh: 我要换上干衣服。

examples.en: Make sure that the surface is clean and dry before you start to paint.
examples.zh: 油漆之前一定先要确保表面清洁干燥。

examples.en: You should store disks in a cool, dry place.
examples.zh: 你应该把磁盘存放在阴凉干燥的地方。

words.definition: a very common water bird with short legs and a wide beak, used for its meat, eggs, and soft feathers; quacker, deary; jank, to dodge; avoid, stay away from
words.translation: 鸭，雌鸭；鸭肉；鸭子；（英）宝贝儿；零分；闪避；没入水中；躲避；猛按…入水

examples.en: roast duck with orange sauce
examples.zh: 烤鸭配橘子酱

words.translation: 饺子，汤团；面团布丁

words.definition: from the beginning to the end of a period of time; in time of
words.translation: 在…期间；在…的时候，在…的期间

examples.en: During the summer she worked as a lifeguard.
examples.zh: 夏天她当过救生员。

examples.en: He slept calmly during the early part of the night.
examples.zh: 他上半夜睡得很安稳。

examples.en: Foxes remain hidden during the day.
examples.zh: 狐狸白天一直躲藏着。

words.definition: something that you have to do because it is morally or legally right; liability, burden, trust, blame
words.translation: 职责；责任；税；[税收]关税；[管理]职务

examples.en: I promise I will do my duty .
examples.zh: 我保证会尽到我的责任。

examples.en: We feel it is our duty to help her.
examples.zh: 我们感到帮助她是我们的责任。

examples.en: Local authorities have a duty to keep the streets clean.
examples.zh: 地方当局有责任保持街道整洁。

words.definition: respective, several; apiece
words.translation: 各，各自；各；每；各自的；每个；各自

examples.en: They reviewed each aspect of the plan bit by bit.
examples.zh: 他们对计划的各个方面逐一地进行了审核。

words.definition: one of the organs on either side of your head that you hear with; listen, auditory sensation; hear
words.translation: 耳朵；听力，听觉；穗；听觉；倾听；（美俚）听见；抽穗

examples.en: She tucked her hair behind her ears.
examples.zh: 她把头发拢到耳朵背后。

words.definition: before the usual, arranged, or expected time; in the first part of a period of time, event, or process; precocious, inchoate; before one's time
words.translation: 早；早的，早期的；早期的；早熟的；提早；在初期

examples.en: We arrived early.
examples.zh: 我们提早到了。

examples.en: They must have come home early.
examples.zh: 他们肯定提早回到家了。

words.definition: the planet that we live on; land, clay, dirt
words.translation: 地球；陆地，地面；[天]地球；陆地；泥土；尘世；[电]地线

examples.en: the planet Earth
examples.zh: 地球

words.definition: the direction from which the sun rises, and which is on the right if you are facing north; towards the east; orient; oriental
words.translation: 东；东部；在东方；东方；东风；东方国家；东方的；向东的；从东方来的

examples.en: Which way is east?
examples.zh: 哪边是东？

words.definition: not difficult to do, and not needing much effort; pleasant, comfortable, light, easiest; lightly, painlessly
words.translation: 容易的；安逸的；舒适的；不费力地，从容地

examples.en: The test was easy.
examples.zh: 考试很容易。

examples.en: Finishing the task will not be easy.
examples.zh: 完成这项任务并不容易。

examples.en: There must be an easier way to do that.
examples.zh: 一定有更容易的方法去做那件事。

words.definition: the part of an object that is furthest from its centre; margin, superiority, advantage, brink, suburb
words.translation: 边缘，边；刀口；[地质]边缘；优势；刀刃；锋利

examples.en: Put the eggs in the centre of the dish, with the vegetables and herbs around the edge.
examples.zh: 把鸡蛋放在盘子中间，盘边一圈放些蔬菜和香草。

examples.en: He stood at the water’s edge staring across the lake.
examples.zh: 他站在水边，凝视着湖对面。

examples.en: A leaf was on the ground, curling up at the edges.
examples.zh: 地上有一片叶子，叶边卷曲着。

words.definition: the process of teaching and learning, usually at school, college, or university; cultivation, training, pedagogy
words.translation: 教育；训导；教育学；培养

examples.en: She also hopes her children will get a good education.
examples.zh: 她也希望她的孩子可以受到良好的教育。

examples.en: efforts to improve girls’ access to education
examples.zh: 为增加女孩受教育机会所作的努力

words.definition: the physical or mental energy that is needed to do something; achievement, success, pain, struggle, trial
words.translation: 努力；努力的成果；成就

examples.en: Lou lifted the box easily, without using much effort.
examples.zh: 卢没费多大力气就把箱子搬了起来。

examples.en: Frank put a lot of effort into the party.
examples.zh: 弗兰克办这次聚会花了不少精力。

examples.en: Learning to speak another language takes effort.
examples.zh: 学说外语要下功夫。

words.definition: a round object with a hard surface, that contains a baby bird, snake, insect etc and which is produced by a female bird, snake, insect etc; apple, customer, fellow, guy, bird; encourage, fan
words.translation: 蛋，鸡蛋，卵；[禽]蛋；卵子；家伙；煽动；怂恿

examples.en: Blackbirds lay their eggs in March.
examples.zh: 乌鸫在3月产蛋。

examples.en: an ostrich egg
examples.zh: 鸵鸟蛋

examples.en: The eggs hatch (= break open to allow the baby out ) in 26 days.
examples.zh: 这些蛋要26天才能孵化。

words.definition: the number 8; octonary
words.translation: 八，八个，第八；八的

examples.en: It’s only eight days till Christmas.
examples.zh: 还有8天就到圣诞节了。

examples.en: They woke at eight (= eight o’clock ).
examples.zh: 他们是8点钟醒的。

examples.en: My parents died when I was eight (= eight years old ).
examples.zh: 我8岁时父母就去世了。

words.definition: the number 18
words.translation: 十八，十八个

examples.en: At least eighteen bullets were fired.
examples.zh: 至少射出了18颗子弹。

examples.en: Jim was eighteen (= 18 years old ).
examples.zh: 吉姆18岁。

words.definition: one of eight equal parts of something
words.translation: 第八；八分之一

examples.en: Until then, students could leave after the eighth grade, and a lot of them did.
examples.zh: 那时，学生上完八年级就可以辍学，许多学生的确这样做了。

examples.en: Then, in eighth or ninth grade, I studied astronomy, cosmology, and the origins of the universe.
examples.zh: 后来，在八、九年级的时候，我在学习天文学，宇宙学和宇宙的起源。

examples.en: And this whole note obviously can be subdivided into two half notes and each of the half notes into two quarter notes each of these quarter notes into two eighth notes, and so on.
examples.zh: 这个全音符,很明显,可以再分为两个半音符,每个半音符又可以再细分为两个四分之一音符,每个四分之一音符可以再分为两个八分之一音符,等等

words.definition: the number 80; fourscore
words.translation: 八十，八十个；八十；八十岁；八十年代；八十的，八十个的；八十岁的

examples.en: The band was incredibly successful in the eighties.
examples.zh: 这支乐队在80年代红透半边天。

words.definition: or, vel; too, also, ultimately, likewise
words.translation: (两者)任何一个；或者；也（用于否定句或否定词组后）；根本

words.definition: the elder of two people, especially brothers and sisters, is the one who was born first; to be older than someone else; better, ancient; older, senior, advancing
words.translation: 年龄较大的；长者；老人；长辈；年长者；父辈；年长的；资格老的

examples.en: Sarah is the elder of the two.
examples.zh: 两人当中萨拉年纪较长。

words.definition: needing electricity to work, produced by electricity, or used for carrying electricity; dynamoelectric, motor-driven; electrified body
words.translation: 电的，电动的；[电]电的；电动的；发电的；导电的；令人震惊的；电；电气车辆；带电体

examples.en: an electric blanket
examples.zh: 电热毯

words.definition: a very large grey animal with four legs, two tusks(= long curved teeth ) and a trunk(= long nose ) that it can use to pick things up
words.translation: 象

examples.en: A trunk distinguishes the elephant.
examples.zh: 长鼻是象的特征。

examples.en: So the part of the elephant I experience applies what we know about people and how we apply that to UX design.
examples.zh: 所以，我体验的那部分的大象就是我们对人的了解和我们将我们的了解应用于用户体验设计。

examples.en: Tom: No.Although 75% of its raw materials is elephant dung, it is light delicate fragrance instead of stink. This is due to its special fabrication technology.
examples.zh: 不，尽管这种纸里75％的原料都是大象的粪便，但它不但不臭，反而有一种淡淡的清香，这是源于它的特殊的制造工艺。

words.definition: the number
words.translation: 十一，十一个

examples.en: She was sent to jail for eleven months.
examples.zh: 她被判入狱11个月。

examples.en: I never go to bed before eleven (= 11 o’clock ).
examples.zh: 我从不在11点钟以前上床睡觉。

examples.en: James had worked every summer since he was eleven (= 11 years old ).
examples.zh: 詹姆斯自11岁起每年夏天都打工。

words.definition: besides or in addition to someone or something; You use else after words such as "anywhere," "someone," and "what" to refer in a vague way to another person, place, or thing; otherwise, extra; other, tother
words.translation: 其它，另外；别的；其他；否则；另外；其他的

examples.en: There’s something else I’d like to talk about as well.
examples.zh: 我还有其他事情要谈一谈。

examples.en: I’d like you to come, and anyone else who’s free.
examples.zh: 我想请你过来，其他人有空也可以来。

examples.en: He was awake now, as was everyone else.
examples.zh: 他现在已经醒了，其他人也都醒了。

words.definition: having nothing inside; dark, hollow, bare, vacant; dispossess
words.translation: 空的；空洞的；无意义的；无知的；徒劳的；使失去；使…成为空的

examples.en: an empty box
examples.zh: 空盒子

examples.zh: 空瓶子

examples.en: an empty space behind the desk
examples.zh: 书桌后面的空位

words.definition: to give someone the courage or confidence to do something; heart, stimulate, power, hand, second
words.translation: 鼓励；鼓励，怂恿；激励；支持

examples.en: I want to thank everyone who has encouraged and supported me.
examples.zh: 我要感谢每一位鼓励和支持过我的人。

words.definition: the part of a place or object that is furthest from its beginning or centre; to finish what you are doing; completion, death, target, goal, object; drop, determine, pass; conclude, bring to a close
words.translation: 末端；目标；结束；尽头；死亡；结束，终止；终结

examples.en: He wore spectacles perched on the very end of his nose.
examples.zh: 他的眼镜架在鼻尖上。

examples.en: The end of the pencil snapped.
examples.zh: 铅笔的笔尖啪的一声断了。

examples.en: Jo joined the end of the line.
examples.zh: 乔排到了队尾。

words.definition: someone who hates you and wants to harm you; foe, hostes; hostile
words.translation: 敌人；仇敌；敌兵；敌人，仇敌；敌军；敌人的，敌方的

examples.en: She’s a dangerous enemy to have.
examples.zh: 与她为敌很危险。

examples.en: Cats and dogs have always been natural enemies.
examples.zh: 猫和狗向来是天敌。

examples.en: an old enemy of her father
examples.zh: 她父亲的一个宿敌

words.definition: power that is used to provide heat, operate machines etc; vitality, spirit, soul, mind, spring
words.translation: 活力；精力；能；[物]能量；[劳经]活力；精神

examples.en: The water is heated using energy from the sun.
examples.zh: 水是利用太阳能加热的。

examples.en: The problem with nuclear energy is dealing with the waste.
examples.zh: 核能的问题就是要处理核废料。

words.definition: someone whose job is to design or build roads, bridges, machines etc; gineer, sapper; design, style, project, frame, scheme; project, design
words.translation: 工程师，技师；[经管]工程师；工兵；火车司机；设计；策划；精明地处理；建造

examples.en: He trained as a civil engineer (= one who designs and builds roads, bridges etc ).
examples.zh: 他接受过土木工程师培训。

words.translation: 英格兰；英国

words.definition: the language used in Britain, the US, Australia, and some other countries; relating to England or its people; Royal, British; Anglo, British person
words.translation: 英语；英国人的；英文的；英国的；英文；英国人；英格兰人

examples.zh: 你会说英语吗？

examples.en: leaflets written in plain English
examples.zh: 用简单英语写的传单

words.definition: to get pleasure from something; to appreciate, feast
words.translation: 享受；欣赏，喜爱；欣赏，享受；喜爱；使过得快活

examples.en: Sandra enjoys her job in the city.
examples.zh: 桑德拉很喜欢她在城里的这份工作。

examples.en: I enjoyed every minute of it.
examples.zh: 我每一分钟都很享受。

words.definition: Enough is also an adjective; to the degree that is necessary or wanted; adequately, sufficiently; amplitude, ton, plenty of; adequate, plenitudinous
words.translation: 足够的；足够地；足够地，充足地；很多；充足；充足的

examples.en: Her disappearance and death would give proof enough of Charles' guilt.
examples.zh: 她的失踪和死亡将提供足够的证据证明查尔斯有罪。

words.definition: to start to take part in an activity, or become involved in a situation; institute, come into, participate in, go into, get into; participate in, take part in, go through; import, inputting
words.translation: 走进，进入；参加；进入；开始；参加，登场；进去；[计]输入；回车

examples.en: He entered the election as the clear favourite.
examples.zh: 他参加竞选时显然最有希望获胜。

examples.en: The rebels were prepared to enter negotiations (= start discussing something ).
examples.zh: 叛乱分子愿意参加谈判。

words.definition: the air, water, and land on Earth, which is affected by man’s activities; context, circumstance, setting, surrounding, condition
words.translation: 环境，外界；围绕；[环境]环境，外界

examples.en: Some of these chemicals are very damaging to the environment.
examples.zh: 这些化学品中有些对环境非常有害。

examples.en: legislation to protect the environment
examples.zh: 保护环境的法规

examples.en: the effects of acid rain on the environment
examples.zh: 酸雨对环境的影响

words.translation: 橡皮；擦除器；[计] 清除器

words.definition: used to emphasize that something is more important or happens more with one particular thing than with others; peculiarly, notably
words.translation: 特别，尤其，格外；特别；尤其；格外

examples.en: I never liked long walks, especially in winter.
examples.zh: 我向来不喜欢长距离散步，尤其在冬天。

examples.en: Art books are expensive to produce, especially if they contain colour illustrations.
examples.zh: 美术类书籍制作成本很高，尤其是那些带彩色插图的。

words.definition: the continent that is north of the Mediterranean and goes as far east as the Ural Mountains in Russia
words.translation: 欧洲

examples.en: eastern Europe
examples.zh: 东欧

words.definition: relating to Europe or its people; someone from Europe
words.translation: 欧洲的；欧洲人

examples.en: European languages
examples.zh: 欧洲的语言

examples.en: our European partners
examples.zh: 我们的欧洲伙伴

words.definition: used to emphasize something that is unexpected or surprising in what you are saying; flat, equivalent, equal, level; actually, really, too, effectively, yet; equate with; flatten out
words.translation: 甚至；甚至更，还；[数]偶数的；平坦的；相等的；即使；还；实际上；使平坦；使相等；变平；变得可比较；成为相等

examples.en: Most companies have suffered a drop in their profits, even very large companies.
examples.zh: 大多数公司的利润都出现下滑，甚至连很大的公司也不例外。

examples.en: It was quite difficult to see, even with the light on.
examples.zh: 这很难看得见，即使开着灯也没有用。

examples.en: He became quite successful and even appeared on a television show once.
examples.zh: 他相当成功，甚至还上了一次电视节目。

words.definition: the early part of the night between the end of the day and the time you go to bed; night, eve, sunset; bonsoir

examples.en: I do most of my studying in the evening.
examples.zh: 我学习大都在晚上。

examples.en: I’m usually out on Friday evenings.
examples.zh: 周五晚上我通常都不在家。

examples.en: What are you doing tomorrow evening?
examples.zh: 明天晚上你打算做什么？

words.definition: a word meaning at any time; used mostly in questions, negatives, comparisons, or sentences with ‘if’; forever, always, once
words.translation: 在任何时候；曾经；永远；究竟

examples.en: Nothing ever seems to upset him.
examples.zh: 似乎从来没有什么事情会使他烦恼。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris?
examples.zh: 你去过巴黎吗？

examples.en: I don’t think I’ve ever been here before.
examples.zh: 我觉得我以前从未到过这里。

words.definition: Every is also an adjective
words.translation: 每一的；每隔…的

examples.en: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
examples.zh: 他说的每句话都会被细查。

words.definition: everyone
words.translation: 每人，人人

words.definition: ordinary, usual, or happening every day; daily, household, routine; peacetime
words.translation: 每天的，日常的；平时；寻常日子

examples.en: the problems of everyday life
examples.zh: 日常生活中的问题

examples.en: wearing everyday clothes
examples.zh: 穿平常衣服

examples.en: a simple, everyday object
examples.zh: 简单的日常物品

words.definition: every person; each one, everybody (a term of address), Every Body
words.translation: 每人，人人；每个人

examples.en: If everyone is ready, I’ll begin.
examples.zh: 如果大家都准备好了，我就开始。

examples.en: Send my best wishes to everyone in the family.
examples.zh: 请向全家人致以最美好的祝愿。

examples.en: Of course everyone else thought it was hilarious!
examples.zh: 当然其他所有人都觉得好笑极了！

words.definition: each thing or all things
words.translation: 每件事，事事

examples.zh: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

examples.en: I decided to tell her everything.
examples.zh: 我决定把一切都告诉她。

examples.zh: 除了公共汽车晚点之外，其他一切似乎都在按计划进行。

words.definition: in or to every place; around, throughout, about
words.translation: 到处，处处；到处

examples.zh: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

examples.en: He’s travelled everywhere in Europe.
examples.zh: 他走遍了欧洲各地。

examples.en: The south should remain dry, but everywhere else will have heavy rain.
examples.zh: 南部持续干旱，但其他地区会下暴雨。

words.translation: 检查，仔细观察；检查；调查；检测；考试

examples.zh: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

examples.zh: 黑格尔的哲学将在第4章作详细探讨。

words.definition: a specific fact, idea, person, or thing that is used to explain or support a general idea, or to show what is typical of a larger group; mirror, lead, sample; illustrate
words.translation: 例子，实例；模范；例子；榜样；举例

examples.zh: 许多国家，例如墨西哥和日本，经常发生地震。

words.definition: extremely good or of very high quality; remarkable, wonderful, famous, prominent, brilliant
words.translation: 卓越的，杰出的，极好的；卓越的；极好的；杰出的

examples.zh: 极好的建议

examples.en: His car is in excellent condition.
examples.zh: 他的汽车状况极佳。

examples.en: Second-hand computers can be excellent value.
examples.zh: 二手计算机买得好会非常合算。

words.definition: object, sit down on, to oppose; unless, besides, in addition to; but for
words.translation: 除…之外；反对；除了；要不是

examples.en: They were all there except me.
examples.zh: 除了我以外他们都在那里。

examples.en: We all went except him.
examples.zh: 除他以外， 我们都去了。

examples.en: They all howled with laughter except me.
examples.zh: 除了我以外，他们全都哈哈大笑起来。

words.definition: to make someone feel happy, interested, or eager; warm, stir up; warm, fire, to agitate
words.translation: 使激动；引起；激起；刺激…，使…兴奋；激动

examples.zh: 他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

words.translation: 原谅；免除；借口；理由；为…申辩；给…免去；作为借口；请求宽恕；表示宽恕

examples.zh: 这次我原谅你，但别再迟到了。

examples.en: Please excuse my bad handwriting.
examples.zh: 请原谅，我的字写得不好。

words.definition: physical activities that you do in order to stay healthy and become stronger; movement, sport, ceremony, campaign, practice; make use of, fashion, occupy, alarm, employ; motion, do sport
words.translation: 锻炼，训练；练习；运动；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼；锻炼；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐

examples.zh: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

examples.en: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
examples.zh: 由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

examples.zh: 他很难击败。我确信这一点，不过我准备好了。

examples.zh: “你是谁？”他低声问道，预计她可能不会回答。

examples.zh: 他没有得到他预想的加薪。

words.definition: costing a lot of money; rich, dear, costly
words.translation: 昂贵的，花钱多的；昂贵的；花钱的

examples.zh: 城里最贵的餐馆

examples.en: Petrol is becoming more and more expensive.
examples.zh: 汽油越来越贵了。

examples.en: Photography is an expensive hobby.
examples.zh: 摄影是一项很花钱的业余爱好。

words.translation: 经验，感受；经历；经验；体验

examples.zh: 小册子中的建议反映了我们所获得的实践经验。

examples.en: I had some experience in fashion design.
examples.zh: 我有一些时装设计方面的经验。

examples.en: She was turned down on the grounds of lack of experience.
examples.zh: 她因缺乏经验而被拒绝。

words.definition: a scientific test done to find out how something reacts under certain conditions, or to find out if a particular idea is true; have a try, try one's hand; stroke, proof, try, go
words.translation: 实验；试验；尝试；进行实验；[试验]实验，试验

examples.en: The astronauts are conducting a series of experiments to learn more about how the body adapts to weightlessness.
examples.zh: 那些宇航员正在进行一系列实验，以便更多地了解人体如何适应失重状态。

words.definition: to tell someone about something in a way that is clear or easy to understand; bring sb to do sth, go to show
words.translation: 解释；为…辩解；说明

examples.en: He carefully explained the procedure.
examples.zh: 他仔细解释了程序。

words.definition: to tell or show what you are feeling or thinking by using words, looks, or actions; a train or bus that does not stop in many places and therefore travels quickly; voice, put; precise, decided, technical, rapid, specific; rapido, flier
words.translation: 表示；快车，快递；表达；快递；明确的；迅速的；专门的；[交]快车，快递，专使；捷运公司

examples.zh: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

examples.en: She expressed an interest in seeing York.
examples.zh: 她表示有兴趣见见约克。

examples.zh: 许多人反对这些提议。

words.definition: one of the two parts of the body that you use to see with; viewpoint, vision, sight, perspective, outlook; watch, look, behold

examples.zh: 他有一双漂亮的眼睛。

examples.en: There were tears in her eyes as she listened to the story.
examples.zh: 她听故事时眼里噙着泪水。

examples.en: Ow! I’ve got something in my eye!
examples.zh: 哎呀！我眼睛里进了什么东西！

examples.zh: 她面容秀美。

examples.en: Her face was white with fear.
examples.zh: 她吓得脸煞白。

examples.en: A big smile spread across his face.
examples.zh: 他的脸上绽开了灿烂笑容。

words.definition: a piece of information that is known to be true; truth, reality, actuality
words.translation: 事实；实际，实情；实际；真相

examples.zh: 我们之所以决定在哈特尔浦建造博物馆，是因为东北地区没有国家级的博物馆。

words.definition: a building or group of buildings in which goods are produced in large quantities, using machines; plant, mill, work, manufactory
words.translation: 工厂，制造厂；[工经]工厂；制造厂；代理店

examples.en: a car factory
examples.zh: 汽车制造厂

examples.en: factory workers
examples.zh: 工厂工人

words.definition: to not succeed in achieving something; flag, founder, tube; disappoint, let down; flunk
words.translation: 失败；失灵；不能；失败，不及格；破产；缺乏；衰退；不及格；使失望；忘记；舍弃

examples.en: It looks likely that the peace talks will fail.
examples.zh: 看来和平谈判可能会失败。

examples.en: Millions of people have tried to quit smoking and failed miserably (= been completely unsuccessful ).
examples.zh: 数百万人戒过烟，都以惨败告终。

examples.zh: 他挽救自己濒危婚姻的努力

words.definition: an outdoor event, at which there are large machines to ride on, games to play, and sometimes farm animals being judged and sold; beautiful, fine, clear, just, impartial; definitely, directly, equally, immediately, straight; expo, exhibition, beauty

examples.en: a horse fair
