words.definition: several people or things that are all together in the same place; organization, community, team, body, suit; converge, polymerise
words.translation: 小组，群；聚集；组；团体；聚合

examples.en: A group of us are going to London.
examples.zh: 我们有一群人要去伦敦。

words.definition: to protect a person, place, or object by staying near them and watching them; the act or duty of protecting places or people, or of preventing prisoners from escaping; vigilance, alertness; keep one's eye on the ball, keep one's eyes peeled; watching, shield
words.translation: 守卫；看守；卫兵；警戒；护卫队；[安全]防护装置；警惕；保卫；监视

examples.en: The Sergeant told Swift to guard the entrance.
examples.zh: 中士叫斯威夫特守着入口。

examples.en: a lioness guarding her cubs
examples.zh: 守护着幼狮的母狮

words.definition: to try to answer a question or form an opinion when you are not sure whether you will be correct; expect, count, find, feel, make; speculate; speculation, theory, projection
words.translation: 猜测，推测；猜测；认为；推测；猜中；猜

examples.en: I’d say he’s around 50, but I’m only guessing.
examples.zh: 我想他50岁左右，不过也只是猜测。

examples.en: What star sign are you? No, let me guess .
examples.zh: 你是什么星座的？别说，让我来猜猜看。

words.definition: someone who is invited to an event or special occasion; customer, client, consumer; serve, invite, attend; board, stay over
words.translation: 客人，宾客；旅客；客人，[经]宾客；顾客；款待，招待；作客，寄宿

examples.en: a banquet for 250 distinguished guests
examples.zh: 250位贵宾出席的宴会

examples.en: Among the invited guests were Jerry Brown and Elihu Harris.
examples.zh: 受邀的嘉宾中有杰里·布朗和伊莱休·哈里斯。

examples.en: The actress was guest of honour (= the most important guest ) at the launch.
examples.zh: 这位女演员是首发式上的贵宾。

words.definition: a metal weapon which shoots bullets or  shells; gunman, rodman
words.translation: 枪，炮，手枪；枪枝；枪状物；持枪歹徒

examples.en: I’ve never fired a gun in my life.
examples.zh: 我这辈子从来没开过枪。

examples.en: Jake was pointing a gun at the door.
examples.zh: 杰克用枪对着门口。

examples.en: Two policemen were killed in a gun battle .
examples.zh: 两名警察在一次枪战中丧生。

words.definition: a special building or room that has equipment for doing physical exercise; gymnasium, physical culture
words.translation: 体育馆，健身房；健身房；体育；体育馆

examples.en: I go to the gym as often as I can.
examples.zh: 我一有空就去健身房健身。

words.definition: the mass of things like fine threads that grows on your head; capello, poil; pilar
words.translation: 头发，毛发；毛；头发；[解剖]毛发；些微；[解剖]毛发的；护理毛发的；用毛发制成的

examples.en: Her hair was short and dark.
examples.zh: 她的头发又短又黑。

examples.en: a short fat man with no hair on his head
examples.zh: 光头的矮胖男人

words.definition: exactly or about 50% (1/2) of an amount, time, distance, number etc; Half is also an adjective; moiety; partly; incomplete, synsemantic
words.translation: 半，一半；一半的；一半；半场；半学年；一半地；部分地；不完全的；半途的

examples.en: Only half the guests had arrived by seven o’clock.
examples.zh: 7点钟前只来了一半客人。

examples.en: If you look at our members, at least half are women.
examples.zh: 看看我们的会员，至少有一半是女性。

examples.en: ...a half measure of fresh lemon juice.
examples.zh: …半量杯的新鲜柠檬汁。

words.definition: the area just inside the door of a house or other building, that leads to other rooms; passage, corridor
words.translation: 门厅；过道；会堂；门厅，走廊；[建]会堂；食堂；学生宿舍

examples.en: a huge tiled entrance hall
examples.zh: 铺着地砖的大门厅

words.definition: the upper part of a pig’s leg, or the meat from this that has been preserved with salt or smoke; amateur radio; overplay; affected, stagey
words.translation: 火腿；[食品]火腿；业余无线电爱好者；蹩脚演员；表演过火；过火的；做作的

examples.en: a ham sandwich
examples.zh: 火腿三明治

examples.en: a seven-pound ham
examples.zh: 七磅重的火腿

words.definition: a flat round piece of finely cut beef(= meat from a cow ) which is cooked and eaten in a bread bun; burger, beefburger
words.translation: 汉堡包，牛肉饼；汉堡包，汉堡；牛肉饼，肉饼；碎牛肉

examples.en: The whole stadium stink of the hamburger.
examples.zh: 整个体育场内散发着汉堡包的香味。

examples.en: 'Why go out for hamburger when you have steak at home?' he once remarked.
examples.zh: 纽曼曾经说道，“如果家里有了牛排，为什么要出去找汉堡？”

examples.en: I order a soda and a hamburger for myself. Then another person gets coffee for me.
examples.zh: 嗯， 我为自己点了一杯苏打和一个汉堡包， 然后另外一人给我拿了杯咖啡。

words.definition: the part of your body at the end of your arm, including your fingers and thumb, that you use to hold things; assistance, craft, aid, index, finger; encourage, carry, second, back, transfer
words.translation: 手；人手；指针；[解剖]手，手艺；帮助；插手；传递，交给；支持；搀扶

examples.en: Steve gripped the steering wheel tightly with both hands.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫双手紧握方向盘。

examples.en: In her hand was a tattered old photograph.
examples.zh: 她手中拿着的是一张破旧的老照片。

words.definition: a small bag in which a woman carries money and personal things; gripesack
words.translation: 手提包

examples.en: Rice: No, I only have a handbag.
examples.zh: 没有，我只有一个手提包。

examples.en: He grabbed at her handbag .
examples.zh: 他抢夺了她的手提包。

examples.en: Is this my (your) handbag?
examples.zh: 这是我的手提包吗？

words.definition: a handsome victory is important and impressive; generous, liberal
words.translation: 英俊的；相当大的；（男子）英俊的；可观的；大方的，慷慨的；健美而端庄的

examples.en: They won a handsome victory in the elections.
examples.zh: 他们在选举中取得了重大的胜利。

words.definition: when something happens, there is an event, especially one that is not planned; occur, proceed, chance
words.translation: 发生；碰巧，恰好；碰巧；偶然遇到

examples.en: When did the accident happen?
examples.zh: 事故什么时候发生的？

examples.en: It’s impossible to predict what will happen next.
examples.zh: 不可能预测接下来会发生什么。

examples.en: She carried on as if nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 她继续干，似乎什么都未曾发生。

words.definition: having feelings of pleasure, for example because something good has happened to you or you are very satisfied with your life; pleased, glad, blessed, smart
words.translation: 快乐的；幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的

examples.en: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
examples.zh: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

examples.en: I’ve never felt happier in my life.
examples.zh: 我一生从未感到如此快乐。

examples.en: He was a happy child who rarely cried.
examples.zh: 他是一个快乐的孩子，很少哭鼻子。

words.definition: firm, stiff, and difficult to press down, break, or cut; difficult, severe, fierce, tight, violent; closely, heavily, strong
words.translation: 硬的；困难的；努力的；辛苦的；[医]确实的；严厉的；猛烈的；冷酷无情的；努力地；困难地；辛苦地；接近地；猛烈地；牢固地

examples.en: a hard wooden chair
examples.zh: 一把硬木椅

examples.en: the hardest substance known to man
examples.zh: 已知的最硬物质

examples.en: After months without rain, the ground was too hard to plough.
examples.zh: 数月无雨，土地坚硬难犁。

words.definition: almost not; just, ill, fresh, scarcely, barely
words.translation: 几乎不，简直不；刚刚

examples.en: My parents divorced when I was six, and I hardly knew my father.
examples.zh: 我六岁时父母离婚，我对父亲几乎一无所知。

examples.en: The children were so excited they could hardly speak.
examples.zh: 孩子们兴奋得几乎连话都说不出来了。

examples.en: I can hardly believe it.
examples.zh: 这简直让我难以置信。

words.definition: a piece of clothing that you wear on your head; cap, chapeau, titfer
words.translation: 帽子(一般指有边的)；帽子

examples.en: Maria was wearing a beautiful new hat.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚戴着一顶漂亮的新帽子。

words.definition: to dislike something very much; detest, turn away from; despite, hatred
words.translation: 恨，憎恨；不喜欢；憎恨；厌恶；遗憾；反感

examples.en: It’s the kind of movie you either love or hate.
examples.zh: 这是那种你要么喜欢要么讨厌的电影。

examples.en: He hates his job.
examples.zh: 他讨厌自己的工作。

words.definition: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about; boy, guy, man, jack, male
words.translation: (主格)他；男孩，男人；它（雄性动物）

examples.en: ‘Where’s Paul?’ ‘He’s gone to the cinema.’
examples.zh: “保罗在哪儿？”“他去看电影了。”

examples.en: It was he who first suggested the idea.
examples.zh: 是他先提出这个想法的。

words.definition: the top part of your body that has your face at the front and is supported by your neck; to be in charge of a team, government, organization etc; intelligence, understanding; to go forward, make one's way; leave, set out; primary, major, central, leading, great
words.translation: 头；上端；率领；[解剖]头；头痛；最前的部分；理解力；前进；用头顶；作为…的首领；站在…的前头；给…加标题；出发；成头状物；船驶往；头的；主要的；在顶端的

examples.en: He kissed the top of her head.
examples.zh: 他吻了一下她的头顶。

examples.en: Alan fell asleep as soon as he put his head on the pillow.
examples.zh: 艾伦头一挨枕头就睡着了。

examples.en: They dived head first into the water.
examples.zh: 他们一头跳进水中。

words.definition: the general condition of your body and how healthy you are; fitness, hygiene, wellness
words.translation: 健康，健康状况；[医]健康；卫生；保健；兴旺

examples.en: I’m worried about my husband’s health.
examples.zh: 我担心我丈夫的健康状况。

words.definition: physically strong and not likely to become ill or weak; robust, fit, sound, fine, well
words.translation: 健康的；有益健康的；健康的，健全的；有益于健康的

examples.en: a healthy baby boy
examples.zh: 健康的男婴

examples.en: I’ve always been perfectly healthy until now.
examples.zh: 直到现在，我的身体一直非常健康。

words.definition: the organ in your chest which pumps blood through your body; courage, affection, core, main, feeling; encourage, brand, uphold
words.translation: 心，内心；勇气；[内科][解剖]心脏；感情；心形；要点；鼓励；铭记

examples.en: Regular exercise is good for the heart.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼对心脏有好处。

examples.en: Can you hear my heart beating?
examples.zh: 你能听见我的心跳吗？

examples.en: Her cheeks were hot and her heart was pounding.
examples.zh: 她脸颊发烫，心怦怦直跳。

words.definition: warmth or the quality of being hot; to make something become warm or hot; pressure, high temperature; impassion, emotionalize
words.translation: 热，炎热；变热；高温；压力；热度；热烈；使激动；把…加热

examples.en: Ice needs heat to melt.
examples.zh: 冰需要热才能融化。

examples.en: Insulating the attic is a good way to reduce heat loss.
examples.zh: 为阁楼安装隔热层是减少热量流失的好方法。

words.definition: the place where God is believed to live and where good people are believed to go when they die; sky, paradise, air, high
words.translation: 天堂；天，天空；天空；极乐

examples.en: He looked up towards the heavens.
examples.zh: 他仰望苍穹。

words.definition: weighing a lot; huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro; largely, freely, big, importantly, massively
words.translation: 重的；大的；充满的；沉重的；繁重的，巨大的；阴沉的；大量地；笨重地

examples.en: The wardrobe was too heavy for me to move on my own.
examples.zh: 衣橱太重，我一个人移不动。

examples.en: a heavy suitcase
examples.zh: 沉重的手提箱

examples.en: The males are seven times heavier than the females.
examples.zh: 雄性的重量是雌性的七倍。

words.definition: how tall someone or something is; altitude, raise, sky, summit, peak
words.translation: 高，高度；高处；高地；高度；身高；顶点

examples.en: Sam’s about the same height as his sister now.
examples.zh: 萨姆现在身高和他姐姐差不多了。

examples.en: State your age, height, and weight.
examples.zh: 说出你的年龄、身高和体重。

examples.en: buildings of different heights
examples.zh: 高矮不一的建筑

words.definition: to make it possible or easier for someone to do something by doing part of their work or by giving them something they need; things you do to make it easier or possible for someone to do something; facilitate, promote, boost, cure, further; assistance, aid, hand, boost; aid, serve
words.translation: 帮助；援助；帮手；促进；治疗；补救；补救办法；帮忙者；有益的东西；有用；招待

examples.en: If there’s anything I can do to help, just give me a call.
examples.zh: 如果需要我帮忙，就给我打个电话。

words.definition: providing useful help in making a situation better or easier; useful, beneficial, advantageous, conducive, assistant
words.translation: 给予帮助的；有用的；有帮助的；有益的

examples.en: Thank you for your advice; it’s been very helpful.
examples.zh: 谢谢你的建议，它非常有用。

examples.en: It is helpful if we address a few key questions here.
examples.zh: 如果我们在这里解决一些关键问题会很有用的。

words.definition: an adult female chicken; female, she
words.translation: 母鸡，雌禽；母鸡；女人；[禽]雌禽

examples.en: The chickens gathered under the hen.
examples.zh: 小鸡聚集在母鸡翅膀下面。

examples.en: The chickens gathered under the hen.
examples.zh: 小鸡集聚在母鸡翅膀下面。

examples.en: The hen sits in the hencoop [henroost].
examples.zh: 母鸡卧窝。

words.definition: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about
words.translation: (宾格)她；她的

examples.en: Jane? I don’t really know her.
examples.zh: 简？我不太认识她。

examples.en: Margaret wants me to go with her.
examples.zh: 玛格丽特想让我和她一起去。

examples.en: Give her the keys.
examples.zh: 把钥匙给她。

words.definition: used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned
words.translation: 她的(所有物)

examples.en: He bent and touched his mouth to hers.
examples.zh: 他俯身吻她的嘴唇。

examples.en: These are my gloves. Hers are in the drawer.
examples.zh: 这是我的手套，她的在抽屉里。

examples.en: The idea was hers.
examples.zh: 这个主意是她出的。

words.definition: in this place; hier; hey, psst
words.translation: 这里；向这里；在这里；此时；嘿！；喂！

examples.en: What are you doing here?
examples.zh: 你们在这里干什么？

examples.en: Shall we eat here?
examples.zh: 我们在这里吃好吗？

examples.en: Come here for a minute.
examples.zh: 到这里来一下。

words.definition: used to show that the woman or girl who does something is affected by her own action
words.translation: 她自己；她亲自

examples.en: She cut herself on some broken glass.
examples.zh: 碎玻璃把她割伤了。

examples.en: She made herself a cup of coffee.
examples.zh: 她给自己煮了杯咖啡。

words.definition: measuring a long distance from the bottom to the top; at or to a level high above the ground, the floor etc; tall, senior, advanced, lofty; heaven, sky, air; luxuriously, sumptuously
words.translation: 高的；高级的；高；崇高的；高音调的；高水平；天空；由麻醉品引起的快感；高压地带；奢侈地

examples.en: This is the highest mountain in Japan.
examples.zh: 这是日本最高的山。

examples.en: The camp was surrounded by a high fence.
examples.zh: 营地四周围着高高的栅栏。

examples.en: a ten-foot high statue
examples.zh: 10英尺高的雕像

words.definition: an area of land that is higher than the land around it, like a mountain but smaller; slope, rises
words.translation: 小山，山岗；丘陵；小山；[地理]丘陵；斜坡；山冈

examples.en: Their house is on a hill overlooking the sea.
examples.zh: 他们的房子建在可以俯视大海的小山上。

examples.en: A cart was making its way up the hill.
examples.zh: 一辆马车正在爬上山丘。

words.definition: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about
words.translation: (宾格)他

examples.en: Are you in love with him?
examples.zh: 你爱上他了吗？

examples.en: Why don’t you ask him yourself?
examples.zh: 你为什么不自己问他？

examples.en: He repeated what she had told him.
examples.zh: 他把她告诉他的话重复了一遍。

words.translation: 他自己；他亲自

examples.en: He repossessed himself of his farm.
examples.zh: 他收回自己所有的农场。

examples.en: He barred himself in.
examples.zh: 他把自己关在里面。

examples.en: He stroked the name of himself with his pen.
examples.zh: 他用钢笔划掉了他自己的名字。

words.translation: 他的，他的东西

examples.en: He stated his views to me.
examples.zh: 他向我说明了他的观点。

words.definition: all the things that happened in the past, especially the political, social, or economic development of a nation; story, herstory
words.translation: 历史；个人经历；历史，历史学；历史记录；来历

examples.en: Throughout history the achievements of women have been largely ignored.
examples.zh: 从古至今，妇女的成就都被大大地忽视了。

examples.en: No man in recent history has done more to rebuild the Democratic Party.
examples.zh: 他对重建民主党的贡献在近代史上无人能及。

examples.en: the early history of Scotland
examples.zh: 苏格兰的早期历史

words.definition: an activity that you enjoy doing in your free time; weakness, habit, appetite, liking
words.translation: 业余爱好，癖好；嗜好；业余爱好

examples.en: What are your hobbies?
examples.zh: 你有些什么爱好？

examples.en: Susan’s hobbies include reading, cooking, and drama.
examples.zh: 苏珊的业余爱好包括阅读、烹饪和戏剧。

examples.en: Retirement gave him the time to pursue his hobbies.
examples.zh: 退休以后他有充裕的时间来做自己喜欢做的事。

words.definition: a time of rest from work, school etc; festival, Feriae
words.translation: 假日，节日；假期；假日；节日；休息日

examples.en: The school holidays start tomorrow.
examples.zh: 学校假期从明天开始。

words.definition: the house, apartment, or place where you live; relating to or belonging to your home or family; door, residence, haven, harbor, habitat; deep; domestic, valid, internal, available, effective, virtual
words.translation: 家；家乡；家庭的；家，住宅；产地；避难所；在家，回家；深入地；国内的，家庭的；有效的

examples.en: They have a beautiful home in California.
examples.zh: 他们在加州有个美丽的家。

examples.en: Good luck in your new home!
examples.zh: 祝你在新家一切顺利！

examples.en: A family of birds made their home (= started living ) under the roof.
examples.zh: 一窝鸟在屋顶下安了家。

words.definition: Someone's hometown is the town where they live or the town that they come from; country, native land
words.translation: 故乡；家乡

examples.en: Do you like your hometown?
examples.zh: 你喜欢你的家乡吗？

examples.en: She expressed the wish to be interred in the graveyard of hometown.
examples.zh: 她表达了死后葬在故乡的墓地上的愿望。

words.definition: work that a student at school is asked to do at home; schoolwork, home study
words.translation: 家庭作业, 副业；家庭作业，课外作业

examples.en: For homework, finish the exercise on page 14.
examples.zh: 家庭作业是完成第14页的练习。

words.definition: someone who is honest always tells the truth and does not cheat or steal; responsible, effective, transparent, reliable, tried
words.translation: 诚实的；可敬的；诚实的，实在的；可靠的；坦率的

examples.en: He was a hard-working, honest man.
examples.zh: 他勤奋老实。

examples.en: Ann had an honest face.
examples.zh: 安有一张诚实的面孔。

words.definition: to want something to happen or be true and to believe that it is possible or likely; wish, pleasure, confidence, promise, anticipation; want, desire to; rely, depend, expect, like, trust
words.translation: 希望；期望；信心；期待；信赖

examples.en: I do hope everything goes well.
examples.zh: 我真心希望一切顺利。

examples.en: It was hoped that the job would be filled by a local person.
examples.zh: 希望该职位由当地人来担任。

examples.en: Let’s just hope someone finds her bag.
examples.zh: 希望有人找到她的提包。

words.definition: a large strong animal that people ride and use for pulling heavy things; prad, yarraman; play tricks on, play tricks with; ride
words.translation: 马；马科动物；[畜牧]马；骑兵；脚架；海洛因；使骑马；系马于；捉弄；骑马；作弄人

examples.en: a horse and cart
examples.zh: 一辆马车

examples.en: Lee had never ridden a horse before.
examples.zh: 李以前从未骑过马。

words.definition: a large building where sick or injured people receive medical treatment; infirmary
words.translation: 医院；[医]医院

examples.en: They are building a new hospital.
examples.zh: 他们正在建一家新医院。

words.definition: food that tastes hot has a burning taste because it contains strong spices; thermal, intense, excited, warm, tropical; enhance, boost, jack, mount, gain
words.translation: 热的；刺激的；辣的；[通信]热的；热情的；激动的；紧迫的；增加；给…加温

examples.en: a hot curry
examples.zh: 一种辛辣的咖喱

words.definition: a building where people pay to stay and eat meals; restaurant, inn
words.translation: 旅馆；旅馆，[经]饭店；客栈

examples.en: I’ve booked the flights and the hotel.
examples.zh: 我已订好机票和酒店。

examples.en: We’ll be staying at the Hotel Ibis.
examples.zh: 我们将住在宜必思酒店。

words.definition: a unit for measuring time. There are 60 minutes in one hour, and 24 hours in one day.; period, stunde
words.translation: 小时；时间，时刻；钟头；课时；…点钟

examples.en: The interview will last about two hours.
examples.zh: 面试大概要持续两小时。

examples.en: I study for an hour every night.
examples.zh: 我每晚学习一小时。

examples.en: I’ll be back in three hours .
examples.zh: 我三小时以后回来。

words.definition: a company, especially one involved in a particular area of business; residence, organization, machinery, family, home; invest, sheet, roof, cap
words.translation: 房屋，住宅；商号；[建]住宅；家庭；机构；议会；某种用途的建筑物；覆盖；给…房子住；把…储藏在房内

examples.en: America’s oldest publishing house
examples.zh: 美国历史最悠久的出版社

examples.en: a small independent software house
examples.zh: 一家小型的独立软件公司

examples.en: an auction house
examples.zh: 一家拍卖行

words.definition: work that you do to take care of a house, for example washing, cleaning etc
words.translation: 家务事

examples.en: Men are doing more housework nowadays.
examples.zh: 现今男人正在承担越来越多的家务。

words.definition: used to ask or talk about the way in which something happens or is done; somewhat; way of, manner, method, mode, approach, system
words.translation: 怎么；怎样；多少；如何；多么；方法；方式

examples.en: How do you spell your name?
examples.zh: 你的名字怎么拼写？

examples.en: How can I help you?
examples.zh: 我怎么帮你？

examples.en: I’d like to help in some way, but I’m not sure how.
examples.zh: 我想帮点忙，可不知道该怎么做。

words.definition: used when you are adding a fact or piece of information that seems surprising, or seems very different from what you have just said; anyway, at all events; whereas, while, nevertheless, but, yet
words.translation: 然而；不管怎样；无论如何；可是

examples.en: This is a cheap and simple process. However, there are dangers.
examples.zh: 这是个花钱少而又简单的方法，不过有危险。

examples.en: an extremely unpleasant disease that is, however, easy to treat
examples.zh: 一种让人极其难受却容易治疗的病

words.definition: extremely large in size, amount, or degree; enormous, tremendous, massive, macro, vast
words.translation: 巨大的，庞大的；巨大的；庞大的；无限的

examples.en: a huge dog
examples.zh: 一条大狗

examples.en: huge crowds
examples.zh: 大群大群的人

examples.en: Your room’s huge compared to mine.
examples.zh: 你的房间跟我的比很大。

words.definition: belonging to or relating to people, especially as opposed to machines or animals; a person; demic, hominine; person, mankind, man, creature, homo
words.translation: 人的，人类的；人；人的；[人类]人类的；[人类]人；人类

examples.en: There are many different cell types in the human body .
examples.zh: 人体中有许多种不同的细胞类型。

examples.en: the power of the human mind
examples.zh: 人脑的威力

examples.en: The desire for joy lies deep within the human spirit .
examples.zh: 对快乐的渴求藏在人类心灵深处。

words.definition: completely; a very large number of things or people; lots of, sea, host, thousands of, much; numerous, multiple, many
words.translation: 百，百个；许多；一百；一百的；许多的

examples.en: I’m not a hundred percent sure where she lives.
examples.zh: 我不能完全确定她住在哪里。

words.definition: wanting to eat something; eager, desired, anxious, sick, keen
words.translation: 饥饿的；渴望的；荒年的；不毛的

examples.en: I was cold, tired, and hungry.
examples.zh: 我又冷，又累，又饿。

examples.en: If you get hungry , there’s some cold chicken in the fridge.
examples.zh: 你要是饿了，冰箱里有些冷鸡肉。

examples.en: Do you still feel hungry?
examples.zh: 你还觉得饿吗？

words.definition: to do something or go somewhere more quickly than usual, especially because there is not much time; to make someone do something more quickly; hasty indeed, haste; hasten; get a hump on, make haste
words.translation: 赶紧；催促；匆忙，急忙；使赶紧；使匆忙，使急忙；赶紧，赶快；匆忙

examples.en: If we hurry, we’ll get there in time.
examples.zh: 要是赶紧的话，我们能及时到那里。

examples.en: I hate having to hurry a meal.
examples.zh: 我讨厌匆匆忙忙地吃饭。

examples.en: We’ll have to hurry, otherwise we’ll miss the start.
examples.zh: 我们得赶紧，否则就会错过开头部分了。

words.definition: the man that a woman is married to; hubby, worse half
words.translation: 丈夫

examples.en: Have you met my husband Roy?
examples.zh: 你见过我的丈夫罗伊吗？

words.definition: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself
words.translation: (主格)我

examples.en: I moved to this city six years ago.
examples.zh: 六年前我搬到了这个城市。

examples.en: I’m not late again, am I?
examples.zh: 我没有又迟到吧？

examples.en: My husband and I enjoy going to the theatre.
examples.zh: 我和丈夫喜欢去剧院看戏。

words.definition: water that has frozen into a solid state; gelato, reservedness; glacial
words.translation: 冰，冰块；冰镇；[水文][制冷]冰；冰淇淋；矜持；冰的

examples.en: Would you like some ice in your drink?
examples.zh: 你饮料中要放点冰块吗？

examples.en: Her hands were as cold as ice.
examples.zh: 她双手冰冷。

examples.en: The city spent $7 million to remove snow and ice from the roads.
examples.zh: 市政府花费了700万美元用于清除路上的冰雪。

words.definition: a plan or suggestion for a possible course of action, especially one that you think of suddenly; concept, notion, construct, think
words.translation: 想法；思想；意见；主意；概念

examples.en: You should talk to Ken – he's always full of good ideas.
examples.zh: 你应该和肯谈谈，他总是满脑子好主意。

examples.en: I knew it was a bad idea to leave him on his own.
examples.zh: 我知道把他独自留下不是个好主意。

examples.en: It was my wife’s idea to move house.
examples.zh: 要搬家是我妻子的主意。

words.definition: used when talking about something that might happen or be true, or might have happened; whether, provided; condition, qualification, conception, assumption
words.translation: 假如，如果；（表条件）如果；即使；是否；（表假设）假如；条件；设想

examples.en: We’ll stay at home if it rains.
examples.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。

examples.en: If you need money, I can lend you some.
examples.zh: 如果你需要钱，我能借给你一些。

examples.en: If I didn’t apologize, I’d feel guilty.
examples.zh: 如果我不道歉，我会感到内疚。

words.definition: suffering from a disease or not feeling well; to think or say unpleasant things about someone; bad, evil, black, ugly; badly, barely, adversely; illness, disaster, disease, sickness, evil
words.translation: 有病的；坏的；坏；生病的；邪恶的；不吉利的；不利地；恶劣地；几乎不；疾病；不幸

examples.en: Bridget can’t come – she’s ill.
examples.zh: 布里奇特不能来了，她生病了。

examples.en: I was feeling ill that day and decided to stay at home.
examples.zh: 我那天不太舒服，决定留在家里。

examples.en: a hospice for the terminally ill
examples.zh: 晚期病人的安养院

words.definition: a disease of the body or mind, or the condition of being ill; disease, ill, sickness, complaint, maladie
words.translation: 病，疾病；病；[医]疾病

examples.en: She had all the normal childhood illnesses.
examples.zh: 儿童的常见病她小时候都得过。

examples.en: Her mother was recovering from a serious illness.
examples.zh: 她母亲重病后正在逐渐康复。

examples.en: I’ve never missed a day’s work through illness.
examples.zh: 我从未因病耽误过一天工作。

words.definition: to form a picture or idea in your mind about what something could be like; picture, think of; think of, suppose
words.translation: 想象，设想；料想；想像；猜想；臆断；想像起来

examples.en: Perhaps she’d never really been there at all – perhaps she’d just imagined it.
examples.zh: 可能她从未到过那儿——也许这都是她的幻想。

words.definition: very soon before or after something; rapidly, directly, soon, now, shortly; directly, than
words.translation: 立即；直接地；立即，立刻；一…就

examples.en: Those most immediately involved in the disaster will be given support.
examples.zh: 灾害最直接受害者将获得援助。

words.definition: an important event, decision, problem etc has a big effect or influence on people’s lives or on events in the future; crucial, considerable, material, big, significant
words.translation: 重要的；有势力的；重要的，重大的；有地位的；有权力的

examples.en: a very important meeting
examples.zh: 很重要的会议

examples.en: The accident taught him an important lesson.
examples.zh: 那次事故给了他很大的教训。

examples.en: Happiness is more important than money.
examples.zh: 快乐比金钱更重要。

words.definition: to make something better, or to become better; further, build up; gain, accelerate, grow in
words.translation: 使更好；改善；改善，增进；提高…的价值；增加；变得更好

examples.en: a course for students wishing to improve their English
examples.zh: 为想提高英语水平的学生开设的一门课

examples.en: The doctors say she is improving (= after being ill ).
examples.zh: 医生说她正在康复。

examples.en: You could use the money for improving your home.
examples.zh: 你可以用这笔钱改善家居。

words.definition: used with the name of a container, place, or area to say where someone or something is; within, inside; modern, fashionable, tony
words.translation: 在…里ad进，入；按照（表示方式）；从事于；在…之内；在里面的；时髦的

examples.en: There’s some sugar in the cupboard.
examples.zh: 碗橱里有一些糖。

examples.en: My mother was in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我母亲在厨房里。

examples.en: He took us for a drive in his new car.
examples.zh: 他开着他的新车载我们去兜风。

words.definition: a unit for measuring length, equal to 2.54 centimetres. There are 12 inches in a foot.; height, little, touch; worm
words.translation: 英寸；身高；少许；慢慢前进

examples.en: The curtains were an inch too short.
examples.zh: 窗帘短了一英寸。

examples.en: Rainfall here is under 15 inches a year.
examples.zh: 本地的年降雨量不到15英寸。

words.definition: if one thing includes another, the second thing is part of the first; involve, contain, comprise
words.translation: 包含；包含，包括

examples.en: Does the price include postage?
examples.zh: 这个价格包含邮费吗？

examples.en: His job includes looking after under-21 teams.
examples.zh: 他的职责包括照管21岁以下球队。

examples.en: The curriculum includes courses in computing.
examples.zh: 课程内容包括计算机技术。

words.definition: if you increase something, or if it increases, it becomes bigger in amount, number, or degree; enhancement, growth, gain, raising, advance; improve, gain, accelerate, breed, make; enhance, boost, jack, mount, hot
words.translation: 增加；增加，增长；提高；增加，增大；繁殖；增加，加大

examples.en: The population increased dramatically in the first half of the century.
examples.zh: 该世纪上半叶，人口大幅度增加。

examples.en: political tensions that might increase the likelihood of war
examples.zh: 或许会增加战争爆发可能性的紧张政治局面

examples.en: Visits to the site have increased threefold since May.
examples.zh: 来这里的参观者自5月起已增至原来的三倍。

words.translation: 印度

examples.en: Burma borders on India.
examples.zh: 缅甸与印度毗邻。

examples.en: This book treats of the caste system in India.
examples.zh: 这本书论述了印度的种姓制度。

examples.en: If you come to India for just one thing, this should be it.
examples.zh: 如果你只为一件事来到印度，那就到这儿来吧。

words.definition: relating to India or its people; someone from India; hindu; Injun, Red Indian
words.translation: 印度的；印度人；印第安人的；印第安语的；印第安人；印第安语

examples.en: ...the Indian government.
examples.zh: ...印度政府。

words.definition: businesses that produce a particular type of thing or provide a particular service; domain, manufacturing
words.translation: 工业，产业；勤劳；产业；[工业]工业；勤勉

examples.en: I work in the oil industry.
examples.zh: 我在石油行业工作。

examples.en: Italy’s thriving tourist industry
examples.zh: 意大利蓬勃发展的旅游业

words.definition: the power to affect the way someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks, without using direct force or orders; effect, infection, impression, affection, incidence; affect, impact of, impact on, reach, fashion
words.translation: 影响；势力；感化；有影响的人或事；改变

examples.en: As a scientist, his influence was immense.
examples.zh: 身为一名科学家，他的影响力极大。

words.definition: facts or details that tell you something about a situation, person, event etc; feedback, advice, notice, knowledge of, cognition
words.translation: 消息，信息；通知；[计][通信]信息，资料；知识；[图情]情报

examples.en: I need more information.
examples.zh: 我需要更多信息。

words.definition: a coloured liquid that you use for writing, printing or drawing; sign, endorse; atrament
words.translation: 墨水，油墨；签署；涂墨水于；[轻]墨水，墨汁；[印刷]油墨

examples.en: Please write in black ink.
examples.zh: 请用黑色墨水书写。

words.definition: the inner part of something, which is surrounded or hidden by the outer part; interior, within, inner; internal, inner, secret, underground, chamber; within, under, in
words.translation: 在…里面；内部；里面；内情；内脏；里面的；内部的；秘密的；少于；在…之内

examples.en: He concealed the key inside his tie.
examples.zh: 他把钥匙藏在领带里面。

words.definition: to demand that something should happen; emphasize, stay, tough, stress, highlight; stay, stand on
words.translation: 主张，坚持；坚持，强调

examples.en: Stay for supper – I insist!
examples.zh: 留下来吃晚餐——一定的！

words.definition: used to say what is not used, does not happen etc, when something else is used, happens etc
words.translation: 代替，顶替；反而

examples.en: You probably picked up my keys instead of yours.
examples.zh: 你可能没拿你的钥匙而错拿了我的。

examples.en: Could I have tuna instead of ham?
examples.zh: 我可否要金枪鱼来代替火腿？

examples.en: Instead of being annoyed, he seemed quite pleased.
examples.zh: 他没有生气，反而似乎很高兴。

words.definition: the written information that tells you how to do or use something; direction, order, bidding, word, charge
words.translation: 命令，指示，用法说明；指令，命令；指示；教导；用法说明

examples.en: Press ‘Enter’ and follow the on-screen instructions.
examples.zh: 按回车键，然后按照电脑屏幕上的指示来操作。

words.definition: a plan or desire to do something; goals, purpose, sake, meaning, will
words.translation: 打算，意图；意图；目的；意向；愈合

examples.en: They went into town with the intention of visiting the library.
examples.zh: 他们进了城，打算参观图书馆。

words.definition: if you have an interest in something or someone, you want to know or learn more about them; like, fond of
words.translation: 兴趣；利益；利息；兴趣，爱好；[金融]利息；趣味；同行

examples.en: I watched the first few episodes, but soon lost interest.
examples.zh: 我看了前几集，但很快就失去了兴趣。

examples.en: The last round of bidding aroused considerable interest.
examples.zh: 最后一轮竞价引起人们相当大的兴趣。

examples.en: Our survey reveals a disturbing lack of interest in teacher training.
examples.zh: 我们的调查显示人们对教师培训失去了兴趣，这很令人不安。

words.definition: if something is interesting, you give it your attention because it seems unusual or exciting or provides information that you did not know about
words.translation: 有趣的，引人入胜的

examples.en: That’s an interesting question.
examples.zh: 那是一个有趣的问题。

examples.en: a really interesting TV programme
examples.zh: 十分有趣的电视节目

examples.en: Did you meet any interesting people?
examples.zh: 你见过什么有意思的人吗？

words.definition: relating to or involving more than one nation; mundane
words.translation: 国际的，世界(性)的；国际的；世界的

examples.en: the response of the international community
examples.zh: 国际社会的反响

examples.en: the UN and other international organizations
examples.zh: 联合国和其他国际组织

words.translation: 因特网

words.definition: a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out whether they are suitable for a job, course of study etc; to ask someone questions during an interview; audience; cover, to receive
words.translation: 会见；面谈（试）；采访；接见，采访；面试，面谈；接见；对…进行面谈；对某人进行面试

examples.en: a portfolio of work presented at interview
examples.zh: 在面试时呈递的工作成果样本

words.definition: to the inside or inner part of a container, place, area etc
words.translation: 进，入；进入到

examples.en: Come into the office.
examples.zh: 到办公室里来。

examples.en: He thrust his hand into his coat pocket.
examples.zh: 他把手插进大衣口袋里。

examples.en: There must be another way into the cave.
examples.zh: 一定有其他的路可以进入洞穴。

words.definition: if you introduce someone to another person, you tell them each other’s names for the first time; present, recommend, prefer, file, advance
words.translation: 介绍；引进，传入；引进；提出；采用

examples.en: Have you two been introduced? Tom, this is Greg.
examples.zh: 有人给你们俩互相介绍了吗？汤姆，这位是格雷格。

words.definition: the act of formally telling two people each other’s names when they first meet; presentation, adoption
words.translation: 介绍；引进；引言；采用；入门；传入

examples.en: Pete, are you going to make the introductions?
examples.zh: 皮特，你来作一下介绍吧。

examples.en: Our first contestant needs no introduction (= everyone already knows the person ).
examples.zh: 我们的第一位参赛者就不用介绍了。

words.definition: to make, design, or think of a new type of thing; father, coin
words.translation: 发明，创造；捏造；发明；创造；虚构

examples.en: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.
examples.zh: 亚历山大 · 格雷厄姆 · 贝尔于1876年发明了电话。

words.definition: a useful machine, tool, instrument etc that has been invented; fiction, contrivance
words.translation: 发明，创造；捏造；[专利]发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能

examples.en: The dishwasher is a wonderful invention.
examples.zh: 洗碗机是一项奇妙的发明。

words.definition: to ask someone to come to a party, wedding, meal etc; serve, attend, ask, court, guest; calling, invitation to
words.translation: 邀请，聘请；招待；邀请，招待；招致；邀请

examples.en: I’m afraid I wasn’t invited.
examples.zh: 恐怕我没有受到邀请。

words.definition: a common hard metal that is used to make steel, is  magnetic  , and is found in very small quantities in food and blood. It is a chemical  element  : symbol Fe; sadiron, flatiron; cruel, ferrous
words.translation: 铁；烙铁；烫(衣)；熨斗；[服装]烙铁；坚强；铁的；残酷的；刚强的

examples.en: the iron and steel industry
examples.zh: 钢铁工业

examples.en: a driveway with large iron gates
examples.zh: 安装了大铁门的私家车道

examples.en: the absorption of iron from food
examples.zh: 对食物中铁的吸收

words.definition: a piece of land completely surrounded by water; isle, safety strip; to stand alone
words.translation: 岛，岛屿；岛；岛屿；安全岛；岛状物；孤立；使成岛状

examples.en: The Cayman Islands
examples.zh: 开曼群岛

examples.en: the Greek island of Crete
examples.zh: 希腊克里特岛

words.definition: used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, idea etc that has already been mentioned or is already known about
words.translation: 这，那，它

examples.en: ‘Where’s your office?’ ‘It’s on the third floor.’
examples.zh: “你的办公室在哪儿？”“在三楼。”

examples.en: I love the spring – it’s a wonderful time of the year.
examples.zh: 我喜欢春季——这是一年里最美妙的时节。

examples.en: There were people crying, buildings on fire. It was terrible!
examples.zh: 有人在哭喊，楼房在燃烧―太可怕了！

words.translation: 它的

examples.en: He emphasized its importance to me.
examples.zh: 他向我强调它的重要性。

examples.en: The child read the story but did not comprehend its meaning.
examples.zh: 这个孩子读了这篇故事，但不能理解它的意思。

examples.zh: 在客户端下一次连接到服务器时，它将获得另一个许可证。

words.definition: if a town, village, etc lies in a particular place, it is in that place; sit, tell a story; location, situation, site, fiction, leasing
words.translation: 躺，平放；位于；躺；说谎；展现；谎言；位置

examples.en: The town lies in a small wooded valley.
examples.zh: 该城镇坐落于一个林木茂盛的山谷中。

examples.en: The Tasman Sea lies between Tasmania and Australia.
examples.zh: 塔斯曼海位于塔斯马尼亚和澳大利亚之间。

words.definition: to move something or someone upwards into the air; a machine that you can ride in, that moves up and down between the floors in a tall building; promote, stimulate, prefer, upgrade, spirit; evanesce, flee; elevator, up with
words.translation: 提起，提高；电梯；举起；提升；鼓舞；空运；抄袭；消散；升起；耸立；起重机；搭车

examples.en: Sophie lifted the phone before the second ring.
examples.zh: 铃响了一下苏菲就接起了电话。

examples.en: He lifted the lid on the pot of soup.
examples.zh: 他揭开汤锅的盖子。

examples.en: The lumber was lifted by crane and dropped into the truck.
examples.zh: 木材由起重机搬运到卡车上。

words.definition: not very heavy; lamp, lucency; easy, shining; brighten; lamp, lumine
words.translation: 轻的，少量的；[光]光，光亮；[电]灯；轻的；光亮的；容易的；点着；变亮；著火；照亮；点燃；着火

examples.en: You can carry this bag – it’s fairly light.
examples.zh: 你可以拿这个袋子——它很轻。

examples.en: You should wear light, comfortable shoes.
examples.zh: 你应该穿轻便舒适的鞋子。

examples.en: The truck was quite light and easy to drive.
examples.zh: 这辆卡车很轻，容易驾驶。

words.definition: to enjoy something or think that it is nice or good; love, think; prefer, affect; as per; similar, alike; interest, bent, fond of; perhaps, maybe, supposedly, on the cards, forse
words.translation: 喜欢；喜爱；希望；想；愿意；像；如同；同样的；相似的；爱好；同样的人或物；可能

examples.en: I like your jacket.
examples.zh: 我喜欢你这件上衣。

examples.en: I don’t really like classical music.
examples.zh: 我不是很喜欢古典音乐。

examples.en: Do you like this colour?
examples.zh: 你喜欢这种颜色吗？

words.definition: a long thin mark on a piece of paper, the ground, or another surface; vector, row, range, thread, rank; fall in, queue
words.translation: 线；排；路线；线条；路线，航线；绳；排队；站成一排

examples.en: Draw a straight line across the top of the page.
examples.zh: 在这一页的上方画一条直线。

examples.en: Sign your name on the dotted line (= line made up of a series of dots ).
examples.zh: 在虚线上签名。

examples.en: The edges of the pitch are marked by white lines.
examples.zh: 球场的四边画着白线。

words.definition: a large animal of the cat family that lives in Africa and parts of southern Asia. Lions have gold-coloured fur and the male has a mane(= long hair around its neck ).; personality, leo, celebrity
words.translation: 狮子；勇猛的人；名人；社交场合的名流

examples.en: The wounded lion bellowed out.
examples.zh: 受伤的狮子发出了怒吼。

examples.en: The lion bounded on the prey.
examples.zh: 那头狮子向猎物猛扑过去。

examples.en: The savages darted spears at the lion.
examples.zh: 野蛮人们把矛掷向狮子。

words.definition: a set of names, numbers etc, usually written one below the other, for example so that you can remember or check them; A list of things is a set of them that you think of as being in a particular order; statement, directory, bill, content
words.translation: 表，目录；列举；[计]列表；清单；[图情]目录

examples.en: High on the list of public demands is to end military control of broadcasting.
examples.zh: 高居公众要求事项前列的是结束对广播的军事控制。

examples.en: The criminal judicial system always comes up at the top of the list of voters' concerns in focus groups.
examples.zh: 刑事司法制度总是出现在焦点小组中投票者关注事项之首。

words.definition: to pay attention to what someone is saying or to a sound that you can hear; hear, hark; ear
words.translation: 听，留神听；听从；听，倾听；听从，听信

examples.en: Listen! There’s a strange noise in the engine.
examples.zh: 听！引擎发出奇怪的声音。

words.definition: waste paper, cans etc that people have thrown away and left on the ground in a public place; to leave waste paper, cans etc on the ground in a public place; refuse, garbage, junk, rubbish, trash; give birth
words.translation: 废物；杂乱；乱扔；垃圾；轿，担架；一窝（动物的幼崽）；凌乱；产仔；乱扔废弃物

examples.en: People who drop litter can be fined in some cities.
examples.zh: 在有些城市，乱扔垃圾的人会被罚款。

examples.en: A litter of notes, papers, and textbooks were strewn on the desk.
examples.zh: 一堆笔记、考卷和课本乱七八糟地摊在桌子上。

examples.en: The floor was littered with papers.
examples.zh: 地板上乱七八糟扔了许多报纸。

words.definition: if you live in a place, you have your home there; not dead or artificial; telling, vivid, vigorous, energetic; spend, suffer, experience, undergo, last; exist, belong, room, harbor, dwell
words.translation: 居住；活；活的；生动的；实况转播的；精力充沛的；经历；度过；生存

examples.en: He lives just across the street from me.
examples.zh: 他就住在我街对面。

examples.en: We live only a few miles from the coast.
examples.zh: 我们住的地方离海边只有几英里远。

examples.en: A rather odd family came tolive next door to us.
examples.zh: 有一户相当奇怪的人家搬到了我们隔壁。

words.definition: someone who is lively has a lot of energy and is very active; alive, actual, sincere, telling, vivid
words.translation: 活泼的；逼真的；生动的；真实的；生气勃勃的

examples.en: a lively child
examples.zh: 精力充沛的孩子

words.definition: a thing that keeps a door, drawer etc fastened and is usually opened with a key or by moving a small metal bar; to fasten something, usually with a key, so that other people cannot open it, or to be fastened like this （; key, pocket; chain up, seize up; spoke, brake
words.translation: 锁；锁上，锁住；[五金]锁，锁上；隐藏；[五金]锁；锁住；卡住；[水利]水闸；刹车

examples.en: I’m sorry, there isn’t a lock on the bathroom door.
examples.zh: 对不起，浴室门上没有锁。

examples.en: The key turned stiffly in the lock.
examples.zh: 这把钥匙开锁不灵活。

examples.en: a bike lock
examples.zh: 自行车锁

words.translation: 伦敦

examples.en: He was nursed in London.
examples.zh: 他是在伦敦长大的。

examples.en: I trained to London.
examples.zh: 我乘火车到伦敦。

examples.en: He hopped to and fro between London and Paris for the business.
examples.zh: 为了这笔生意他曾不停地往返于伦敦和巴黎。

words.definition: unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone to talk to; remote, doleful
words.translation: 孤独的；荒凉的；寂寞的；偏僻的

examples.en: a lonely old man
examples.zh: 一个孤单的老人

examples.en: Don’t you get lonely being on your own all day?
examples.zh: 你整天独自一人不感到寂寞吗？

words.definition: used to ask and talk about particular amounts of time; tall, full-bottomed; rare, aspire; chronically, ever more
words.translation: 渴望；长的；过长的；做多头的；热望；长期地；始终

examples.en: How long will it take to get there?
examples.zh: 到那里去要多长时间？

examples.en: Try to keep going foras long as possible.
examples.zh: 能坚持多久就坚持多久。

examples.en: Ittookme longerthan I thought it would.
examples.zh: 我用的时间比原先想的要长。

words.definition: to turn your eyes towards something, so that you can see it; an act of looking at something; watching, take care of, behold, face; take care of, behold; air, face
words.translation: 看，显得；看；期待；注意；面向；看上去像；看起来；样子；面容

examples.en: We sneaked out while Jessie’s mom wasn’t looking.
examples.zh: 我们趁杰茜的妈妈没有看到，偷偷地溜了出去。

examples.en: If you look carefully you can see that the painting represents a human figure.
examples.zh: 如果仔细看，就会看出画上是一个人形。

examples.en: Gina covered her eyes, afraid to look.
examples.zh: 吉娜捂住眼睛，不敢看。

words.definition: a large amount or number; fate, destiny, fortune, portion, crowd; plot, to divide; draw straws, draw cuts; extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too
words.translation: 许多，大量；签，阄；命运；一块地；一堆；抽签；份额；划分；抓阄；非常；相当

examples.en: We’ve spent a lot on the children’s education.
examples.zh: 我们在孩子的教育上花费甚多。

examples.en: ‘How many CDs have you got?’ ‘Lots.’
examples.zh: “你有多少张CD？”“多着呢。”

words.definition: making a lot of noise; ceaseless, unceasing; aloud, ringingly
words.translation: 响亮的；吵闹的；大声的，高声的；不断的；喧吵的；大声地，高声地，响亮地

examples.en: The book fell to the floor with a loud bang.
examples.zh: 书砰的一声掉落到地上。

examples.en: The music was so loud that I had to shout.
examples.zh: 音乐太响了，我只得大声地喊。

examples.en: ‘Who’s there?’ asked David in a loud voice.
examples.zh: “是谁？” 戴维大声问道。

words.definition: to have a strong feeling of  affection  for someone, combined with sexual attraction; a strong feeling of caring about someone, especially a member of your family or a close friend; passion, amativeness; worship, take a fancy to
words.translation: 爱，喜欢；爱；恋爱；亲爱的；酷爱；喜爱的事物；喜欢；热爱；爱慕

examples.en: I love you, Tracy.
examples.zh: 我爱你，特雷西。

examples.en: He was the only man she had ever loved.
examples.zh: 他是她唯一爱过的男人。

words.definition: beautiful or attractive; pleasant, pretty, taking, grateful, cute
words.translation: 可爱的；令人愉快的

examples.en: She had a lovely face.
examples.zh: 她有一张漂亮的脸蛋。

examples.en: What a lovely house!
examples.zh: 多么漂亮的房子啊！

examples.en: You look lovely in that dress.
examples.zh: 你穿那条连衣裙很漂亮。

words.definition: bad, or below an acceptable or usual level or quality; flat, shallow; sotto voce, shamefacedly; keen price
words.translation: 低的，矮的；低下的；低的，浅的；卑贱的；粗俗的；消沉的；低声地；谦卑地，低下地；低；低价；低点；牛叫声

examples.en: Their safety standards seem to be pretty low.
examples.zh: 他们的安全标准似乎相当低。

examples.en: Cost-cutting has led to a lower quality of service.
examples.zh: 削减成本导致服务质量降低。

examples.en: the children’s low achievement in school
examples.zh: 孩子们在学校里不好的成绩

words.definition: good things that happen to you by chance; fortune, chance, mercy; have one's day, strike it rich
words.translation: 运气；好运，幸运；幸运；带来好运的东西；靠运气，走运；凑巧碰上

examples.en: You’re not having much luck today, are you?
examples.zh: 你今天运气不太好，是不是？

examples.en: He’s had good luck with his roses this year.
examples.zh: 今年他种玫瑰的运气不错。

examples.en: It was an incredible piece of luck.
examples.zh: 真是令人难以置信的好运气。

words.definition: having good luck; fortunate, providential
words.translation: 幸运的；吉祥的；侥幸的

examples.en: I didn’t really know your name – it was just a lucky guess .
examples.zh: 我并不知道你的名字―只是运气好猜中的。

words.definition: a meal eaten in the middle of the day; dejeuner, Mittagessen
words.translation: 午餐，(美)便餐；午餐

examples.en: What’s for lunch?
examples.zh: 午饭吃什么？

words.definition: a piece of equipment with moving parts that uses power such as electricity to do a particular job; organization, robot, house
words.translation: 机器；机械；机械，[机]机器；机构；机械般工作的人

examples.en: Could you get me a coffee from the drinks machine ?
examples.zh: 给我从自动饮料机里买一罐咖啡好吗？

examples.en: The fax machine is broken.
examples.zh: 传真机坏了。

examples.en: Did you put my dirty shirts in the machine (= washing machine ) ?
examples.zh: 你把我的脏衬衫放进洗衣机里了吗？

words.definition: crazy or very silly; crazy, possessed, foolish, stupid, bugs; fury, agriothymia
words.translation: 发疯的；恼火的；疯狂的；愚蠢的；着迷的；狂怒

examples.en: He can’t possibly get that finished in time. He must be mad !
examples.zh: 他不可能按时完成的。他一定是疯了！

examples.en: I’d go mad (= start to feel crazy ) if I was stuck at home all day.
examples.zh: 如果我整天困在家里我会发疯的。

examples.en: He’s been driving me mad !
examples.zh: 他真让我受不了！

words.definition: used to address a woman in a polite way, especially a customer in a shop; Mrs, Miss, wife
words.translation: 夫人，女士，太太；夫人；女士；鸨母

examples.en: Are you being served, Madam?
examples.zh: 有人接待您吗，夫人？

words.definition: a large thin book with a paper cover that contains news stories, articles, photographs etc, and is sold weekly or monthly; journal, mags
words.translation: 杂志，期刊；杂志；弹药库；胶卷盒

examples.en: a magazine article
examples.zh: 杂志中的文章

examples.en: She glanced over the magazine racks.
examples.zh: 她扫了一眼杂志架。

words.definition: the power to make impossible things happen by saying special words or doing special actions; medicine, witchcraft, wizardry; mysterious, fantastic, miraculous
words.translation: 魔法，巫术；戏法；巫术；魔法；不可思议的；有魔力的；魔术的

examples.en: Do you believe in magic?
examples.zh: 你相信魔法吗？

words.definition: the letters and packages that are delivered to you; to send a letter or package to someone; armour, dawk; send off, pack off
words.translation: 邮件；邮寄；邮政，[邮]邮递；盔甲；寄出

examples.en: You shouldn’t read other people’s mail.
examples.zh: 你不应该看别人的信件。

examples.en: He found a mountain of mail waiting for him.
examples.zh: 他发现有堆积如山的邮件等着他处理。

examples.en: She promised to forward my mail to my new address (= send it from your old home or office to your new one ) .
examples.zh: 她答应把我的邮件转寄到我的新地址。

words.definition: larger or more important than all other things, ideas etc of the same kind; core, body, chief, heart, essential; primary, major, central, ruling, great
words.translation: 主要的，最重要的；主要部分，要点；体力；[材]总管道；全力的

examples.en: The main reason for living in Spain is the weather.
examples.zh: 居住在西班牙的主要原因是天气。

examples.en: What do you consider to be the main problem?
examples.zh: 你认为最主要的问题是什么？

examples.en: Our main concern is that the children are safe.
examples.zh: 我们最关心的是保证孩子们的安全。

words.definition: to direct or control a business or department and the people, equipment, and money involved in it; possess, run, regulate, conduct, direct; cope with, handle with
words.translation: 管理；设法；对付；经营；控制；处理；应付过去

examples.en: He was asked to manage a new department.
examples.zh: 他被要求去管理一个新的部门。

examples.en: Managing a football team is harder than you think.
examples.zh: 管理一支足球队比你想象的要难。

examples.en: The company had been very badly managed.
examples.zh: 公司管理非常糟糕。

words.definition: someone whose job is to manage part or all of a company or other organization; executive, gerente
words.translation: 经理，管理人；经理；管理人员

examples.en: one of our regional managers
examples.zh: 我们的一位地区经理

examples.en: a middle manager in a computer company
examples.zh: 一家计算机公司的中层管理人员

words.definition: a drawing of a particular area, for example a city or country, which shows its main features, such as its roads, rivers, mountains etc; schedule, propose, design, project; conventional diagram, schematic plan
words.translation: 地图；图；天体图；映射；计划；绘制地图；确定基因在染色体中的位置；[测]地图；示意图；染色体图

examples.en: According to the map we should turn left.
examples.zh: 从地图上看，我们应该左拐。

words.definition: the third month of the year, between February and April; demonstration, anabasis; step by, road to
words.translation: 三月；行军，进军；进行曲；示威游行；进军；走过

examples.en: I flew to Milwaukee in early March.
examples.zh: 我3月初飞到了密尔沃基。

words.definition: a small area of darker or lighter colour on a plain surface such as a person’s skin or an animal’s fur; to show where something is; symbol, sign, seal, flag, trace; signal
words.translation: 斑点；记号；标明；标志；马克；符号；痕迹；做标记于；打分数

examples.en: The kitten is mainly white with black marks on her back.
examples.zh: 小猫身体基本为白色，背上有黑色斑点。

words.definition: a particular country or area where a company sells its goods or where a particular type of goods is sold; exchanges, store, shop, outlet, plaza
words.translation: 市场；集市；销路；行情；股票市场；市面；[贸易]集市；商店

examples.en: Our main overseas market is Japan.
examples.zh: 我们的主要海外市场是日本。

words.definition: the relationship between two people who are married, or the state of being married; wedding, merger, consolidation, coalition
words.translation: 结婚，婚姻；婚礼；结婚；婚姻生活；密切结合，合并

examples.en: She has three daughters from a previous marriage.
examples.zh: 她前一次婚姻生了三个女儿。

words.definition: if you marry someone, you become their husband or wife; go to the world, be married to; get married, tie the knot, get hitched, change one's condition, make a match
words.translation: 娶，嫁；结婚；嫁；娶；与……结婚

examples.en: He married Bea in 1925.
examples.zh: 他在1925年娶了贝亚。

examples.en: I’m going to ask her to marry me on St Valentine’s Day.
examples.zh: 我打算在情人节向她求婚。

examples.en: She married young (= at a young age ) .
examples.zh: 她结婚早。

words.definition: someone who is very skilled at something; possess, contain, regulate, bit, bottle; teacher, professor, artist, host, great; experienced, primary, major, skilled, central
words.translation: 主人；能手；硕士；控制；精通；征服；大师；教师；主人的；主要的；熟练的

examples.en: a work of art by a true master
examples.zh: 一件真正的大师之作

words.definition: an organized sports event between two teams or people; equal, rival; suit, balance; competition, game, tournament, play, contest
words.translation: 比赛，竞赛；对手；使比赛；使相配；敌得过，比得上；相配；与…竞争；比赛；匹配；相配，相称；相比；火柴

examples.en: It’s our last match of the season.
examples.zh: 这是我们本赛季最后一场比赛。

examples.en: They’re preparing for a big match tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他们在为明天的一场大赛做准备。

examples.en: McClaire’s goal earned him the title of man of the match (= the person in a team who plays best ) .
examples.zh: 麦克莱尔的进球为他赢得了“本场最佳球员”的称号。

words.translation: 数学（等于mathematics）

words.definition: if something may happen or may be true, there is a possibility that it will happen or be true but this is not certain; should, must, would
words.translation: aux可能；可以，祝；可能，可以；愿意

examples.en: I may be late, so don’t wait for me.
examples.zh: 我可能会迟到，所以别等我。

examples.en: Some chemicals may cause environmental damage.
examples.zh: 有些化学物品可能会给环境造成破坏。

examples.en: There may not be enough money to pay for the repairs.
examples.zh: 可能钱不够支付修理费。

words.definition: used to say that something may happen or may be true but you are not certain; perhaps, possibly, probably, like; possibility, probability, feasibility, potential, chance
words.translation: 大概，或许；也许；可能；大概；可能性；不确定性

examples.en: Maybe it’s all just a big misunderstanding.
examples.zh: 也许这只是一个很大的误会。

examples.en: ‘Do you think he’ll come back?’ ‘Maybe.’
examples.zh: “你认为他会回来吗？”“也许会吧。”

examples.en: Maybe they’re right, but maybe not .
examples.zh: 也许他们是对的，但也许不是。

words.definition: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself; self, ego
words.translation: (宾格)我；自我；极端自私的人；自我的一部分

examples.en: Stop, you’re hurting me.
examples.zh: 住手，你弄疼我了。

examples.en: He bought me a drink.
examples.zh: 他给我买了一杯酒。

examples.en: Give that book to me.
examples.zh: 把那本书给我。

words.definition: an occasion when you eat food, for example breakfast or dinner, or the food that you eat on that occasion; board, feed; have a dinner, dine
words.translation: 膳食，一餐；一餐，一顿饭；膳食；进餐

examples.en: We must have a meal together some time.
examples.zh: 我们一定要找个时间一起吃顿饭。

examples.en: Dinner is the main meal of the day for most people.
examples.zh: 晚饭是大多数人一天中的主餐。

words.definition: the thing or idea that a word, expression, or sign represents; significance, intention, will, import, offer; significant, eloquent
words.translation: 意义，意思；意图；意义；含义；意味深长的

examples.en: What’s the meaning of this? I asked you to be here an hour ago!
examples.zh: 这是什么意思？我让你一小时之前就要到的！

words.definition: the flesh of animals and birds eaten as food; flesh, carne
words.translation: 肉；[食品]肉，肉类（食用）

examples.zh: 我几个月以前开始不吃肉了。

examples.en: raw meat
examples.zh: 生肉

examples.en: a meat pie
examples.zh: 肉馅饼

words.definition: relating to medicine and the treatment of disease or injury; iatrical; doctor, hakeem
words.translation: 医学的；内科的；药的；医生；体格检查

examples.zh: 医学研究

examples.zh: 医务人员

examples.en: a medical student
examples.zh: 医科学生

words.definition: the treatment and study of illnesses and injuries; drug, pharmacon
words.translation: 内服药；医学；[医学][药物][药]药；[内科]内科；巫术

examples.en: She studied medicine at Johns Hopkins University.
examples.zh: 她曾在约翰•霍普金斯大学学医。

examples.en: the remarkable achievements of modern medicine
examples.zh: 现代医学的非凡成就

words.definition: an event at which people meet to discuss and decide things; session, congress, assembly, gathering; rendezvousing
words.translation: 聚集，会合，会见；会议；会见；集会；汇合点；会面；会合（meet的ing形式）

examples.en: We’re having a meeting next week to discuss the matter.
examples.zh: 我们下周将开会讨论此事。

words.definition: a person or country that belongs to a group or organization; fellow, insider
words.translation: 成员，会员；成员；会员；议员

examples.en: The majority of union members voted in favour of a strike.
examples.zh: 大多数工会成员投票赞成罢工。

words.definition: someone’s ability to remember things, places, experiences etc; mind, retention
words.translation: 记忆；回忆；存储；[心理]记忆，记忆力；内存，[计]存储器

examples.en: He has lots of happy memories of his stay in Japan.
examples.zh: 他对在日本逗留的那段时光有许多美好的回忆。

words.definition: to repair a tear or hole in a piece of clothing; improve, repair, doctor, modify; change for the better, polish up; reforming, improvement in
words.translation: 修理，修补，缝补；修理，修补；改善；修改；改善，好转；好转，改进；修补处

examples.en: My father used to mend our shoes.
examples.zh: 我父亲过去常为我们修补鞋子。

words.definition: to talk or write about something or someone, usually quickly and without saying very much or giving details; indicate to, make reference to; reference, allusion
words.translation: 提及，说起；提到，谈到；提及，论及；说起

examples.en: Was my name mentioned at all?
examples.zh: 我的名字被提到过吗？

examples.en: Some of the problems were mentioned in his report.
examples.zh: 其中的一些问题在他的报告里提到了。

examples.en: (= it is important enough to mention ) that they only studied a very small number of cases.
examples.zh: 必须说明的是他们仅研究了几个个案。

words.definition: a list of all the kinds of food that are available for a meal, especially in a restaurant; carte, memu
words.translation: 菜单；[计]菜单

examples.en: Could we have the menu, please?
examples.zh: 请把菜单给我们，好吗？

examples.en: a three course set menu
examples.zh: 三道菜的套餐

words.definition: a spoken or written piece of information that you send to another person or leave for them; news, prediction, word; inform of, report to; give notice, instruct, advise of
words.translation: 信息，消息；启示；消息；差使；预言；广告词；报信，报告；[通信]报文；通知

examples.en: He left a message saying he would probably be a little late.
examples.zh: 他留言说可能会晚一点来。

words.definition: a hard, usually shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel; alloy
words.translation: 金属，金属制品；[材]金属；合金

examples.en: The gate is made of metal.
examples.zh: 这扇大门是用金属做成的。

examples.en: a small black metal box
examples.zh: 一个黑色的金属小盒子

examples.en: They traded in gold and other precious metals (= valuable metals used especially for making jewellery ) .
examples.zh: 他们做黄金和其他贵金属的交易。

words.definition: a planned way of doing something, especially one that a lot of people know about and use; approach, way, system, medium, how
words.translation: 方法，办法；教学法；方法；条理；类函数

examples.en: traditional teaching methods
examples.zh: 传统的教学法

examples.en: I think we should try again using a different method.
examples.zh: 我想我们应该用不同的方法再试一次。

examples.en: effective methods for the storage and retrieval of information
examples.zh: 信息存储和检索的有效方法

words.definition: the part that is nearest the centre of something, and furthest from the sides, edges, top, bottom etc; nearest the centre and furthest from the edge, top, end etc; medium, mid, intermediary, secondary, moderate; center, waist; double up, double back; double over
words.translation: 中部；中部的；中间的，中部的；中级的，中等的；中间，中央；腰部；把…放在中间，把…对折；放在中间，对折

examples.en: There are plenty of small houses for sale, and quite a lot of very large ones, but very little in the middle.
examples.zh: 在售的小房子很多，大房子也有不少，但是不大不小的很少。

words.definition: a unit for measuring distance, equal to 1,760  yard s  or about 1,609 metres
words.translation: 英里

examples.en: It’s 40 miles from here to the Polish border.
examples.zh: 从这里到波兰边界有40英里。

examples.en: an area 50 miles wide and 150 miles long
examples.zh: 一片50英里宽、150英里长的地区

examples.en: We walked about half a mile .
examples.zh: 我们大约走了半英里。

words.definition: a white liquid produced by cows or goats that is drunk by people; to take milk from a cow or goat; lait, creamery; extract, ream
words.translation: 乳，牛奶；挤(奶)；[食品]牛奶；[化学]乳状物；榨取；挤…的奶

examples.en: a bottle of milk
examples.zh: 一瓶奶

examples.en: Would you like some milk in your tea?
examples.zh: 你茶里要加点奶吗？

examples.en: a pint of semi-skimmed milk
examples.zh: 一品脱半脱脂奶

words.definition: your thoughts or your ability to think, feel, and imagine things; opinion, intelligence, energy, memory, spirit; devote one's attention to, concentrate upon; take care of, take notice
words.translation: 头脑；理智；记忆；理智，精神；意见；[心理]智力；记忆力；介意；专心于；照料；注意

examples.en: It is impossible to understand the complex nature of the human mind .
examples.zh: 要想了解人类思维复杂的特性是不可能的。

examples.en: Mind and body are closely related.
examples.zh: 思想和肉体紧密相连。

examples.en: Meditation involves focusing the mind on a single object or word.
examples.zh: 冥想需要把思想集中在一个物体或单词上。

words.definition: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with himself or herself; ore, pit; exploit
words.translation: 我的；矿，矿藏；矿山，矿井；地雷，水雷；开采，采掘；在…布雷

examples.en: It was Glen’s idea, not mine.
examples.zh: 这是格伦的主意，不是我的。

examples.en: ‘Is that your car?’ ‘No, mine is parked over the road.’
examples.zh: “那是你的车吗？”“不是，我的车停在路对面。”

examples.en: You’ve got good legs – mine are too thin.
examples.zh: 你的腿很美——我的腿太细了。

words.definition: a unit for measuring time. There are 60 minutes in one hour; cent, moments, note, while, penny; tiny, strict, micro, detailed, particular
words.translation: 分，分钟；一会儿；[计量][数]分，分钟；片刻，一会儿；备忘录，笔记；会议记录；微小的，详细的

examples.en: It takes me ten minutes to walk to work.
examples.zh: 我步行上班要用十分钟。

examples.en: The train arrived at four minutes past eight.
examples.zh: 火车于八点零四分到达。

examples.en: He returned a few minutes later.
examples.zh: 几分钟后他回来了。

words.definition: a piece of special glass that you can look at and see yourself in; if one thing mirrors another, it is very similar to it and may seem to copy or represent it; example, lead; glass, image, echo
words.translation: 镜子；反映，反射；[轻]镜子；真实的写照；榜样；[光]反射；反映

examples.en: He spends hours in front of the mirror !
examples.zh: 他老是照镜子！

examples.en: When I looked in the mirror I couldn’t believe it. I looked fantastic!
examples.zh: 我看着镜子简直不敢相信，我看上去棒极了！

words.definition: used in front of the family name of a woman who is not married to address her politely, to write to her, or to talk about her; lose, let slip
words.translation: 小姐；漏掉；错过；想念

examples.en: I’d like to make an appointment with Miss Taylor.
examples.zh: 我想约一下泰勒小姐。

words.definition: a small copy of a building, vehicle, machine etc, especially one that can be put together from separate parts; matrix, former, shape, fashion, type; mold, simulate, pattern, form, imitate
words.translation: 模型；模式；模特儿；典型；模范；样式；模拟；塑造；模仿

examples.en: a working model (= one with parts which move ) of a steam engine
examples.zh: 蒸汽机车的活动模型

words.definition: belonging to the present time or most recent time; recent, fashionable, in, tony; Homo sapiens sapiens
words.translation: 现代的，近代的；时髦的；现代人；有思想的人

examples.en: Such companies must change if they are to compete in the modern world .
examples.zh: 此类公司如果想在现代社会中与别人竞争，就必须有所改变。

examples.en: They are the youngest children in modern times to face murder charges.
examples.zh: 他们是近代面临谋杀指控儿童中年龄最小的。

examples.en: Smaller families are a feature of modern society .
examples.zh: 家庭规模变小是现代社会的一个特征。

words.definition: a particular point in time; importance, breath, second, magnitude, instant

examples.zh: 这是他一生中最激动人心的时刻之一。

examples.en: She may be in trouble at this very moment and trying to call you.
examples.zh: 此时此刻她可能遇到了麻烦，正想方设法给你打电话。

examples.en: I remember the moment when I first saw him after the operation.
examples.zh: 我还记得手术后第一次见到他的那一刻。

words.definition: the day between Sunday and Tuesday
words.translation: 星期一

examples.zh: 总统周一宣布他会取消这笔债务。

words.definition: what you earn by working and can use to buy things. Money can be in the form of notes and coins or cheques, and can be kept in a bank; currency, wealth, treasure, fortune, QIAN
words.translation: 货币；金钱，财富；钱；[金融]货币；财富

examples.en: Don’t spend all your money on the first day of your holiday!
examples.zh: 别在度假的第一天就把钱都花完了！

examples.en: The repairs will cost quite a lot of money.
examples.zh: 修理要花一大笔钱。

words.definition: to carefully watch and check a situation in order to see how it changes over a period of time; detectophone, invigilator

examples.zh: 使用这种新药的病人将被要求监测病情进展。

examples.zh: 政府正密切关注着局势。

examples.en: The temperature is carefully monitored .
examples.zh: 温度受到仔细的监控。

words.definition: a small brown animal with a long tail, which uses its hands to climb trees and lives in hot countries; urchin, simian; horse around, mess about; guy, make game of

examples.zh: 那只猴子到处乱窜。

examples.zh: 这只猴子囫囵吞下食物。

examples.en: The monkey had deflowered an entire section of the garden.
examples.zh: 这只猴子把花园中一整块地方的花都糟蹋了。

words.translation: 月，月份；[天]月，一个月的时间

examples.zh: 我希望我这个月底能完成工作。

examples.zh: 她每月约挣350英镑。

examples.en: We update the schedule at least once a month.
examples.zh: 我们至少每月更新一次日程表。

words.definition: the round object that you can see shining in the sky at night, and that moves around the Earth every 28 days; satellite, parish lantern; muck about, fool around; dream away, idle

examples.zh: 月球表面的环形山

examples.zh: 美国人于1969年登上月球。

examples.en: The moon appeared from behind a cloud.
examples.zh: 月亮从云后钻了出来。

words.definition: the early part of the day, from when the sun rises until 12 o’clock in the middle of the day; prime, sunrise
words.translation: 早晨，上午；早晨；黎明；初期

examples.zh: 我讨厌冬天里寒冷的早晨。

examples.zh: 今天早上我觉得不大舒服。

examples.en: He stayed in bed late on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 星期日早上他睡到很晚。

words.definition: a female parent of a child or animal; mater, madre; raise, foster, breed; maternal, natal

examples.zh: 他的父母都是医生。

examples.en: the relationship between mother and child
examples.zh: 母亲和孩子之间的关系

examples.en: Goodnight, Mother.
examples.zh: 晚安，妈妈。

words.definition: a fast two-wheeled vehicle with an engine; autocycle, motor van
words.translation: 摩托车, 机车；[车辆]摩托车；机动车

examples.zh: 你最好马上卖掉摩托车换成现款。

examples.zh: 她摩托车都会骑， 自行车更不在话下了。

examples.en: He runs behind a motorcycle for half an hour every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早晨跟在摩托车后面跑半个小时。

words.definition: a very high hill; range, cordillera
words.translation: 山，山岳；山脉；[地理]山

examples.en: the highest mountain in Austria
examples.zh: 奥地利最高的山

examples.en: the Rocky Mountains
examples.zh: 落基山脉

examples.en: a steep mountain road
examples.zh: 陡峭的山路

words.definition: the part of your face which you put food into, or which you use for speaking; jaws, ostium; grumble

examples.zh: 他把玻璃杯举到嘴边。

examples.zh: 利亚姆大张着嘴，睡得很熟。

examples.zh: 火车行驶时请保持车门关闭。

examples.zh: “来吧。”休说。但没有人动。

examples.en: Could you move your car, please? It’s blocking the road.
examples.zh: 你能把车挪一下吗？挡着路了。

words.definition: a film made to be shown at the cinema or on television; film, cinema, theater; motion-picture, cinematic
words.translation: 电影；电影院；[电影]电影；电影业；[电影]电影的

examples.en: It was like one of those old John Wayne movies.
examples.zh: 这部电影有点像约翰•韦恩演的一部老片子。

words.definition: the crime of deliberately killing someone; murther; killing, rubout
words.translation: 谋杀，凶杀

examples.zh: 凶案发生当晚他不在国内。

examples.en: The man accused of her murder will appear in court today.
examples.zh: 被指控谋杀她的那名男子将于今天出庭。

examples.en: He was found guilty of attempted murder .
examples.zh: 他被判谋杀未遂。

words.definition: a building where important  cultural  , historical, or scientific objects are kept and shown to the public
words.translation: 博物馆；展览馆

examples.en: the Museum of Modern Art
examples.zh: 现代艺术博物馆

examples.en: The museum has an extensive collection of early photographs.
examples.zh: 这座博物馆藏有大量早期的照片。

words.definition: a series of sounds made by instruments or voices in a way that is pleasant or exciting
words.translation: 音乐，乐曲，乐谱

examples.zh: 我在车上经常听古典音乐。

examples.en: A new piece of music was specially written for the occasion.
examples.zh: 为了这个活动专门写了一首新曲子。

words.definition: to have to do something because it is necessary or important, or because of a law or order; may, shall, ought
words.translation: aux必须；必然要；必须，一定；可以，应当；很可能

examples.zh: 所有乘客都必须系安全带。

examples.en: It’s getting late. I really must go.
examples.zh: 天晚了，我真的必须走了。

examples.en: You must work hard.
examples.zh: 你必须努力工作。

words.definition: oh, dear
words.translation: 我的；哎呀（表示惊奇等）；喔唷

examples.en: All my friends do not smoke.
examples.zh: 我的朋友并不全都吸烟。

examples.en: Then you must be my cousin.
examples.zh: 那么你一定是我的远亲了。

words.definition: used by the person speaking or writing to show that they are affected by their own action
words.translation: 我自己；我亲自

examples.en: I blame myself for what has happened.
examples.zh: 发生这一切都怪我自己。

examples.en: I can look after myself.
examples.zh: 我可以照顾好自己。

examples.en: I’m making myself a sandwich.
examples.zh: 我在给自己做三明治。

words.definition: what someone is called; to say what the name of someone or something is, especially officially; reputation, Bezeichnung; install, constitute, place, style, call
words.translation: 名字；名誉；说出；名称，名字；姓名；命名，任命；指定；称呼；提名；叫出

examples.en: Her name is Mandy Wilson.
examples.zh: 她的名字是曼迪•威尔逊。

examples.en: What’s your name?
examples.zh: 你叫什么名字？

words.definition: related to a whole nation as opposed to any of its parts; state, natl; subject
words.translation: 民族的；国家的；国民的；国立的；国民

examples.zh: 宗教事务在全国都非常重要。

examples.en: Between 1929 and 1933 America’s national income fell by more than half.
examples.zh: 1929至1933年间，美国的国民收入下降过半。

examples.en: There are strong indications that the Prime Minister will call national elections in May.
examples.zh: 有明显迹象预示首相将于5月召集全国大选。

words.definition: existing in nature and not caused, made, or controlled by people; material, physical, born, spontaneous; idiot, baichi

examples.en: the study of the natural world
examples.zh: 对自然界的研究

examples.en: an area of spectacular natural beauty
examples.zh: 自然风景秀丽的地区

examples.en: death from natural causes
examples.zh: 自然死亡

words.definition: everything in the physical world that is not controlled by humans, such as wild plants and animals, earth and rocks, and the weather; property, category, variety, manner, kind
words.translation: 大自然；本性；性质；自然；种类

examples.en: We grew up in the countryside, surrounded by the beauties of nature.
examples.zh: 我们在乡村长大，周围是美丽的大自然。

examples.en: nature conservation
examples.zh: 自然保护

examples.en: Disease is nature’s way of keeping the population down.
examples.zh: 疾病是大自然控制人口的方法。

words.definition: only a short distance from a person or thing; only a short distance away from someone or something; familiar, close; rising, forbye; next, anigh
words.translation: 近，接近；近的；亲近的；近似的；近；接近；靠近；近似于

examples.en: They live near London.
examples.zh: 他们住在伦敦附近。

examples.en: I’m sure they live somewhere near here.
examples.zh: 我肯定他们就住在这附近。

examples.en: They moved house to be nearer the school.
examples.zh: 他们把家搬到离学校近一些。

words.definition: almost, but not quite or not completely; almost, most, virtually, practically
words.translation: 差不多；密切地；差不多，几乎
