examples.zh: 到这里花了将近两小时。

examples.en: Michelle’s nearly twenty.
examples.zh: 米歇尔年近二十。

examples.en: Is the job nearly finished?
examples.zh: 这工作快干完了吗？

words.definition: something that is necessary is what you need to have or need to do; inevitable, required, essential, certain, automatic; requirement, want
words.translation: 必要的；必然的；[数]必要的；必需的；必需品

examples.en: The booklet provides all the necessary information about the college.
examples.zh: 这本小册子提供了关于那所学院的所有必需信息。

examples.en: No further changes were considered necessary.
examples.zh: 没有必要作出进一步改变。

examples.en: The doctor says it may be necessary for me to have an operation.
examples.zh: 医生说我可能需要做手术。

words.definition: the part of your body that joins your head to your shoulders, or the same part of an animal or bird; narrow, channel, sound, collar
words.translation: 颈，脖子；脖子；衣领；海峡

examples.en: Mike rubbed the back of his neck.
examples.zh: 迈克揉了揉后颈。

examples.en: You have a lot of tension in your neck muscles.
examples.zh: 你的颈部肌肉很紧张。

examples.en: He patted his horse’s neck.
examples.zh: 他拍了拍马脖子。

words.definition: to have to have something or someone, because you cannot do something without them, or because you cannot continue or cannot exist without them; necessity, shortage, want, do, deficiency; ask, lack, claim, to require; wish, to require
words.translation: 需要；aux需要；需要，要求；缺乏；必要之物

examples.en: You don’t really need a car.
examples.zh: 你其实并不需要一辆车。

examples.en: Plants need light in order to survive.
examples.zh: 植物需要光才能存活。

examples.en: The camcorder needs a new battery.
examples.zh: 这台摄像机需要一块新电池。

words.definition: nor
words.translation: (两者)都不的；也不；既不

examples.en: She lives in retirement, neither making nor receiving visits.
examples.zh: 她过着隐退的生活， 既不访客， 也不见客。

words.definition: worried or frightened about something, and unable to relax; neural, jittery
words.translation: 神经的；易激动的；[解剖]神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的

examples.en: I wish you’d stop looking at me like that. You’re making me nervous.
examples.zh: 我希望你不要再那样看着我了，你让我紧张。

examples.en: By the time I got into the interview I was a nervous wreck (= was extremely nervous ).
examples.zh: 到了面试的时候，我紧张得要命。

words.definition: not at any time, or not once; none, nothing
words.translation: 永不，决不；不；从未；决不

examples.en: He’s never been to Australia.
examples.zh: 他从未去过澳大利亚。

examples.en: I’m never going back there again, not as long as I live.
examples.zh: 只要我活着，我再也不会回到那儿去。

examples.en: It is never too late to give up smoking.
examples.zh: 戒烟不言晚。

words.definition: recently made, built, invented, written, designed etc; fresh, updated; recently, freshly
words.translation: 新的；新近出现的；新的，新鲜的；更新的；初见的；新近

examples.en: the city’s new hospital
examples.zh: 市里新建的医院

examples.en: the new issue of ‘Time’ magazine
examples.zh: 新一期《时代周刊》

examples.en: new products on the market
examples.zh: 市场上的新产品

words.definition: information about something that has happened recently; message, word, press
words.translation: 新闻，消息；新闻报导

examples.en: I hope to have some good news for you soon.
examples.zh: 我希望很快就能给你好消息。

words.definition: a set of large folded sheets of printed paper containing news, articles, pictures, advertisements etc which is sold daily or weekly; paper, courant
words.translation: 报纸，报；报纸

examples.en: She had read about it in the newspapers.
examples.zh: 关于这件事她已经在报纸上看到了。

examples.en: a series of newspaper articles about life in Cuba
examples.zh: 刊登在报纸上的一系列关于古巴生活的文章

words.definition: Thenext place or person is the one that is nearest to you or that is the first one that you come to; secondly, then, afterwards; following, posterior; near, anigh
words.translation: 紧接的；贴近的；然后；下次；其次；下一个的；其次的；靠近；居于…之后

examples.en: Grace sighed so heavily that Trish could hear it in the next room.
examples.zh: 格雷丝沉重地叹气，特蕾什在隔壁房间都听到了。

examples.en: The man in the next chair was asleep.
examples.zh: 邻座的男子睡着了。

words.definition: pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable; precision, exact, narrow, kind, benign
words.translation: 美好的，令人愉快的；精密的；美好的；细微的；和蔼的

examples.en: They’ve got a very nice house.
examples.zh: 他们的房子真漂亮。

examples.en: Did you have a nice time?
examples.zh: 你们玩得开心吗？

examples.en: It’s such a nice day (= good weather ), why not go for a swim?
examples.zh: 天气真好，为什么不去游泳呢？

words.definition: the dark part of each 24-hour period when the sun cannot be seen and when most people sleep; evening, nocte; vesperal
words.translation: 夜，夜间；夜晚，晚上；黑暗，黑夜；夜晚的，夜间的

examples.en: It was a cold moonlit night.
examples.zh: 那是个寒冷的月夜。

examples.en: I didn’t sleep too well last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚睡得不太好。

words.definition: the number 9
words.translation: 九，九个

examples.en: He’s only been in this job for nine months.
examples.zh: 他干这份工作才九个月。

examples.en: We open at nine (= nine o’clock ).
examples.zh: 我们9点开始营业。

examples.en: Kay was taught by her mother till she was nine (= nine years old ).
examples.zh: 凯一直由她妈妈教到九岁。

words.definition: the number 19
words.translation: 十九，十九个

examples.en: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
examples.zh: 当时是7点19分。

examples.en: I was only nineteen (= 19 years old ).
examples.zh: 我当时只有19岁。

words.definition: the number 90
words.translation: 九十，九十个

examples.en: America was far richer in the nineties.
examples.zh: 90年代的美国要富裕得多。

words.definition: one of nine equal parts of something
words.translation: 第九；九分之一

examples.en: In that region, Chile went from ninth to first, overall, as Chilean mobile web use increased by 3200% over the past year.
examples.zh: 智利从这一地区的第九跃升到第一位，因为智利的移动网络用户在过去一年增长了 3200% 。

words.definition: used to give a negative reply to a question, offer, or request; not, non, n't; nah
words.translation: 不；并不；没有；不是

examples.en: ‘Are you Italian?’ ‘No, I’m Spanish.’
examples.zh: “你是意大利人吗？”“不，我是西班牙人。”

examples.en: ‘Do you want any more?’ ‘No thanks.’
examples.zh: “你还要再来点吗？”“不要了，谢谢。”

examples.en: ‘Could you help me write this?’ ‘No, sorry, I haven’t got time at the moment.’
examples.zh: “你能帮我写这个吗？”“抱歉，不行，我现在没时间。”

words.definition: no one; small potatoes, worm
words.translation: 谁也不；无人；无名小卒；小人物

examples.en: I knocked on the door but nobody answered.
examples.zh: 我敲了敲门，但没人应门。

words.definition: to move your head up and down, especially in order to show agreement or understanding; swing, bob; noddle; to oscillate, to swing
words.translation: 点(头)；点头表示；点头；打盹；摆动

examples.en: I asked her if she was ready to go, and she nodded.
examples.zh: 我问她是否已准备好出发，她点了点头。

examples.en: Mom nodded her head sympathetically.
examples.zh: 妈妈同情地点了点头。

words.definition: a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or frightening; row-de-dow, klang; rumor; make a sound
words.translation: 喧闹声；响声；噪声；噪音；[环境]杂音；谣传；发出声音；大声议论

examples.en: What’s that noise?
examples.zh: 那是什么声音？

examples.en: Try not to make a noise when you go upstairs.
examples.zh: 上楼时尽量不要弄出声。

examples.en: There was a lot of noise outside.
examples.zh: 外面很吵闹。

words.definition: not any amount of something or not one of a group of people or things; not having any more understanding or knowledge about something than you had before; lacking, void of; nothing, noway
words.translation: 没有人；毫不；没有的，一点没有的；决不，一点也不

examples.en: I wish I could offer you some cake but there’s none left.
examples.zh: 我真想能请你吃些蛋糕，但一点也没剩的了。

examples.en: Although these were good students, none had a score above 60.
examples.zh: 虽然这些都是好学生，但是没有一个考到60分以上。

examples.en: She waited for a reply, but none came.
examples.zh: 她等着答复，可是什么也没等到。

words.translation: 面条；笨蛋

words.definition: 12 o’clock in the daytime; midday, midnoon
words.translation: 正午，中午；中午；[天]正午；全盛期

examples.en: We met at 12 noon.
examples.zh: 我们中午12点见了面。

words.definition: used when mentioning two things that are not true or do not happen; neither
words.translation: 也不；不；也不是

examples.en: He can neither read nor write (= he cannot read or write ).
examples.zh: 他既不会读也不会写。

examples.en: Hilary was neither shocked nor surprised by the news.
examples.zh: 希拉里对这个消息既没有感到震惊，也没有觉得意外。

examples.en: Neither Matt nor Julie said anything.
examples.zh: 马特和朱莉都没有说什么。

words.definition: usual, typical, or expected; standard, arm's-length; criterion, standard, level, prototype
words.translation: 正常的，普通的；[数]正常的；正规的，标准的；正常；标准；常态

examples.en: A normal working week is 40 hours.
examples.zh: 一个正常的工作周是40小时。

examples.en: She was assessed in the normal way, and placed on the waiting list.
examples.zh: 她接受了正常的评估后被列入等候名单。

examples.en: All I want is to lead a normal life.
examples.zh: 我想要的只是能过正常的生活。

words.definition: the direction that is at the top of a map of the world, above the Equator. It is on the left if you are facing the rising sun; in the north or facing the north; nord; boreal
words.translation: 北，北方；北方的；[测]北，[地理]北方；[地理]北方的；朝北的

examples.en: Which way is north?
examples.zh: 哪边是北？

words.definition: in or from the north of a country or area; boreal, upstate
words.translation: 北方的，北部的；[地理]北部的；北方的

examples.en: a man with a northern accent
examples.zh: 带有北方口音的男子

examples.en: Northern Europe
examples.zh: 北欧

words.definition: the part of a person’s or animal’s face used for smelling or breathing; smell, boko; smell, snuff at; ask after
words.translation: 鼻子；突出部分；嗅觉；突出的部分；探问；嗅；用鼻子触；小心探索着前进

examples.en: Someone punched him on the nose.
examples.zh: 有人一拳打在他的鼻子上。

words.definition: used to make a word, statement, or question negative; no, non, n't
words.translation: 不，没有；不（用于否定句）

examples.en: Most of the stores do not open until 10 am.
examples.zh: 大多数商店要到上午10点才开始营业。

examples.en: She’s not a very nice person.
examples.zh: 她为人不太好。

examples.en: You were wrong not to inform the police.
examples.zh: 你没有通知警方是错误的。

words.definition: information that a student writes down during a lesson, from a book etc; bill, minute, William; watching, register, take care of
words.translation: 笔记；便条；注释；[声]音符；[金融]票据；注解；纸币；便笺；照会；调子；注意；记录

examples.en: Can I borrow your lecture notes?
examples.zh: 我能不能借用一下你的课堂笔记？

words.definition: a book made of plain paper on which you can write notes; manual, jotter
words.translation: 笔记本，期票簿；笔记本，笔记簿；手册

examples.en: He brought out a notebook and pen from his pocket.
examples.zh: 他从口袋里掏出了一个笔记本和一支钢笔。

words.definition: not anything or no thing; to have no qualities or features that are similar to someone or something else; nil, nonbeing; none, nowise
words.translation: 没有东西；毫不；无；零；不关紧要之事；决不

examples.en: Nothing ever happens in this town.
examples.zh: 这镇上从来都不会发生什么特别的事。

examples.en: There’s nothing in this box.
examples.zh: 这盒子里什么也没有。

examples.en: There was nothing else the doctors could do.
examples.zh: 医生们没有别的办法了。

words.definition: if you notice something or someone, you realize that they exist, especially because you can see, hear, or feel them; when you notice or pay attention to someone or something; advice, information, announcement, declaration, regard; message, observe; draw attention, make a dent
words.translation: 注意；通知；通知，布告；公告；注意到；留心；引起注意

examples.en: He noticed a woman in a black dress sitting across from him.
examples.zh: 他看到有位黑衣女子坐在他的对面。

examples.en: I didn’t notice any smoke.
examples.zh: 我没注意到有烟。

examples.en: Have you noticed any change in him?
examples.zh: 你注意到他有什么变化了吗？

words.definition: the 11th month of the year, between October and December
words.translation: 十一月

examples.en: And again in November.
examples.zh: 在十一月又一次。

examples.en: Too much snow in November.
examples.zh: 太多的大雪在十一月。

words.definition: You use now to refer to the present time, often in contrast to a time in the past or the future; soon, immediately, shortly; current, present, nowaday; present, these days; since, when, seeing
words.translation: 现在；立刻；于是；如今；现在的；目前；由于；既然

examples.en: She's a widow now.
examples.zh: 她现在是一个寡妇。

examples.en: But we are now a much more fragmented society.
examples.zh: 但是我们现在是一个更加四分五裂的社会。

words.definition: a word or sign that represents an amount or a quantity; figure, arithmetic, digital; control No., code name
words.translation: 数，数字；号码；[数]数；（杂志等的）期；数字；算术；编号；计入；数…的数目；使为数有限

examples.en: They wrote various numbers on a large sheet of paper.
examples.zh: 他们在一张大纸上写下了很多不同的数字。

examples.en: Add all the numbers together.
examples.zh: 把所有数字加起来。

words.definition: someone whose job is to look after people who are ill or injured, usually in a hospital; to look after someone who is ill or injured; cultivate, plant, rear; fend for, attend on; sister, amah
words.translation: 保姆；护士；看护；看护，护理；照顾；培养；给…喂奶；照料，护理；喂奶；当保姆；[医]护士；奶妈，保姆

examples.en: The nurse is coming to give you an injection.
examples.zh: 护士会来给你打针。

examples.en: The school nurse sent Sara home.
examples.zh: 学校的护士送萨拉回家。

examples.en: a male nurse
examples.zh: 男护士

words.definition: a solid thing that you can hold, touch, or see but that is not alive; target, goal, end, cause, aim; refuse, sit down on
words.translation: 物，物体；目的；目标；物体；客体；[语]宾语；反对；拒绝

examples.en: an everyday object such as a spoon
examples.zh: 调羹之类的日常用品

examples.en: a small metal object
examples.zh: 一个小金属物件

examples.en: scientists studying plants, animals, or inanimate objects
examples.zh: 研究植物、动物或无生命物体的科学家

words.definition: the tenth month of the year, between September and November
words.translation: 十月

examples.en: Most seasonal hiring is done in early October.
examples.zh: 多数季节性招聘是在10月初进行。

words.definition: used to show what a part belongs to or comes from; concerning, about, as for, with reference to, in relation to
words.translation: …的；由于；关于；属于；由…组成的

examples.en: the back of the house
examples.zh: 房子的后部

examples.en: the last scene of the movie
examples.zh: 电影的最后一个场景

examples.en: the end of the day
examples.zh: 一天的末了

words.definition: used to say how much of something someone has; removed, available, leisure
words.translation: (离)开；(停)止；远离的；空闲的

examples.en: How are you off for sports equipment? (= do you have enough? )
examples.zh: 你的体育运动装备够不够？

words.definition: to ask someone if they would like to have something, or to hold something out to them so that they can take it; a statement saying that you are willing to do something for someone or give them something; afford, undertake, try, tender, lend; proposal, intention, meaning, will, bid; occur, figure, come out
words.translation: 提供；提出；出价；试图；提议；意图；出现；献祭；求婚

examples.en: A number of groups offer their services free of charge.
examples.zh: 一些团体免费提供服务。

words.definition: a building that belongs to a company or organization, with rooms where people can work at desks; bureaux, government agency
words.translation: 办公室；处，局，社；[管理]办公室；政府机关；官职；营业处

examples.en: The department occupies an office just a mile from the White House.
examples.zh: 该部门就在离白宫一英里远的地方有个办公楼。

examples.en: Did you go to the office (= the office where you work ) today?
examples.zh: 今天你去办公室了吗？

examples.en: the increased demand for office space
examples.zh: 对办公室空间日益增长的需求

words.definition: someone who is in a position of authority in the army, navy etc; wardroom, Irvine; captain, boss, lead, to command
words.translation: 官员；干事；军官；军官，警官；公务员，政府官员；船长；指挥

examples.en: a commanding officer of the SAS
examples.zh: 英国空军特种部队的一名指挥官

words.definition: if something happens often, it happens regularly or many times; forever, frequently, always, oft
words.translation: 经常，常常；常常，时常

examples.en: She often works at the weekend.
examples.zh: 她周末经常要上班。

examples.en: If you wash your hair too often, it can get too dry.
examples.zh: 如果洗头过勤，头发会变得干枯。

examples.en: How often do you see your parents?
examples.zh: 你隔多久去看你父母？

words.definition: the thick dark liquid from under the ground from which petrol is produced; to put oil onto part of a machine or part of something that moves, to help it to move or work more smoothly; petroleum, geoline; gas, melt; thaw out
words.translation: 油；石油；加油于；[油脂]油；油画颜料；加油；涂油；使融化；融化；加燃油

examples.en: a rise in the price of oil
examples.zh: 石油价格的上涨

examples.en: the importance of protecting our oil supplies
examples.zh: 保护我们石油供应的重要性

examples.en: an oil refinery
examples.zh: 炼油厂

words.translation: 好的；不错的；行；很好；好；可以；对…表示同意；同意

words.definition: used to talk about how long a person or thing has lived or existed; ancient, aged, advanced
words.translation: 老的；…岁的；陈旧的，古老的；年老的

examples.en: How old are you?
examples.zh: 你多大年纪？

examples.en: Are you older than Sally?
examples.zh: 你比萨莉大吗？

examples.en: You’re old enough to get your own breakfast now.
examples.zh: 你现在已经长大，可以自己弄早餐了。

words.definition: used to say what part of someone or something is hit or touched; forward, antrorsely; towards, unto, at, concerning, about
words.translation: 在…上；在…旁；向前地；作用中，行动中；继续着；向，朝……；关于；在……之上；在……时候

examples.en: I wanted to punch him on the nose.
examples.zh: 我真想一拳打到他鼻子上。

examples.en: Matt kissed her on the cheek.
examples.zh: 马特亲吻了她的脸颊。

words.definition: on one occasion only; from the time when something happens; ever, e'er; breath, one time
words.translation: 一次；曾经；一次，一回

examples.en: I’ve only met her once.
examples.zh: 我只见过她一面。

examples.en: Paul’s been to Wexford once before.
examples.zh: 保罗曾去过韦克斯福德一次。

words.definition: the number 1; used to mean someone or something of a type that has already been mentioned or is known about; unique, sole; ane
words.translation: 一；一个人；一的；唯一的

examples.en: They had one daughter.
examples.zh: 他们有一个女儿。

examples.en: one hundred and twenty-one pounds
examples.zh: 121英镑

examples.en: Come back at one (= one o’clock ).
examples.zh: 1点钟回来。

words.definition: the reflexive form of one27
words.translation: 自己；亲自

examples.en: It is only through study that one really begins to know oneself.
examples.zh: 只有通过学习，一个人才能真正了解自己。

words.definition: not more than a particular number, age etc; used to say that there is one person, thing, or group in a particular situation and no others; merely, simply, but, just, barely; unique, one, sole; granted, but, and, yet, however
words.translation: 只，仅仅；唯一的；不料；唯一的，仅有的；最合适的；但是；不过；可是

examples.en: Naomi was only 17 when she got married.
examples.zh: 娜奥米结婚时才17岁。

examples.en: There are only a few cars on the island.
examples.zh: 这个岛上只有几辆汽车。

examples.en: It’s only eight o’clock.
examples.zh: 才8点钟。

words.definition: not closed, so that things, people, air etc can go in and out or be put in and out; to move a door, window etc so that people, things, air etc can pass through, or to be moved in this way; honest, transparent; proceed, lie; crack, disclose; publicity, daylight
words.translation: 开的；开放的；开；[电]公开的；敞开的；空旷的；坦率的；营业着的；开始；展现；公开；打开；空旷；户外

examples.en: He threw the door open and ran down the stairs.
examples.zh: 他猛地打开门，往楼下跑去。

examples.en: an open window
examples.zh: 打开的窗户

examples.en: The gates swung silently open.
examples.zh: 大门悄悄地打开了。

words.definition: a space or area, for example a particular point on a surface or in a room, building, town, city etc; district, seat; install, constitute, park, name; come to the top

examples.zh: 一定要把钥匙放在安全的地方。

examples.zh: 我这一天尽是在东奔西跑。

examples.zh: 那地方全是大叫大嚷的孩子们。

examples.zh: 他计划先取得经济学学位，然后去国外工作一年。

words.definition: A planet is a large, round object in space that moves around a star. The Earth is a planet.

examples.zh: 安妮塔把盘子推开；她其实什么都没吃。

words.definition: an area for children to play, especially at a school or in a park, that often has special equipment for climbing on, riding on etc; sports ground, athletic ground

examples.zh: 在操场上叫嚷奔跑的孩子们

words.translation: 令人愉快的，舒适的；讨人喜欢的，和蔼可亲的

examples.zh: 卢克走了进来，双手插在口袋里。

examples.en: The policeman told me to turn out my pockets (= take everything out of them ) .
examples.zh: 警察让我把口袋里的东西都掏出来。

examples.zh: …一本爱情诗集。

examples.zh: 那个观点很有趣。

words.translation: 人口；全体居民；种群，[生物]群体

examples.zh: 我们的酒店处于极佳的中心位置，在圣马克广场附近。

words.translation: 邮递员；邮差

examples.zh: 那个邮递员负责这条投递线路。

examples.en: The old man often stands here to watch out for the postman.
examples.zh: 老人常常站在这儿等邮递员。

examples.zh: 莫伊拉的体重约为130磅。

examples.zh: 学习弹吉他需要长时间的练习。

examples.zh: 稍微再练一练，你应该能通过考试了。

examples.zh: 简受到了老师的表扬。

examples.zh: 原告想要有更多的时间来准备诉讼。

examples.zh: 遭受贫困和疾病折磨的数百万人民的现状

examples.zh: 我们被阻止进入现场。

examples.zh: 女儿进来时他的内心充满了自豪感。

words.definition: most important; elementary, major, central, main, leading; original color, fundamental colour
words.translation: 主要的，基本的；主要的；[数]初级的；基本的；原色；最主要者

examples.en: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
examples.zh: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

examples.en: Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
examples.zh: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

examples.en: Personal safety is of primary importance .
examples.zh: 人身安全至关重要。

words.definition: to produce many printed copies of a book, newspaper etc; writing that has been printed, for example in books or newspapers; impression, seal; strike off; bring out, get out
words.translation: 印刷；正片；[印刷]印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记；[印刷]印刷；[计]打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样；出版

examples.en: Over five million copies of the paper are printed every day.
examples.zh: 这份报纸每日印量超过五百万。

examples.en: When the book was first written no publisher would print it.
examples.zh: 这本书刚写成时没有出版商愿意出版。

words.definition: a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime, or while they are waiting to go to court for their  trial; jail, big house; imprison, jail
words.translation: 监狱，监禁；[法]监狱；监禁；拘留所；监禁，关押

examples.en: He visits his dad in prison every week.
examples.zh: 他每周都去探望狱中的父亲。

examples.en: Ricky has been out of prison for three years now.
examples.zh: 里基现已出狱三年。

examples.en: They’ll probably put him in prison for a long time.
examples.zh: 他们很可能会让他在监狱里待很长时间。

words.definition: someone who is kept in a prison as a legal punishment for a crime or while they are waiting for their  trial; capture, galley slave
words.translation: 囚犯；囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告

examples.en: Relationships between the staff and the prisoners are good.
examples.zh: 狱警和犯人相处良好。

examples.en: Prisoners here only serve short sentences.
examples.zh: 这里的犯人只是短期服刑。

examples.en: The organization is arguing for the release of political prisoners (= people in prison because of their political opinions ) .
examples.zh: 该组织正在争取释放政治犯。

words.definition: for use by one person or group, not for everyone; chamber, cabinet; seaman second class
words.translation: 私人的；私有的；私下的；列兵；二等兵

examples.en: Morris has a private jet.
examples.zh: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

examples.en: He made some notes for his private use.
examples.zh: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

examples.en: They objected to any form of private property .
examples.zh: 他们反对任何形式的私有财产。

words.definition: something that is given to someone who is successful in a competition, race, game of chance etc; to think that someone or something is very important or valuable; award, capture; assess, acquire, evaluate, value, rate
words.translation: 奖赏，奖金；珍视；[劳经]奖品；奖赏；战利品；捕获；估价

examples.en: In this month’s competition you could win a prize worth £3,000.
examples.zh: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000英镑的奖品。

examples.en: The first prize has gone to Dr John Gentle.
examples.zh: 获得一等奖的是约翰·金特尔博士。

examples.en: The prizes are awarded (= given ) every year to students who have shown original thinking in their work.
examples.zh: 这些奖项每年颁发给在学习中表现出创造性思维的学生。

words.definition: a situation that causes difficulties; conundrum, puzzler; debatable, stubborn
words.translation: 问题；习题，问题；难题；引起麻烦的人；成问题的；难处理的

examples.en: She was older than me, but that wasn’t really a problem.
examples.zh: 她比我年长，不过那不算什么问题。

words.definition: to cause a particular result or effect; attract, cause, operate, occasion, induce; manufacture, work, agricultural products; turn out, bring in
words.translation: 生产；产生；展现；引起；创作；农产品，产品；生产，创作

examples.en: New drugs are producing remarkable results .
examples.zh: 新药正在产生显著的效果。

examples.en: a rise in sea level produced by climatic change
examples.zh: 由气候变化引起的海平面升高

examples.en: As a policy, it did not produce the desired effect .
examples.zh: 作为一项政策，它并未产生预期的效果。

words.definition: the process of getting better at doing something, or getting closer to finishing or achieving something; development, growth, making, advancement; wage, do, go ahead
words.translation: 前进，进展；进步；进步，发展；前进；前进，进步；进行

examples.en: We made good progress despite the snow.
examples.zh: 尽管下雪，我们的行程还是很顺利。

words.definition: a statement that you will definitely do or provide something or that something will definitely happen; to tell someone that you will definitely do or provide something or that something will happen; wish, hope, pleasure; pledge, vouchsafe
words.translation: 诺言；指望；允诺；许诺，允诺；希望；允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望

examples.en: If you make a promise, you should keep it.
examples.zh: 如果你许下一个诺言，你就应该遵守它。

words.definition: to make the sound of a letter, word etc, especially in the correct way; declare, pass sentence; articulate
words.translation: 发…的音；宣布；发音；宣判；断言；作出判断

examples.en: How do you pronounce your name?
examples.zh: 你的名字怎么念？

words.definition: the way in which a language or a particular word is pronounced; sonation, vocalization
words.translation: 发音，发音法；发音；读法

examples.en: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
examples.zh: 她给出了这个单词的法语发音。

words.definition: right, suitable, or correct; suitable, appropriate, adequate, typical, becoming; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, strictly, fully
words.translation: 适合的；合乎体统的；适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的；完全地

examples.en: Everything was in its proper place (= where it should be ) .
examples.zh: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

examples.en: the proper way to clean your teeth
examples.zh: 正确的刷牙方法

examples.en: The proper name for Matthew’s condition is hyperkinetic syndrome.
examples.zh: 马修的病的恰当名称是多动症。

words.definition: to keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or illness; secure, watch, preserve
words.translation: 保护，保卫，警戒；保护，防卫；警戒

examples.en: Are we doing enough to protect the environment?
examples.zh: 我们在保护环境方面做得够吗？

words.definition: feeling pleased about something that you have done or something that you own, or about someone or something you are involved with or related to; beamish, complacent
words.translation: 骄傲的；自豪的；得意的；自负的

examples.en: Seth was the proud owner of a new sports car.
examples.zh: 赛思因为有了新跑车而扬扬得意。

words.definition: to show that something is true by providing facts, information etc; demonstrate, reveal, make clear, argue
words.translation: 证明；结果是；检验；显示

examples.en: You’re wrong, and I can prove it.
examples.zh: 你错了，我可以证明。

examples.en: To prove his point (= show that he was right ) , he mentioned several other experiments which had produced similar results.
examples.zh: 为了证明自己的观点，他提到了另外几个结果相似的实验。

words.definition: to give something to someone or make it available to them, because they need it or want it; afford, define, regulate, tender, state; take care of, prime
words.translation: 提供；装备，供给；规定；准备；装备；抚养；作准备

examples.en: Tea and biscuits will be provided.
examples.zh: 有茶水和饼干供应。

words.definition: relating to all the ordinary people in a country, who are not members of the government or do not have important jobs; ordinary people who do not work for the government or have any special position in society; governmental, commonable; society, ambiente
words.translation: 公众的；公众；政府的；公用的；公立的；社会；公共场所

examples.en: We have to show that publishing this story is in the public interest (= helpful or useful to ordinary people ) .
examples.zh: 我们必须证明刊登这篇报道有利于公众。

examples.en: full public access to information
examples.zh: 公众对信息的充分知情权

examples.en: Public opinion is gradually shifting in favor of the imprisoned men.
examples.zh: 舆论渐渐倾向于同情入狱的男子。

words.definition: to use your hands to make something or someone move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving; draw, snake; draw; tension, digging rope
words.translation: 拉，拖；拉，拉力；拉；拔；拖；拉，拉绳；拉力，[交]牵引力

examples.en: Mom! Davey’s pulling my hair!
examples.zh: 妈妈! 戴维拽我的头发！

words.definition: to make someone suffer because they have done something wrong or broken the law; penalise, chastise; drop across, come down on
words.translation: 罚，惩罚，处罚；惩罚；严厉对待；贪婪地吃喝

examples.en: Smacking is not an acceptable way of punishing a child.
examples.zh: 要惩罚孩子，不应该用打的方式。

examples.en: He promised to punish severely any officials found guilty of electoral fraud.
examples.zh: 他承诺要严惩任何在选举中有欺诈行为的官员。

examples.en: They deserve to be punished for putting passengers at risk.
examples.zh: 他们置乘客于危险之中，理应受到惩罚。

words.definition: someone who is being taught, especially a child; student, minor
words.translation: 学生，小学生；学生；[解剖]瞳孔；未成年人

examples.en: About 20 pupils study music here.
examples.zh: 大约20名小学生在这里学习音乐。

examples.en: staff and pupils
examples.zh: 教职员工和学生

examples.en: a star pupil
examples.zh: 一名优秀的小学生

words.definition: a dark colour that is a mixture of red and blue; having a dark colour that is a mixture of red and blue; regal, violet; lila, amethyst; empurple
words.translation: 紫色；紫的；紫色的；帝王的；华而不实的；紫袍；使成紫色

examples.en: A purple may be made by dyeing a blue over a red.
examples.zh: 红色染上蓝色便可成为紫色。

examples.en: She had a purple dress on with a silver-white necklace.
examples.zh: 她穿着一条紫色的连衣裙配着一条银白色的项链。

words.definition: a bag in which a woman carries her money and personal things; bag, wallet; rivel
words.translation: 钱包，小钱袋，手袋；钱包，小钱袋；金钱，财源；皱起，缩拢

examples.en: I locked the door and dropped the keys in my purse.
examples.zh: 我锁上门，然后把钥匙丢进手提包里。

words.definition: to make someone or something move by pressing them with your hands, arms etc; enhance, drive, boost, press, force; spread, improve, accelerate, extend, gain; determination, decision, resolution, enterprise, attempt
words.translation: 推，逼迫；推；推动；增加；推行；逼迫；推进；伸展；努力争取；决心；奋力；攻击；干劲；进取心

examples.en: It didn’t move, so she pushed harder.
examples.zh: 它一动不动，因此她加力去推。

examples.en: I promised to push him on the swings for as long as he wanted.
examples.zh: 我答应他想在秋千上荡多久我就推多久。

examples.en: shoppers pushing their grocery carts
examples.zh: 推着购物车的购物者

words.definition: one of four equal parts into which something can be divided; region, area, direction, orientation, aspect; room, stop at
words.translation: 四分之一；一刻钟；季度；[数]四分之一；地区；方向；两角五分；驻扎；住宿

examples.en: It’s about a page and a quarter.
examples.zh: 大概是一又四分之一页。

examples.en: Cut the cake into quarters.
examples.zh: 把蛋糕切成四等份。

words.definition: a playing card with a picture of a queen on it; Regina, lady in waiting
words.translation: 王后；女王；女王，王后；（纸牌中的）皇后；（蜜蜂等的）蜂王

examples.en: the queen of diamonds
examples.zh: 方块Q，方块王后

words.definition: a sentence or phrase that is used to ask for information or to test someone’s knowledge; issue, doubt, query; dispute, wonder, query; wonder, query
words.translation: 发问；问题；疑问；[数]问题，疑问；询问；疑问句；怀疑；审问

examples.en: Can I ask you a question?
examples.zh: 我能问你个问题吗？

examples.en: I’m afraid I can’t answer that question.
examples.zh: 我恐怕无法回答那个问题。

words.definition: lasting for or taking only a short time; core, kernel, nucleus; sensitive, rapid, fast, forward, ready; rapidly, soon, fast, promptly, ready
words.translation: 快的；敏捷的；核心；伤口的嫩肉；迅速的，敏捷的；灵敏的；迅速地，快

examples.en: That was quick! I thought you’d be another hour.
examples.zh: 很快啊！我以为你还要一个小时呢。

examples.en: It’s probably quicker by train.
examples.zh: 乘火车可能会快一点。

examples.en: Have we got time for a quick drink?
examples.zh: 我们有时间喝口东西吗？

words.definition: not making much noise, or making no noise at all; balanced, still, tranquil; peace, tranquilness; comfort, appease; calm down, wind down
words.translation: 寂静的；安静的；安定的；不动的；温顺的；安静；和平；使平息；安慰；平静下来

examples.en: We’ll have to be quiet so as not to wake the baby.
examples.zh: 我们得安静点，免得吵醒宝宝。

examples.en: It’s a nice car. The engine’s really quiet.
examples.zh: 这车真好，发动机声音很小。

examples.en: I’ll be as quiet as a mouse (= very quiet ).
examples.zh: 我会像老鼠一样悄无声息的。

words.definition: You use quite to indicate that something is the case to a fairly great extent; greatly, badly, too, far, powerful
words.translation: 完全；相当；的确；很

examples.en: I felt quite bitter about it at the time.
examples.zh: 当时我对此感到相当痛苦。

examples.en: Well, actually it requires quite a bit of work and research.
examples.zh: 呃，实际上这需要相当多的工作和研究。

words.definition: a small animal with long ears and soft fur, that lives in a hole in the ground; bunny, hare; to hell with
words.translation: 兔子，野兔；让…见鬼去吧

examples.en: The rabbit disappeared in the bushes.
examples.zh: 那只兔子消失在树丛中。

examples.en: At this time, a robust rabbit said: "No, or eat me !
examples.zh: 这时，一只健壮的兔子又说：“不，还是先吃我吧！

words.definition: a competition in which people or animals compete to run, drive etc fastest and finish first; family, house, genus
words.translation: 比赛，竞赛，竞争；属，种；[人类]种族，人种；家庭，门弟

examples.en: The women's race was won by the only American in the field, Patti Sue Plumer.
examples.zh: 女子赛跑被田赛场上惟一的一名美国人帕蒂·休·普卢默赢得了。

words.definition: a piece of electronic equipment which you use to listen to programmes that are broadcast, such as music and news; receiving set
words.translation: 无线电；收音机；[电讯]收音机；无线电广播设备

examples.en: The last 12 months have been difficult ones for local radio.
examples.zh: 最近的12个月对地方广播电台来说是艰难的。

words.definition: a system of tracks along which trains run, or a system of trains; path, track, trajectory, orbit
words.translation: 铁路，铁道；（英）[铁路]铁路；轨道；铁道部门

examples.en: a railway company
examples.zh: 铁路公司

words.definition: water that falls in small drops from clouds in the sky; if it rains, drops of water fall from clouds in the sky; wet, monsoon; Make it Rain
words.translation: 雨，雨水；下雨；[气象]雨；雨天；雨季；降雨

examples.en: a night of wind and rain
examples.zh: 风雨交加的夜晚

examples.en: There will be heavy rain in most parts of the country.
examples.zh: 全国大部分地区将有大雨。

words.translation: （美）雨衣

words.definition: a rainy period of time is one when it rains a lot; pluvian, drippy
words.translation: 下雨的，多雨的；下雨的；多雨的

examples.en: a cold rainy day in October
examples.zh: 十月里一个寒冷的雨天

examples.en: I hate rainy weather .
examples.zh: 我讨厌雨天。

examples.en: the rainy season
examples.zh: 雨季

words.definition: to increase an amount, number, or level; enhance, mother, foster, breed; arise, go up, climb; height, rise, altitude, elevation, upgrade
words.translation: 提高，筹款，抚养；提高；筹集；养育；升起；上升；高地；加薪

examples.en: Many shops have raised their prices.
examples.zh: 很多商店都提价了。

examples.en: The university is working to raise the number of students from state schools.
examples.zh: 这所大学正在努力增加公立学校学生的入学人数。

examples.en: a campaign to raise awareness of meningitis
examples.zh: 增强脑膜炎防治意识的活动

words.definition: happening or done very quickly and in a very short time; fast, forward, ready, express, quick; rush, whitewater
words.translation: 快的；急流；迅速的，急促的；飞快的；险峻的；高速交通工具，高速交通网

examples.en: The patient made a rapid recovery.
examples.zh: 病人迅速康复。

examples.en: a period of rapid decline
examples.zh: 迅速衰退期

examples.en: He fired three times in rapid succession (= one after another ) .
examples.zh: 他接连开了三枪。

words.definition: an animal that looks like a large mouse with a long tail; traitor, betrayer; mouse, inform
words.translation: 老鼠，耗子；[脊椎]鼠；卑鄙小人，叛徒；捕鼠；背叛，告密

examples.en: But you promised to help us, you rat!
examples.zh: 可你答应过要帮我们的，你这小人！

words.definition: You use rather to indicate that something is true to a fairly great extent, especially when you are talking about something unpleasant or undesirable; soon, first, lot, bit, preferably
words.translation: 宁可，宁愿；相当

examples.en: I grew up in rather unusual circumstances.
examples.zh: 我在相当不寻常的环境中长大。

examples.en: I'm afraid it's a rather long story.
examples.zh: 我恐怕这是个相当长的故事。

words.definition: if someone or something reaches a particular point in their development or in a process or competition, they get to that point; go, range, arrive at; accomplish, affect, extend, influence, impact of; extent, boundary, region, scope, spectrum, territory, range
words.translation: 抵达；伸出vi达到；达到；延伸；伸出手；传开；影响；伸出；范围；河段；横风行驶

examples.en: Chelsea could reach the final of the European Cup.
examples.zh: 切尔西队会进入欧洲杯决赛。

words.definition: if you are ready, you are prepared for what you are going to do; rapid, fast, forward, express, quick; cash, real money; quickly, rapidly, in advance, previously, fast; prime
words.translation: 准备好的；愿意的；准备好；现成的；迅速的；情愿的；快要…的；现款；预备好的状态；迅速地；预先；使准备好

examples.en: Come on. Aren’t you ready yet?
examples.zh: 快点，你还没准备好吗？

examples.en: When the doorbell rang he was ready and waiting .
examples.zh: 门铃响的时候，他已经准备好在等着了。

examples.en: Why does it take you so long to get ready to go out?
examples.zh: 你外出怎么要准备那么长时间？

words.definition: something that is real exists and is important; practical, actual, effective, sincere, honest; strictly, indeed, undoubtedly, authentically; actuality, praxis
words.translation: 真的；现实的；[数]实际的；真实的；实在的；真正地；确实地；现实；[数]实数

examples.en: There is a real danger that the disease might spread.
examples.zh: 这种疾病确实有蔓延的危险。

examples.en: We need to tackle the real problems of unemployment and poverty.
examples.zh: 我们需要解决失业和贫穷这两个实际问题。

examples.en: There is no real reason to worry.
examples.zh: 没有什么真正的理由需要担心。

words.definition: to be given something; acknowledge receipt of, to hand; take over
words.translation: 收到；得到；接待；接纳；接收

examples.en: All the children will receive a small gift.
examples.zh: 每个孩子都会收到一份小礼物。

examples.en: Lee received 324 votes (= 324 people voted for him ) .
examples.zh: 李得到324票。

words.definition: having happened or started only a short time ago; latest, modern, current, nearest, last
words.translation: 新近的，最近的；[地质]最近的；近代的

examples.en: Irving’s most recent book
examples.zh: 欧文最新的书

examples.en: recent research into the causes of cancer
examples.zh: 近来对致癌原因的研究

examples.en: the recent past
examples.zh: 不久前

words.definition: to say a poem, piece of literature etc that you have learned, for people to listen to; repeat, specify, relate; say over, learn sth by memory
words.translation: 背诵， 朗诵；列举， 一一说出；背诵；叙述；列举

examples.en: She recited a poem that she had learnt at school.
examples.zh: 她背诵了一首学校里学的诗。

words.definition: information about something that is written down or stored on computer, film etc so that it can be looked at in the future; to write information down or store it in a computer or on film so that it can be looked at in the future; register, keep track of; keep track of, make notes of; disk, file, resume, disc
words.translation: 记录；履历；记录，记载；标明；将...录音；录音；档案，履历；[电子]唱片；最高纪录

examples.en: According to official records, five people were killed last year near that road junction.
examples.zh: 据官方记录，去年有五人在那个路口附近丧生。

words.definition: a piece of electrical equipment that records music, films etc; tape-recorder, dictating machine
words.translation: 记录者；录音机；[电讯]录音机；[法][仪][电子]记录器；记录员；八孔直笛

examples.zh: 很多人正计划回到自己的祖国去。

words.definition: mathematics; arith
words.translation: (英)数学；数学（等于mathematics）

examples.zh: 数学课

examples.zh: 她数学和化学得了最高分。

words.definition: a stupid person or someone who has done something stupid; to trick someone into believing something that is not true; pull a fast one, give the shaft; stupid, donkey; sell, fox, kid; twp, softheaded
words.translation: 蠢人，傻子；欺骗；开玩笑；戏弄；傻瓜；愚人；受骗者；欺骗，愚弄；傻的

examples.en: What a fool she had been to think that he would stay.
examples.zh: 她竟然那么傻，以为他会留下来。

examples.zh: 我像个傻子，立刻就接受了。

examples.zh: 你这个大傻瓜！

words.definition: when something or someone is liked or supported by a lot of people; prevalence, diffusedness
words.translation: 普及， 流行；声望；普及，流行；名气；受大众欢迎

examples.en: The president’s popularity has declined considerably.
examples.zh: 总统的支持率大大下降了。

words.definition: one of the hard white objects in your mouth that you use to bite and eat food; engage
words.translation: 牙齿；啮合

examples.zh: 糖对牙齿不好。

words.definition: the part of your body that you stand on and walk on; last, trilby; hoof it, pad; Make Payment, disburse
words.translation: 脚；最下部；英尺；[解剖]脚；步调；末尾；步行；跳舞；总计；支付；给……换底

examples.en: My foot hurts.
examples.zh: 我脚痛。

examples.en: I had blisters on the soles of my feet .
examples.zh: 我的脚底起泡了。

examples.en: I dropped a glass earlier, so don’t walk around in bare feet .
examples.zh: 我刚才打破了一个玻璃杯，所以不要光着脚到处走。

words.definition: a group of numbers, shapes etc in mathematics; device, apparatus, installation, assembly, tendency, unit, direction; put, fire, rear, light; result, bottom line; specified, stated, fixed, prescribed, regulation
words.translation: 集（合）；一套；[数]集合；[机]装置；趋势；布景；放；树立；点燃；使凝结；点缀；结果；定型；凝固；规定的；固定的；固执的

examples.en: The set (x, y) has two members.
examples.zh: （x, y）这个集里有两个项。

words.definition: extremely good; prominent, excellent, obvious, brilliant, marked
words.translation: 突出的，杰出的；杰出的；显著的；未解决的；[会计][经]未偿付的

examples.en: an outstanding example of a 13th-century castle
examples.zh: 13世纪城堡的杰出典范

examples.en: an outstanding success
examples.zh: 了不起的成功

examples.en: His performance was outstanding.
examples.zh: 他的表演相当出色。

words.definition: a set of moving stairs that take people to different levels in a building
words.translation: 电动扶梯

examples.en: Take the escalator to the third floor and it's the last office on the left.
examples.zh: 乘电梯到4楼，左边最后的那个办公室就是。

words.definition: one of two people who are married, or who live together and have a sexual relationship; comrade, associate; joint stock, tie up; team
words.translation: 伙伴；搭挡；配偶；[法]合伙人；[法]合伙；合股；成为搭档；使合作；与…合伙

examples.en: Discuss your worries with your partner.
examples.zh: 和伴侣谈谈你的忧虑。

examples.en: Only 29% of lone parents receive financial support from their former partners .
examples.zh: 只有29%的单身家长得到他们前配偶的经济资助。

examples.en: a sexual partner
examples.zh: 性伴侣

words.definition: a small creature with eight legs, which catches insects using a fine network of sticky threads; araneid, tripod
words.translation: 蜘蛛；[无脊椎]蜘蛛；设圈套者；三脚架

examples.en: What should I find but an enormous spider!
examples.zh: 我居然发现了一只巨大的蜘蛛！

examples.en: Do you think that the spider can web anything?
examples.zh: 你觉得这蜘蛛能用网捕住什么吗?

examples.en: I should not have to live my eternity away from my little spider.
examples.zh: 我不会离开我的小蜘蛛而孤凄地度过那无边岁月的。

words.definition: a quality that people, places, or things have that makes them very attractive to look at; fair, pulchritude
words.translation: 美，美丽；美人；美；美丽；美好的东西

examples.en: her beauty and grace
examples.zh: 她的美貌和优雅风姿

examples.en: an area of outstanding natural beauty
examples.zh: 一个自然风景极美的地区

examples.en: Millions of dollars are spent each year on beauty products .
examples.zh: 每年都有上千万的钱花在美容产品上。

words.definition: used instead of repeating a verb that has already been used; requirement, provision, need, desire, demand; accomplish, carry out, come, achieve, perform; progress, wage
words.translation: v；做，干，办；要求；规定；C大调音阶中的第一音；做；进行；完成；解答

examples.en: ‘Will Kay come?’ ‘She may do.’
examples.zh: “凯来吗？” “或许吧。”

examples.en: So now you know as much as I do.
examples.zh: 那么现在你知道的和我一样多了。

examples.en: ‘You forgot all about it.’ ‘No, I didn’t.’
examples.zh: “你把这事忘记得一干二净。” “没有，我没忘记。”

words.definition: funny and enjoyable; funny, witty
words.translation: 富于幽默的，诙谐的；诙谐的，幽默的；滑稽的，可笑的

examples.en: humorous stories
examples.zh: 诙谐的故事

examples.en: The film has some mildly humorous moments.
examples.zh: 那部电影中有些略显幽默的片段。

words.definition: timid, tremulous
words.translation: 引起惊慌的；提心吊胆的；胆小的

words.definition: something that causes problems, or that makes someone or something less likely to be successful or effective; defect, deficiency, vice, losing, expense
words.translation: 不利情况，缺点；缺点；不利条件；损失

examples.en: Criminal behaviour can be linked to economic disadvantage.
examples.zh: 犯罪行为可能会与经济困难有关。

words.definition: to say that you are annoyed, not satisfied, or unhappy about something or someone; whine about, beef; beef about, rail against
words.translation: 抱怨；投诉；发牢骚；诉说；控诉

examples.en: Residents are complaining because traffic in the area has increased.
examples.zh: 由于这个地区的交通流量有所增加，居民都在抱怨。

examples.en: ‘You never ask my opinion about anything,’ Rod complained.
examples.zh: “你什么事都不问问我的看法。”罗德抱怨道。

examples.en: Employees complained bitterly about working conditions.
examples.zh: 雇员们对工作条件十分不满。

words.definition: a metal blade fixed into a handle, used for cutting or as a weapon; sword, chiv; injure, scar; to break open
words.translation: 小刀，刀，餐刀；[机]刀；匕首；用刀切；（口）伤害；劈开；划过

examples.en: a knife and fork
examples.zh: 一副刀叉

examples.en: Some young people are carrying knives to defend themselves.
examples.zh: 一些年轻人带着刀子防身。

examples.en: a kitchen knife
examples.zh: 厨房用刀

words.definition: a large piece of electrical kitchen equipment, shaped like a cupboard, used for keeping food and drink cool; icebox, freezer
words.translation: 冰箱，冷藏库；[制冷]冰箱，冷藏库

words.definition: small in size; tiny, few, small, brief, passing; far from; touch, trait
words.translation: 小的；少；幼小的；很少的；短暂的；小巧可爱的；完全不；少许；没有多少；短时间

examples.en: a little house
examples.zh: 小屋

examples.en: a cake decorated with little flowers
examples.zh: 点缀着小花的蛋糕

examples.en: She was cutting the meat up into little bits.
examples.zh: 她把肉切成小丁。

words.definition: a large tree that is common in northern countries, or the hard wood of this tree; quercine
words.translation: 栎属植物；栎木；[植]栎树的；栎木制的

examples.en: an oak door
examples.zh: 橡木门

words.definition: to be in a particular position or condition; lie on, be located on
words.translation: 坐；位于；(Sit)人名；(东南亚国家华语)硕；(罗)西特

examples.en: The parliament building sits in a large square.
examples.zh: 议会大楼位于一个大广场上。

examples.en: He’s got a computer sitting on his desk, but he doesn’t use it.
examples.zh: 他有一台电脑放在书桌上，但他不用。

examples.en: My climbing boots were sitting unused in a cupboard.
examples.zh: 我的登山靴在橱柜里，一直没有穿。

words.definition: a large group of people who have gathered together to do something, for example to watch something or protest about something; burst at the seams, be packed with; lot, band; concentrate, pile, collect, mass, pack
words.translation: 群；大众；一伙人；挤满；将…塞进；催逼，催促；人群；一堆；一帮；拥挤，挤；聚集

examples.en: A vast crowd gathered in the main square.
examples.zh: 主广场上聚集了一大群人。

examples.en: She mingled with the crowd of guests, exchanging greetings.
examples.zh: 她穿梭在宾客中间和他们打招呼。

examples.en: Saturday’s game was watched by a capacity crowd (= the maximum number of people that a sports ground etc can hold ) .
examples.zh: 星期六的比赛座无虚席。

words.definition: without problems or difficulties; clearly, no doubt, readily, lightly
words.translation: 容易地；舒适的；无疑地

examples.en: They won quite easily.
examples.zh: 他们赢得相当轻松。

examples.en: We found the house easily enough.
examples.zh: 我们轻轻松松就找到了房子。

words.definition: a set of clothes worn by an actor or by someone to make them look like something such as an animal, famous person etc; clothing, wear, garment, apparel
words.translation: 服装；[服装]服装，装束；戏装，剧装

examples.en: the film’s lavish costumes and spectacular sets
examples.zh: 影片中奢华的戏装和壮观的场景

examples.en: Hallowe’en costumes
examples.zh: 万圣节前夕化装服

words.translation: 走廊， 回廊； 门厅， 过道

words.definition: a word or group of words that describes an action, experience, or state, such as ‘come’, ‘see’, and ‘put on’; rhematic
words.translation: 动词；[语]动词的；有动词性质的；起动词作用的

examples.en: The German verb is postponed.
examples.zh: 德语动词放在句末。

examples.en: The word is compounded of a preposition and a verb.
examples.zh: 这个词是由一个介词和一个动词复合而成的。

examples.en: The verb agrees with its subject in number and person.
examples.zh: 动词的数和人称与主语一致。

words.translation: 存在， 是

words.definition: to cook something in hot fat or oil, or to be cooked in hot fat or oil; deep-fry, panbroil; deepfry
words.translation: 油煎，油炸，油炒；油炸；油煎

examples.en: Fry the potatoes, covered, for about 20 minutes.
examples.zh: 盖上盖，将马铃薯煎20分钟左右。

examples.en: I could smell onions frying.
examples.zh: 我闻到了煎洋葱的味道。

words.definition: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it; an amount of liquid that you drink, or the act of drinking something; eat, absorb; wine, liquor; wine, liquor, beverage
words.translation: 饮；喝；饮料；喝，饮；吸收；举杯庆贺；喝酒；饮水；干杯；酒，饮料

examples.en: You should drink plenty of water.
examples.zh: 你应该大量喝水。

examples.en: What would you like to drink?
examples.zh: 你想喝点什么？

examples.en: Take a seat while I get you something to drink .
examples.zh: 请坐，我去给你倒杯喝的。

words.definition: to officially tell people about something, especially about a plan or a decision; indicate, bill, forecast, shadow
words.translation: 宣布，声称；宣布；述说；预示；播报

examples.zh: 他们在《泰晤士报》上宣布了订婚的消息。

examples.en: At the end of their meeting, it was announced that an agreement had been reached.
examples.zh: 会议最后宣布已达成一项协议。

words.definition: to use and control a machine or equipment; run, act; attract, keep, produce, work, handle
words.translation: 操作；施行手术；运转；动手术；起作用；经营；引起；对…开刀

examples.zh: 刘易斯一家在运河上经营着几艘船。

examples.zh: 克莱夫对操作电脑很有经验。

words.definition: used as a greeting when you see or meet someone; hallo, holloo
words.translation: 喂；哈罗

examples.zh: 喂，约翰！你好吗？

examples.en: Stanley, come and say hello to your nephew.
examples.zh: 斯坦利，过来和你的侄子打声招呼。

examples.en: Well, hello there ! I haven’t seen you for ages.
examples.zh: 嗨，你好！好久不见了。

words.definition: to start doing something; institute, initiate, start in, lead off, to box; proceed, start in
words.translation: 开始；首先

examples.en: As everybody’s here, let’s begin.
examples.zh: 大家都到齐了，我们就开始吧。

examples.en: In the third year students begin the study of classical Chinese.
examples.zh: 学生在三年级开始学古代汉语。

examples.en: The president begins talks with the prime minister tonight.
examples.zh: 总统将于今晚和首相展开会谈。

words.definition: a tropical bird with a curved beak and brightly coloured feathers that can be taught to copy human speech; Nuri, popinjay
words.translation: 鹦鹉；[鸟]鹦鹉；学舌者，应声虫；机械模仿别人的人

examples.en: We recited poems parrot fashion.
examples.zh: 我们鹦鹉学舌般机械地背诵诗歌。

words.definition: to start to have a feeling or quality, or to start to develop into something; get, fall, come; suit, adapt to something
words.translation: 变成；成为，变得；成为；变得；适合；相称

examples.en: The weather became warmer.
examples.zh: 天气变暖和了。

examples.en: Slowly my eyes became accustomed to the darkness.
examples.zh: 我的眼睛渐渐适应了黑暗。

examples.en: Helen became increasingly anxious about her husband’s strange behaviour.
examples.zh: 海伦越来越担心她丈夫的反常行为。

words.definition: to end a period of silence by talking or making a noise; rest, interruption; smash in, cut off
words.translation: 打破；损坏；破坏；休息，中断；破裂处；打破，弄破；中断；弄坏；削弱

examples.zh: 一声尖叫打破了寂静。

words.definition: to produce a picture of something using a pencil, pen etc; picture, absorb, pull, attract, engage; pull; lot, tie
words.translation: 画，划；拖；拨出；画；拉；吸引；平局；抽签

examples.en: Katie had drawn a cottage with a little stream running next to it.
examples.zh: 凯蒂画了一间小茅舍，旁边流淌着一条小溪。

examples.en: She asked the little girl to draw a picture of the man she’d spoken to.
examples.zh: 她让小女孩把刚才和她说话的那个男人画出来。

examples.en: Keith was drawing a complicated-looking graph.
examples.zh: 基思在画一张看上去很复杂的图表。

words.definition: a piece of furniture with doors, and sometimes shelves, used for storing clothes, plates, food etc; dresser, spense
words.translation: 碗柜，碗碟橱；食橱；[家具]碗柜

examples.en: It’s in the kitchen cupboard.
examples.zh: 它在厨房的碗柜里。

examples.en: The cupboard doors were open.
examples.zh: 柜门开着。

words.definition: to deliberately put or keep something or someone in a place where they cannot easily be seen or found; lock, pocket, conceal; bottle up, keep in; fell, jook
words.translation: 把…藏起来；隐瞒；隐藏；鞭打；躲藏；兽皮；躲藏处

examples.en: She keeps a bottle of gin hidden behind a stack of books.
examples.zh: 她在一堆书的后面藏了一瓶杜松子酒。

words.definition: a mark or shape that has a particular meaning; symbol, breath, evidence, mark, motion; subscribe; ink, endorse
words.translation: 符号；招牌；签名；迹象；记号；手势；签署；示意

examples.en: the dollar sign
examples.zh: 美元符号

examples.en: a minus sign
examples.zh: 减号

words.definition: someone who has written a book; writer, pen
words.translation: 作者，作家；[图情]作者；作家；创始人

examples.en: Nothomb is a Belgian author.
examples.zh: 诺东是位比利时作家。

examples.en: It’s clear that the author is a woman.
examples.zh: 显然，这位作者是女性。

words.definition: a machine that measures and shows the amount of something you have used or the amount of money that you must pay; rhythm, metre
words.translation: 计量器，计，表；米；仪表；[计量]公尺；韵律

examples.en: A man came to read the electricity meter .
examples.zh: 有个男的来抄电表。

examples.en: The taxi driver left the meter running while I ran in to pick up my bags.
examples.zh: 我跑进去拿行李时，出租车司机让计价器继续走字。

words.translation: 原形； 不定式

words.definition: to start a company, organization, system, etc that is intended to exist or continue for a long time; build, found, constitute, put, station
words.translation: 建立，创办，设立；建立；创办；安置

examples.en: The city of Boerne was established by German settlers in the 1840s.
examples.zh: 博恩市是德国移民于19世纪40年代建立的。

examples.en: Our goal is to establish a new research centre in the North.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是在北方建立一个新的研究中心。

words.definition: a series of thoughts, images, and feelings that you experience when you are asleep; to think about something that you would like to happen or have; come to mind, bethink of; voice, aspirations; ideal, unreasonable
words.translation: 梦；梦想；做梦；做梦，梦见；想到；梦想，愿望；[心理]梦；梦的；理想的；不切实际的

examples.en: I had lots of dreams last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我做了很多梦。

words.definition: a short piece of writing about a particular subject by a student as part of a course of study; attempt, prose; sample, have a try
words.translation: 散文，文章；散文；试图；随笔；尝试；对…做试验

examples.en: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown.
examples.zh: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

words.definition: a statement about what you think is going to happen, or the act of making this statement; message, forecast
words.translation: 预言，预告；预报；预言

examples.en: The data can be used to make useful economic predictions .
examples.zh: 这些数据可用于进行有用的经济预测。

words.definition: to ask a large number of people questions in order to find out their attitudes or opinions; a set of questions that you ask a large number of people in order to find out about their opinions or behaviour; investigation, measurement, probe, research; examine, check into

examples.zh: 被调查的 100 家公司中，10% 的公司营业额在 5,000 万到 9,900 万英镑之间。

words.translation: 时态，时；紧张的；拉紧的；变得紧张；使拉紧；拉紧，变得紧张

examples.en: It was as though Corinne was already dead: they were speaking of her in the past tense.
examples.zh: 就好像科琳已经死了似的：他们当时在用过去时态谈起她。

words.definition: a set of instructions for cooking a particular type of food; secret, tips
words.translation: 秘方，食谱；食谱；[临床]处方；秘诀

examples.en: a recipe book
examples.zh: 一本烹饪书

words.definition: a piece of  wax  , paper, wire etc that you have to break in order to open a container, document etc; to close an entrance or a container with something that stops air, water etc from coming in or out of it; symbol, print; pressure, air proof
words.translation: 封蜡；印记；封；[机]密封；印章；[皮革][脊椎]海豹；封条；标志；盖章

examples.en: The seal on the box broke when it fell from its hiding-place.
examples.zh: 盒子从隐藏处掉下时上面的封口破了。

words.definition: to bend the top part of your body forward in order to show respect for someone important, or as a way of thanking an  audience; stem, Yumi; stoop down, bend down; curve, winding, flexural, crooked
words.translation: 鞠躬；弓；船首；弯腰；弯曲的

examples.en: She bowed and left the stage.
examples.zh: 她鞠了一躬，离开了舞台。

examples.en: Corbett entered the room, bowing respectfully.
examples.zh: 科比特走进房间，恭敬地鞠了一躬。

examples.en: The servant bowed low and handed his master the sealed note.

words.translation: 有规律的，经常的；定期的；有规律的；合格的；[植]整齐的；常客；正式队员；中坚分子；定期地；经常地

examples.en: The company holds regular meetings with employees.
examples.zh: 公司定期召集雇员开会。

examples.en: His breathing was slow and regular.
examples.zh: 他的呼吸缓慢而均匀。

examples.en: Trains will run at regular intervals from 11 am to 4 pm.
examples.zh: 火车从上午11点到下午4点每隔一定时间开行。

words.definition: to give something to someone in exchange for money; promote, find a market; bring to market, go to sb for; marketing, disappointment
words.translation: 销售；推销；出卖；欺骗；失望；推销术；卖；出售；受欢迎；有销路

examples.en: If you offer him another hundred, I think he’ll sell.
examples.zh: 如果你再加一百元钱，我想他会卖的。

examples.en: He regrets selling all his old records.
examples.zh: 他后悔把所有的老唱片都卖掉了。

words.definition: a strong human feeling such as love, hate, or anger; mood, will, spirit, affect, feeling
words.translation: 情感，感情；激动；[心理]情感；情绪

examples.en: Her voice was full of emotion.
examples.zh: 她的声音充满了激情。

examples.en: She was good at hiding her emotions.
examples.zh: 她很会掩饰自己的情感。

examples.en: Kim received the news without showing any visible sign of emotion.
examples.zh: 金接到消息时丝毫不露声色。

words.definition: the formal rules for polite behaviour in society or in a particular group; ceremony, manner, protocol
words.translation: 礼节， 礼仪；礼节，礼仪；规矩

examples.en: strict rules of professional etiquette
examples.zh: 严格的行规

words.definition: a line of people waiting to enter a building, buy something etc, or a line of vehicles waiting to move; to form or join a line of people or vehicles waiting to do something or go somewhere; train, alignment, tail, rank; line up for, stand in a line
words.translation: 行列；排队等候；[数]队列；长队；辫子；[数]排队

examples.en: You’ll have to join the queue.
examples.zh: 你得排队。

words.translation: 不礼貌的， 粗鲁的

words.definition: to make known something that was previously secret or unknown; make clear, prove, disclose, expose; uncovery, exposure to sth
words.translation: 揭露，揭示；显示；透露；揭露；泄露；暴露；门侧，[建]窗侧

examples.en: He may be prosecuted for revealing secrets about the security agency.
examples.zh: 他可能因泄露安全部门的机密而被起诉。

examples.en: a test that can reveal a teacher’s hidden skills
examples.zh: 能够展现老师潜在技能的测试

words.definition: a round white vegetable with a brown, red, or white skin and many layers. Onions have a strong taste and smell.
words.translation: 洋葱，洋葱头

examples.en: Chop the onions finely.
examples.zh: 把洋葱切碎。

examples.en: red onions
examples.zh: 红皮洋葱

examples.en: home-made onion soup
examples.zh: 自制的洋葱汤

words.definition: considering only the bad qualities of a situation, person etc and not the good ones; passive, destructive; infirmation, disaffirmation; deny, refuse
words.translation: 否定的；消积的；[数]负的；消极的；[语]否定的；阴性的；[语]否定；负数；[摄]底片；拒绝

examples.en: students with a negative attitude to school
examples.zh: 对上学抱消极态度的学生

examples.en: They have a uniformly negative image of the police.
examples.zh: 他们都对警察印象不好。

examples.en: Jean rarely sounded so negative about her mother.
examples.zh: 琼很少这么说她母亲不好。

words.definition: judging and dealing with situations in a practical way according to what is actually possible rather than what you would like to happen; living, breathing
words.translation: 现实的，实际的；现实的；现实主义的；逼真的；实在论的

examples.en: Is this a realistic target?
examples.zh: 这个目标能够实现吗？

words.definition: an imaginary or ancient creature that is large, ugly, and frightening; giant, bugbear; huge, enormous, tremendous, massive, macro
words.translation: 怪物；畸形的动植物；巨人，巨兽；残忍的人；巨大的，庞大的

examples.en: the remains of a prehistoric monster
examples.zh: 史前怪兽的遗骸

examples.en: the search for the Loch Ness Monster
examples.zh: 对内斯湖水怪的搜寻

words.definition: a small piece of paper, plastic etc attached to something to show what it is, who owns it, what it costs etc; name, ticket, label, belonging; dog, shadow, couple; tread on the heels of
words.translation: 附加语；标签；名称；结束语；附属物；尾随，紧随；连接；起浑名；添饰；紧随

examples.en: Staff wore name tags and called inmates by their first names.
examples.zh: 工作人员戴着姓名标签，对同僚直呼其名。

words.definition: if the wind or a current of air blows, it moves; stroke, shock, strike, hit, hiding; catch my breath
words.translation: 吹，吹动；吹响；吹；[机]打击；殴打；风吹；喘气

examples.en: A cold breeze was blowing hard .
examples.zh: 寒风劲吹。

examples.en: It was blowing from an easterly direction.
examples.zh: 这是从东面吹过来的。

examples.en: Outside, the weather was blowing a gale .
examples.zh: 外面狂风大作。

words.definition: a sudden shaking of the earth’s surface that often causes a lot of damage; temblor, seismic event
words.translation: 地震；大震荡；[地震]地震；大动荡

examples.en: An earthquake measuring 6.1 on the Richter scale struck southern California on June 28.
examples.zh: 6月28日加州南部地区发生了里氏6.1级地震。

examples.en: The city is in an earthquake zone.
examples.zh: 该市位于地震带。

words.definition: money put, saved, or given towards something is used to pay for it; at, unto, for, on, to
words.translation: 用于，有助于；朝，向；对于；有助于

examples.en: The money collected will be put towards repairing the church roof.
examples.zh: 募集到的钱款将用于修缮教堂屋顶。

words.definition: to arrange for something to go or be taken to another place, especially by post; beam, release, mission, project, let go; to post a letter; ascending motion, upward movement
words.translation: 发送,派遣；发送，寄；派遣；使进入；发射；派人；寄信；上升运动

examples.en: Lyn sent some pictures of the wedding.
examples.zh: 琳恩寄了几张婚礼照片。

words.definition: the purpose of something is what it is intended to achieve; goals, intention, sake, objective, use; propose, think
words.translation: 目的；意图；效果；用途；意志；决心；企图；打算

examples.en: Nick had no particular purpose in mind when he started.
examples.zh: 尼克开始的时候头脑中并没有明确的目标。

words.definition: to leave somewhere very quickly, in order to escape from danger; lift, disappear, blank; escape, desert
words.translation: 逃走， 逃掉， 逃离；避开， 逃避；逃走；消失，消散；逃跑，逃走；逃避

examples.en: His attackers turned and fled.
examples.zh: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

examples.en: Masaari spent six months in prison before fleeing the country .
examples.zh: 正有蹲了六个月监狱，然后逃出了该国。

words.definition: a man who is admired for doing something extremely brave; chief actor, starring actor
words.translation: 男主角；英雄；勇士；男主角，男主人公

examples.en: He had dared to speak out against injustice, and overnight he became a national hero .
examples.zh: 他敢于站出来抨击不公正的现象，一夜之间就成了国家英雄。

examples.en: His father was a war hero , a former fighter pilot.
examples.zh: 他父亲是一位战争英雄，曾经是战斗机飞行员。

examples.en: the unsung heroes who drove convoys of aid to Bosnia
examples.zh: 运载援助物品到波斯尼亚的那些无名英雄

words.definition: to officially give someone something such as a prize or money to reward them for something they have done; something such as a prize or money given to someone to reward them for something they have done; grant, give; prize, sentence
words.translation: 授予；判给；奖(金)；判定；奖品；判决

examples.en: Moodie has been awarded a golf scholarship at the University of Hawaii.
examples.zh: 穆迪获授夏威夷大学高尔夫奖学金。

words.definition: to make the necessary arrangements so that an activity can happen effectively; structure, form
words.translation: 组织，编组；组织；使有系统化；给予生机；组织成立工会等

examples.en: The course was organized by a training company.
examples.zh: 这一课程是由一家培训公司组织的。

examples.en: Students need to learn how to organize their work.
examples.zh: 学生要学会如何安排好自己的学习。

words.definition: not as good as you hoped or expected; disillusionary, cauld
words.translation: 令人失望的；令人扫兴的

examples.en: disappointing profit figures
examples.zh: 令人失望的盈利数字

examples.en: The Lakers’ loss in the playoffs was very disappointing.
examples.zh: 湖人队在季后赛中的失利令人十分失望。

words.definition: athlete, sportsman
words.translation: 游戏的人；比赛者；运动员，比赛者；游戏者，做游戏的人；演奏者，表演者；演员

examples.en: a guitar player
examples.zh: 一名吉他手

words.definition: the amount of money that you have to pay in order to buy, do, or produce something; invested, spend, expend; fee, charge, expense, price, losing
words.translation: 价格，代价；成本；花费；使付出；使花许多钱；费用，[贸易]代价，[会计]成本；损失

examples.en: I offered to pay the cost of the taxi.
examples.zh: 我提出支付出租车费。

examples.en: Insurance to cover the cost of a funeral is possible.
examples.zh: 可以用保险支付葬礼费用。

examples.en: This doesn’t include the cost of repairing the damage.
examples.zh: 这不包括修理破损的费用。

words.definition: to make someone feel pleased by doing what they want; turn up trumps; meet, fulfill, fill, please, reason
words.translation: 满足,使满意；令人满意；令人满足；满足；说服，使相信；使满意，使高兴

examples.en: Nothing I did would ever satisfy my father.
examples.zh: 我做什么都不能让父亲满意。

words.translation: 将，会，要〔用于构成将来时〕；意志，毅力，决心；设法用意志力驱使〔某事发生〕
真正地；实在

words.definition: something that tests strength, skill, or ability, especially in a way that is interesting; dare, doubt
words.translation: 挑战；质疑；怀疑

examples.en: They threw down the challenge that he couldn’t wash 40 cars in one hour (= invited him to try to do it ) .
examples.zh: 他们激将他，说他不可能在1小时内擦洗40辆汽车。

words.definition: living in a natural state, not changed or controlled by people; in natural and free conditions, not kept or controlled by people; if plants run wild, they grow a lot in an uncontrolled way; crazy, field, enthusiastic, desert; Sahara, moorland; random, madly
words.translation: 野生的；野蛮的；狂热的；荒凉的；荒野；疯狂地；胡乱地

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["wild animals"]}
examples.zh: 野生动物

examples.en: a field full of wild flowers
examples.zh: 遍地野花的田野

examples.en: animals both wild and domesticated
examples.zh: 野生动物和家养动物
